# STAGE 1: Build
# ============================================
FROM node:20-alpine AS builder

WORKDIR /app

COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm install

COPY . .

ENV NODE_ENV=production

RUN npm run build

# ============================================
# STAGE 2: Serve dengan nginx
# ============================================
FROM nginx:alpine

COPY --from=builder /app/dist /usr/share/nginx/html
COPY nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf

EXPOSE 80

CMD ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"]

FILE: combine.cjs

// combine.js
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

const SRC_DIR = path.join(__dirname, 'src');
const OUTPUT_FILE = path.join(__dirname, 'combined.txt');

// Daftar extension yang mau di-include (kosongkan array = semua file)
const INCLUDE_EXTENSIONS = ['.js', '.ts', '.jsx', '.tsx', '.json', '.css', '.html', '.md'];
// File/folder yang di-skip
const IGNORE_LIST = ['node_modules', '.git', 'dist', 'build', '.next'];

/**
 * Cek apakah file/folder harus di-skip
 */
function shouldIgnore(name) {
  return IGNORE_LIST.includes(name);
}

/**
 * Baca semua file secara rekursif
 */
function walkDir(dir, files = []) {
  const entries = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true });

  for (const entry of entries) {
    if (shouldIgnore(entry.name)) continue;

    const fullPath = path.join(dir, entry.name);

    if (entry.isDirectory()) {
      walkDir(fullPath, files);
    } else if (entry.isFile()) {
      // Filter extension jika INCLUDE_EXTENSIONS tidak kosong
      if (INCLUDE_EXTENSIONS.length > 0) {
        const ext = path.extname(entry.name).toLowerCase();
        if (!INCLUDE_EXTENSIONS.includes(ext)) continue;
      }
      files.push(fullPath);
    }
  }

  return files;
}

/**
 * Format output: gabungkan semua file
 */
function buildOutput(files) {
  const parts = [];
  const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();

  parts.push('='.repeat(80));
  parts.push(`COMBINED SOURCE FILES`);
  parts.push(`Generated: ${timestamp}`);
  parts.push(`Total files: ${files.length}`);
  parts.push('='.repeat(80));
  parts.push('');

  for (const file of files) {
    // Path relatif terhadap folder src (untuk header)
    const relativePath = path.relative(__dirname, file).replace(/\\/g, '/');
    // Nama file
    const fileName = path.basename(file);
    // Folder lokasi
    const folderPath = path.dirname(relativePath);

    parts.push('');
    parts.push('='.repeat(80));
    parts.push(`FILE   : ${fileName}`);
    parts.push(`PATH   : ${relativePath}`);
    parts.push(`FOLDER : ${folderPath}`);
    parts.push('='.repeat(80));

    try {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf-8');
      parts.push(content);
    } catch (err) {
      parts.push(`[ERROR membaca file: ${err.message}]`);
    }

    parts.push(''); // newline pemisah
  }

  return parts.join('\n');
}

/**
 * Main
 */
function main() {
  // Cek folder src
  if (!fs.existsSync(SRC_DIR)) {
    console.error(`❌ Folder tidak ditemukan: ${SRC_DIR}`);
    process.exit(1);
  }

  console.log(`📂 Membaca file dari: ${SRC_DIR}`);

  const files = walkDir(SRC_DIR);
  console.log(`✅ Ditemukan ${files.length} file`);

  if (files.length === 0) {
    console.warn('⚠️  Tidak ada file yang ditemukan.');
    return;
  }

  const output = buildOutput(files);
  fs.writeFileSync(OUTPUT_FILE, output, 'utf-8');

  const sizeKB = (Buffer.byteLength(output, 'utf-8') / 1024).toFixed(2);
  console.log(`💾 Output disimpan ke: ${OUTPUT_FILE}`);
  console.log(`📦 Ukuran file: ${sizeKB} KB`);
}

main();

import { Refine, Authenticated } from "@refinedev/core";
import { RefineKbarProvider } from "@refinedev/kbar";
import routerProvider, {
  NavigateToResource,
  UnsavedChangesNotifier,
  DocumentTitleHandler,
  CatchAllNavigate,
} from "@refinedev/react-router-v6";
import { dataProvider, liveProvider } from "@refinedev/supabase";
import { BrowserRouter, Route, Routes, Outlet } from "react-router-dom";
import { useNotificationProvider, ErrorComponent } from "@refinedev/antd";
import { App as AntdApp, ConfigProvider } from "antd";
import {
  DashboardOutlined,
  AppstoreOutlined,
  AppstoreAddOutlined,
} from "@ant-design/icons";
import "@refinedev/antd/dist/reset.css";

import { supabaseClient } from "./utility/supabaseClient";
import { USE_MOCK } from "./utility/config";
import { DashboardPage } from "./pages/dashboard";
import { InventoryPage } from "./pages/inventory";
import { LoginPage } from "./pages/login";
import { ProductCreatePage } from "./pages/products/create";
import { EntryPage } from "./pages/entry";
import { AdminLayout } from "./components/layout/AdminLayout";
import { authProvider } from "./authProvider";

const mockDataProvider = {
  getList: async () => ({ data: [], total: 0 }),
  getOne: async () => ({ data: {} }),
  create: async () => ({ data: {} }),
  update: async () => ({ data: {} }),
  deleteOne: async () => ({ data: {} }),
  getApiUrl: () => "",
  custom: async () => ({ data: {} }),
} as never;

function App() {
  const dataProviderConfig = USE_MOCK
    ? mockDataProvider
    : dataProvider(supabaseClient);

  const liveProviderConfig = USE_MOCK
    ? undefined
    : liveProvider(supabaseClient);

  return (
    <BrowserRouter>
      <ConfigProvider
        theme={{ token: { borderRadius: 8, colorPrimary: "#1677ff" } }}
      >
        <AntdApp>
          <RefineKbarProvider>
            <Refine
              dataProvider={dataProviderConfig}
              liveProvider={liveProviderConfig}
              routerProvider={routerProvider}
              notificationProvider={useNotificationProvider}
              authProvider={authProvider}
              options={{
                syncWithLocation: true,
                warnWhenUnsavedChanges: true,
                projectId: "admin-stock",
                title: { text: "Admin Stock" },
              }}
              resources={[
                {
                  name: "dashboard",
                  list: "/dashboard",
                  meta: {
                    label: "Dashboard",
                    icon: <DashboardOutlined />,
                  },
                },
                {
                  // ✅ Menu Tambah Barang + tepat di bawah Dashboard
                  name: "products-create",
                  list: "/products/create",
                  meta: {
                    label: "Tambah Barang +",
                    icon: <AppstoreAddOutlined />,
                  },
                },
                {
                  name: "inventory",
                  list: "/inventory",
                  meta: {
                    label: "Data Persediaan",
                    icon: <AppstoreOutlined />,
                  },
                },
              ]}
            >
              <Routes>
                {/* Router yang dilindungi oleh AdminLayout */}
                <Route
                  element={
                    <AdminLayout>
                      <Outlet />
                    </AdminLayout>
                  }
                >
                  <Route
                    index
                    element={<NavigateToResource resource="dashboard" />}
                  />
                  <Route path="/dashboard" element={<DashboardPage />} />
                  <Route
                    path="/products/create"
                    element={<ProductCreatePage />}
                  />
                  <Route path="/inventory" element={<InventoryPage />} />
                  <Route path="/entry" element={<EntryPage />} />
                </Route>

                <Route path="/login" element={<LoginPage />} />
                <Route path="*" element={<ErrorComponent />} />
              </Routes>

              <UnsavedChangesNotifier />
              <DocumentTitleHandler />
            </Refine>
          </RefineKbarProvider>
        </AntdApp>
      </ConfigProvider>
    </BrowserRouter>
  );
}

export default App;

import type {
  AuthProvider,
  AuthActionResponse,
  CheckResponse,
} from "@refinedev/core";
import { supabaseClient } from "./utility/supabaseClient";
import { USE_MOCK } from "./utility/config";

const MOCK_USER = {
  email: "admin@admin.com",
  password: "admin123",
  name: "Administrator",
};

const STORAGE_KEY = "mock-auth-user";

const getMockUser = () => {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};

export const authProvider: AuthProvider = {
  login: async ({ email, password }): Promise<AuthActionResponse> => {
    if (USE_MOCK) {
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400));
      if (email === MOCK_USER.email && password === MOCK_USER.password) {
        localStorage.setItem(
          STORAGE_KEY,
          JSON.stringify({ email, name: MOCK_USER.name, role: "admin" }),
        );
        return { success: true, redirectTo: "/dashboard" };
      }
      return {
        success: false,
        error: {
          name: "LoginError",
          message: "Email atau password salah",
        },
      };
    }

    const { data, error } = await supabaseClient.auth.signInWithPassword({
      email,
      password,
    });

    if (error) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: { name: "LoginError", message: error.message },
      };
    }
    if (!data?.user) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: { name: "LoginError", message: "User tidak ditemukan" },
      };
    }
    return { success: true, redirectTo: "/dashboard" };
  },

  logout: async (): Promise<AuthActionResponse> => {
    if (USE_MOCK) {
      localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      return { success: true, redirectTo: "/dashboard" };
    }
    await supabaseClient.auth.signOut();
    return { success: true, redirectTo: "/dashboard" };
  },

  // ✅ Selalu izinkan akses agar User (Public) bisa melihat stok tanpa harus login
  check: async (): Promise<CheckResponse> => {
    return { authenticated: true };
  },

  getIdentity: async () => {
    if (USE_MOCK) {
      const user = getMockUser();
      if (user) {
        return {
          id: "admin-1",
          name: user.name,
          email: user.email,
          role: "admin",
        };
      }
      return {
        id: "public-user",
        name: "User (Public)",
        email: "",
        role: "user",
      };
    }

    const { data } = await supabaseClient.auth.getUser();
    if (data?.user) {
      return {
        id: data.user.id,
        name: data.user.email?.split("@")[0] ?? "Admin",
        email: data.user.email,
        role: "admin",
      };
    }

    return {
      id: "public-user",
      name: "User (Public)",
      email: "",
      role: "user",
    };
  },

  getPermissions: async () => {
    if (USE_MOCK) {
      const user = getMockUser();
      return user ? ["admin"] : ["user"];
    }
    const { data } = await supabaseClient.auth.getSession();
    return data.session ? ["admin"] : ["user"];
  },

  onError: async (error) => {
    return { error };
  },
};

import { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { Input, Modal, Spin, Empty, Tag, Typography } from "antd";
import { SearchOutlined } from "@ant-design/icons";
import { useKeyboardShortcut } from "../../hooks/useKeyboardShortcut";
import { useProductSearch } from "../../hooks/useProductSearch";
import type { Product } from "../../types";

const { Text } = Typography;

export const GlobalSearch = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [keyword, setKeyword] = useState("");
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(0);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const { products, isLoading } = useProductSearch(keyword);

  // Reset state saat modal terbuka
  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setKeyword("");
      setActiveIndex(0);
      setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 50);
    }
  }, [open]);

  // Clamp active index saat hasil berubah
  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeIndex >= products.length) setActiveIndex(0);
  }, [products.length, activeIndex]);

  const handleSelect = useCallback(
    (product: Product) => {
      setOpen(false);
      navigate(`/stock-entries/create?productId=${product.id}`);
    },
    [navigate],
  );

  // ⌨️ Space → buka palette (kecuali sedang mengetik di input)
  useKeyboardShortcut({
    key: " ",
    ignoreInputs: true,
    enabled: !open,
    handler: () => setOpen(true),
  });

  // ⌨️ Ctrl+K → buka palette juga (opsional, umum dipakai)
  useKeyboardShortcut({
    key: "k",
    ctrlKey: true,
    enabled: !open,
    handler: () => setOpen(true),
  });

  const handleKeyDown = (event: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (event.key === "ArrowDown") {
      event.preventDefault();
      setActiveIndex((i) => Math.min(i + 1, products.length - 1));
    } else if (event.key === "ArrowUp") {
      event.preventDefault();
      setActiveIndex((i) => Math.max(i - 1, 0));
    } else if (event.key === "Enter") {
      event.preventDefault();
      const selected = products[activeIndex];
      if (selected) handleSelect(selected);
    } else if (event.key === "Escape") {
      event.preventDefault();
      setOpen(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onCancel={() => setOpen(false)}
      footer={null}
      closable={false}
      width={560}
      destroyOnClose
      styles={{ body: { padding: 0 } }}
      style={{ top: 80 }}
    >
      <div style={{ padding: 12, borderBottom: "1px solid #f0f0f0" }}>
        <Input
          ref={inputRef as never}
          size="large"
          prefix={<SearchOutlined />}
          placeholder="Cari produk berdasarkan nama atau kode..."
          value={keyword}
          onChange={(e) => setKeyword(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
          variant="borderless"
          autoFocus
        />
      </div>

      <div style={{ maxHeight: 360, overflowY: "auto", padding: 8 }}>
        {isLoading && (
          <div style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: 24 }}>
            <Spin />
          </div>
        )}

        {!isLoading && products.length === 0 && (
          <Empty
            description="Produk tidak ditemukan"
            image={Empty.PRESENTED_IMAGE_SIMPLE}
            style={{ padding: 24 }}
          />
        )}

        {!isLoading &&
          products.map((product, index) => (
            <div
              key={product.id}
              onMouseEnter={() => setActiveIndex(index)}
              onClick={() => handleSelect(product)}
              style={{
                padding: "10px 12px",
                borderRadius: 8,
                cursor: "pointer",
                display: "flex",
                alignItems: "center",
                justifyContent: "space-between",
                gap: 12,
                background:
                  index === activeIndex ? "#e6f4ff" : "transparent",
              }}
            >
              <div style={{ minWidth: 0, flex: 1 }}>
                <div style={{ fontWeight: 500, fontSize: 14 }}>
                  {product.name}
                </div>
                <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                  {product.code} · Stok: {product.stock} {product.unit}
                </Text>
              </div>
              <Tag color="blue" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
                Input
              </Tag>
            </div>
          ))}
      </div>

      <div
        style={{
          padding: "8px 16px",
          borderTop: "1px solid #f0f0f0",
          display: "flex",
          gap: 16,
          fontSize: 12,
          color: "#8c8c8c",
        }}
      >
        <span>↑↓ navigasi</span>
        <span>↵ pilih</span>
        <span>esc tutup</span>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
};

import { Card, Empty, Space, Tag, Typography, Skeleton } from "antd";
import { UserOutlined, SendOutlined } from "@ant-design/icons";
import { formatNumber } from "../../utility/format";
import type { StockExit } from "../../types";

const { Text } = Typography;

interface Props {
  exits: StockExit[];
  loading?: boolean;
}

export const StockExitList = ({ exits, loading }: Props) => {
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Card
        title="📤 Barang Keluar Hari Ini"
        variant="borderless"
        style={{ borderRadius: 12 }}
      >
        <Skeleton active paragraph={{ rows: 6 }} />
      </Card>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Card
      title="📤 Barang Keluar Hari Ini"
      variant="borderless"
      style={{ borderRadius: 12, height: "100%" }}
      styles={{
        body: {
          padding: exits.length ? 12 : 24,
          maxHeight: 600,
          overflowY: "auto",
        },
      }}
    >
      {exits.length === 0 ? (
        <Empty
          description="Belum ada barang keluar hari ini"
          image={Empty.PRESENTED_IMAGE_SIMPLE}
        />
      ) : (
        <Space direction="vertical" size={8} style={{ width: "100%" }}>
          {exits.map((exit) => (
            <Card
              key={exit.id}
              size="small"
              style={{
                borderRadius: 8,
                background: "#fafafa",
                border: "1px solid #f0f0f0",
              }}
              styles={{ body: { padding: 10 } }}
            >
              {/* Header: jam + nama pekerja */}

                style={{

                  justifyContent: "space-between",
                  alignItems: "center",

                }}
              >
                <Text strong style={{ fontSize: 14, color: "#1677ff" }}>
                  {exit.time}
                </Text>
                <Tag color="blue" style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 11 }}>
                  <UserOutlined /> {exit.person}
                </Tag>
              </div>

              {/* Tujuan */}
              {exit.destination && (
                <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#666", marginBottom: 6 }}>
                  <SendOutlined /> {exit.destination}
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Items */}
              <div style={{ borderTop: "1px dashed #e0e0e0", paddingTop: 6 }}>
                {exit.items.map((item, idx) => (
                  <div
                    key={idx}
                    style={{
                      display: "flex",
                      justifyContent: "space-between",
                      fontSize: 12,
                      padding: "2px 0",
                      gap: 8,
                    }}
                  >
                    <Text style={{ fontSize: 12 }} ellipsis>
                      • {item.itemName}
                      {item.size && (
                        <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
                          {" "}
                          ({item.size})
                        </Text>
                      )}
                    </Text>
                    <Text
                      strong
                      style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#ff4d4f", flexShrink: 0 }}
                    >
                      {formatNumber(item.quantity)} {item.unit}
                    </Text>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </Space>
      )}
    </Card>
  );
};

import { Card, Empty, Skeleton } from "antd";
import { Line } from "@ant-design/plots";
import { useStockInChart } from "../../hooks/useStockInChart";
import { formatDate } from "../../utility/format";

export const StockInChart = () => {
  const { items, isLoading } = useStockInChart(30);

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <Card
        title="📈 Barang Masuk 30 Hari Terakhir"
        style={{ borderRadius: 12 }}
      >
        <Skeleton active paragraph={{ rows: 6 }} />
      </Card>
    );
  }

  if (!items.length) {
    return (
      <Card
        title="📈 Barang Masuk 30 Hari Terakhir"
        style={{ borderRadius: 12 }}
      >
        <Empty description="Belum ada transaksi 30 hari terakhir" />
      </Card>
    );
  }

  const data = items.map((i) => ({
    date: formatDate(i.date),
    total: i.total,
  }));

  return (
    <Card
      title="📈 Barang Masuk 30 Hari Terakhir"
      style={{ borderRadius: 12 }}
    >
      <Line
        data={data}
        xField="date"
        yField="total"
        height={300}
        smooth
        point={{ size: 4, shape: "circle" }}
        color="#1677ff"
        tooltip={{ showMarkers: false }}
        xAxis={{ label: { autoRotate: false, autoHide: true } }}
        yAxis={{
          label: {
            formatter: (v: string) => Number(v).toLocaleString("id-ID"),
          },
        }}
      />
    </Card>
  );
};

================================================================================
FILE   : EntryBoard.tsx
PATH   : src/components/entry/EntryBoard.tsx
FOLDER : src/components/entry
================================================================================
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  AutoComplete,
  Button,
  Card,
  Empty,
  Input,
  InputNumber,
  List,
  Space,
  Tag,
  Typography,
} from "antd";
import {
  CheckCircleOutlined,
  CloseCircleOutlined,
  EnvironmentOutlined,
  SearchOutlined,
  TeamOutlined,
  UserOutlined,
} from "@ant-design/icons";
import { useProductSearch } from "../../hooks/useProductSearch";
import { formatNumber } from "../../utility/format";
import type { Person, Team, Workplace, EntryLine } from "../../types/entry";
import type { Product } from "../../types";

const { Title, Text } = Typography;

interface Props {
  team: Team;
  person: Person;
  workplace: Workplace;
  phase: "search" | "quantity";
  activeItem: Product | null;
  activeQty: number;
  lines: EntryLine[];
  onSelectItem: (item: Product) => void;
  onConfirmQuantity: () => void;
  onCancelQuantity: () => void;
  onIncreaseQty: () => void;
  onDecreaseQty: () => void;
  onRemoveLine: (itemId: number) => void;
  onFinish: () => void;
}

export const EntryBoard = ({
  team,
  person,
  workplace,
  phase,
  activeItem,
  activeQty,
  lines,
  onSelectItem,
  onConfirmQuantity,
  onCancelQuantity,
  onIncreaseQty,
  onDecreaseQty,
  onRemoveLine,
  onFinish,
}: Props) => {
  // ==========================================
  // Local state
  // ==========================================
  const [keyword, setKeyword] = useState("");
  const [highlightedIdx, setHighlightedIdx] = useState(0);
  const searchRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const qtyRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const { products } = useProductSearch(keyword, 8);

  // ==========================================
  // Auto-focus sesuai phase
  // ==========================================
  useEffect(() => {
    if (phase === "search") {
      setTimeout(() => searchRef.current?.focus(), 100);
    } else if (phase === "quantity") {
      setTimeout(() => qtyRef.current?.focus(), 100);
    }
  }, [phase]);

  // ==========================================
  // Reset highlight saat keyword berubah
  // ==========================================
  useEffect(() => {
    setHighlightedIdx(0);
  }, [keyword]);

  // ==========================================
  // Ctrl+Enter → selesai
  // ==========================================
  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.ctrlKey && e.key === "Enter") {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (lines.length > 0) onFinish();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", handler);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handler);
  }, [lines.length, onFinish]);

  // ==========================================
  // Handlers — search phase
  // ==========================================
  const commitItem = () => {
    if (products.length === 0) return;
    const chosen = products[highlightedIdx] ?? products[0];
    onSelectItem(chosen);
    setKeyword("");
  };

  const handleSearchKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
      e.preventDefault();
      setHighlightedIdx((i) => Math.min(i + 1, products.length - 1));
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
      e.preventDefault();
      setHighlightedIdx((i) => Math.max(i - 1, 0));
    } else if (e.key === "Enter") {
      e.preventDefault();
      commitItem();
    }
  };

  // ==========================================
  // Handlers — quantity phase
  // ==========================================
  const handleQtyKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === "Enter") {
      e.preventDefault();
      onConfirmQuantity();
    } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
      e.preventDefault();
      onCancelQuantity();
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
      e.preventDefault();
      onIncreaseQty();
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
      e.preventDefault();
      onDecreaseQty();
    }
  };

  // ==========================================
  // Derived
  // ==========================================
  const totalItems = lines.reduce((sum, l) => sum + l.quantity, 0);

  return (
    <div style={{ maxWidth: 900, margin: "0 auto" }}>
      {/* ====================================== */}
      {/* Header card — workplace + team + person */}
      {/* ====================================== */}
      <Card variant="borderless" style={{ borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 16 }}>
        <Space direction="vertical" size={4} style={{ width: "100%" }}>
          <Space size={8}>
            <EnvironmentOutlined style={{ color: "#1677ff", fontSize: 20 }} />
            <Title level={3} style={{ margin: 0 }}>
              {workplace.name}
            </Title>
          </Space>
          <Space size={12} wrap>
            <Text type="secondary">
              <EnvironmentOutlined /> {workplace.name}
            </Text>
            <Text type="secondary">
              <TeamOutlined /> {team.name}
            </Text>
            <Text type="secondary">
              <UserOutlined /> {person.name}
            </Text>
          </Space>
        </Space>
      </Card>

      {/* ====================================== */}
      {/* Input card — search atau quantity       */}
      {/* ====================================== */}
      <Card
        variant="borderless"
        style={{ borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 16 }}
        styles={{ body: { padding: 24 } }}
      >
        {phase === "search" && (
          <>
            <Text strong style={{ fontSize: 14 }}>
              Nama Barang
            </Text>
            <AutoComplete
              value={keyword}
              onChange={setKeyword}
              options={products.map((p, idx) => ({
                value: p.name,
                label: (
                  <div
                    style={{
                      display: "flex",
                      justifyContent: "space-between",
                      padding: "2px 0",
                      background:
                        idx === highlightedIdx ? "#e6f4ff" : "transparent",
                    }}
                  >
                    <span>
                      {p.name}{" "}
                      <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                        · {p.code}
                      </Text>
                    </span>
                    <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                      stok: {p.stock} {p.unit}
                    </Text>
                  </div>
                ),
                data: p,
              }))}
              onSelect={(_, opt) => {
                onSelectItem((opt as { data: Product }).data);
                setKeyword("");
              }}
              style={{ width: "100%", marginTop: 8 }}
            >
              <Input
                ref={searchRef as never}
                size="large"
                prefix={<SearchOutlined />}
                placeholder="Ketik nama barang, lalu Enter..."
                onKeyDown={handleSearchKeyDown}
                autoFocus
              />
            </AutoComplete>

            <Space style={{ marginTop: 12 }} size="small" wrap>
              <Tag>↑↓</Tag>
              <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                navigasi
              </Text>
              <Tag>Enter</Tag>
              <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                pilih & lanjut ke jumlah
              </Text>
              <Tag>Ctrl+Enter</Tag>
              <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                selesai
              </Text>
            </Space>
          </>
        )}

        {phase === "quantity" && activeItem && (
          <>
            <Space
              style={{
                marginBottom: 12,
                width: "100%",
                justifyContent: "space-between",
              }}
            >
              <Text strong style={{ fontSize: 14 }}>
                Jumlah — {activeItem.name}
              </Text>
              <Tag color="blue">
                Stok: {activeItem.stock} {activeItem.unit}
              </Tag>
            </Space>

            <Space.Compact style={{ width: "100%" }}>
              <Button
                size="large"
                onClick={onDecreaseQty}
                style={{ width: 60, height: 48, fontSize: 20 }}
              >
                −
              </Button>

              <InputNumber
                ref={qtyRef as never}
                value={activeQty}
                size="large"
                min={1}
                max={activeItem.stock}
                controls={false}
                onKeyDown={handleQtyKeyDown}
                readOnly
                style={{
                  flex: 1,
                  textAlign: "center",
                  fontSize: 20,
                  fontWeight: 600,
                }}
              />

              <Button
                size="large"
                onClick={onIncreaseQty}
                style={{ width: 60, height: 48, fontSize: 20 }}
              >
                +
              </Button>
            </Space.Compact>

            <div style={{ marginTop: 8, textAlign: "right" }}>
              <Text type="secondary">
                {activeQty} {activeItem.unit}
              </Text>
            </div>

            <Space style={{ marginTop: 12 }} size="small" wrap>
              <Tag>↑↓ / + −</Tag>
              <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                ubah jumlah
              </Text>
              <Tag>Enter</Tag>
              <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                tambah & lanjut
              </Text>
              <Tag>Esc</Tag>
              <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                batal
              </Text>
            </Space>
          </>
        )}
      </Card>

      {/* ====================================== */}
      {/* Lines list — barang yang sudah di-input */}
      {/* ====================================== */}
      <Card
        title={`Daftar Barang (${lines.length} jenis · ${formatNumber(totalItems)} total)`}
        variant="borderless"
        style={{ borderRadius: 12 }}
        extra={
          <Button
            type="primary"
            icon={<CheckCircleOutlined />}
            disabled={lines.length === 0}
            onClick={onFinish}
          >
            Selesai (Ctrl+Enter)
          </Button>
        }
      >
        {lines.length === 0 ? (
          <Empty
            description="Belum ada barang ditambahkan"
            image={Empty.PRESENTED_IMAGE_SIMPLE}
          />
        ) : (
          <List
            size="small"
            dataSource={lines}
            renderItem={(line) => (
              <List.Item
                actions={[
                  <Button
                    key="del"
                    type="text"
                    danger
                    size="small"
                    icon={<CloseCircleOutlined />}
                    onClick={() => onRemoveLine(line.itemId)}
                  />,
                ]}
              >
                <List.Item.Meta
                  title={line.itemName}
                  description={`${formatNumber(line.quantity)} ${line.unit}`}
                />
              </List.Item>
            )}
          />
        )}
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
};



================================================================================
FILE   : SetupWizard.tsx

================================================================================
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  AutoComplete,
  Button,
  Card,
  Input,
  Modal,
  Space,
  Steps,
  Tag,
  Typography,
} from "antd";
import { SearchOutlined, UserOutlined, EnvironmentOutlined } from "@ant-design/icons";
import type { Person, Workplace } from "../../types/entry";

const { Title, Text } = Typography;

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  step: "person" | "workplace";
  title: string;
  placeholder: string;
  options: readonly (Person | Workplace)[];
  onSelect: (value: Person | Workplace) => void;
  onBack?: () => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

const STEP_INDEX: Record<"person" | "workplace", number> = {
  person: 0,
  workplace: 1,
};

export const SetupWizard = ({
  open,
  step,
  title,
  placeholder,
  options,
  onSelect,
  onBack,
  onClose,
}: Props) => {
  const [keyword, setKeyword] = useState("");
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setKeyword("");
      setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 100);
    }
  }, [open, step]);

  const filtered = options.filter((o) =>
    o.name.toLowerCase().includes(keyword.trim().toLowerCase()),
  );

  const handleEnter = () => {
    if (filtered.length > 0) {
      onSelect(filtered[0]);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onCancel={onClose}
      footer={null}
      closable
      maskClosable
      keyboard
      width={520}
      styles={{ body: { padding: 0 } }}
      style={{ top: 80 }}
    >
      <Card
        variant="borderless"
        style={{ borderRadius: 16 }}
        styles={{ body: { padding: 24 } }}
      >
        <Steps
          current={STEP_INDEX[step]}
          size="small"
          items={[
            { title: "Nama Pekerja", icon: <UserOutlined /> },
            { title: "Lokasi Pekerjaan", icon: <EnvironmentOutlined /> },
          ]}
          style={{ marginBottom: 20 }}
        />

        <Title level={4} style={{ marginBottom: 4 }}>
          {title}
        </Title>

        <div style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
          <AutoComplete
            value={keyword}
            onChange={setKeyword}
            options={filtered.map((o) => ({
              value: o.name,
              label: o.name,
              data: o,
            }))}
            onSelect={(_, option) => {
              const data = (option as { data: Person | Workplace }).data;
              onSelect(data);
            }}
            style={{ width: "100%" }}
            placeholder={placeholder}
          >
            <Input
              ref={inputRef as never}
              size="large"
              prefix={<SearchOutlined />}
              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                if (e.key === "Enter") {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  handleEnter();
                } else if (e.key === "Escape" && onBack) {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  onBack();
                }
              }}
              autoFocus
            />
          </AutoComplete>
        </div>

        {/* Tombol Pilihan Cepat (Sangat memudahkan di Mobile & Desktop) */}
        <div style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
          <Space size={[8, 8]} wrap>
            {filtered.map((item) => (
              <Button
                key={item.id}
                size="middle"
                style={{ borderRadius: 8, fontWeight: 500 }}
                onClick={() => onSelect(item)}
              >
                {item.name}
              </Button>
            ))}
          </Space>
        </div>

        <Space style={{ marginTop: 20 }} size="small" wrap>
          <Tag>Enter</Tag>
          <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
            pilih item pertama
          </Text>
          {onBack && (
            <>
              <Tag style={{ cursor: "pointer" }} onClick={onBack}>
                Esc / Kembali
              </Tag>
              <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                kembali ke pilih nama
              </Text>
            </>
          )}
        </Space>
      </Card>
    </Modal>
  );
};

import { useState } from "react";
import { Table, Typography, Tag, Space, Card, Input } from "antd";
import { formatNumber } from "../../utility/format";
import { SendOutlined, UserOutlined, SearchOutlined } from "@ant-design/icons";
import type { Product, StockExit } from "../../types";

const { Text } = Typography;

type TableType = "stock" | "outbound";

interface BaseProps {
  type: TableType;
  loading?: boolean;
}

interface StockProps extends BaseProps {
  type: "stock";
  dataSource: Product[];
}

interface OutboundProps extends BaseProps {
  type: "outbound";
  dataSource: StockExit[];
}

type InventoryTableProps = StockProps | OutboundProps;

export const InventoryTable = (props: InventoryTableProps) => {
  const { type, loading } = props;
  const [searchText, setSearchText] = useState("");

  const stockColumns = [
    { dataIndex: "name", title: "Nama Item" },
    {
      dataIndex: "size",
      title: "Ukuran",
      width: 250,
      render: (v: string | null) => v ?? "-",
    },
    {
      dataIndex: "stock",
      title: "Stok Tersedia",
      width: 180,
      align: "right" as const,
      defaultSortOrder: "descend" as const, // ✅ Default Sort Tertinggi
      sorter: (a: Product, b: Product) => a.stock - b.stock,
      render: (v: number, r: Product) => (
        <Text strong style={{ fontSize: 14 }}>
          {formatNumber(v)}{" "}
          <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 400 }}>
            {r.unit}
          </Text>
        </Text>
      ),
    },
  ];

  const outboundColumns = [
    {
      title: "Waktu",
      dataIndex: "time",
      width: 100,
      render: (v: string) => <Text strong style={{ color: "#1677ff" }}>{v}</Text>,
    },
    {
      title: "Nama Item",
      dataIndex: "itemName",
      ellipsis: true,
      render: (v: string, r: any) => (
        <>
          <Text>{v}</Text>
          {r.size && <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12, marginLeft: 6 }}>({r.size})</Text>}
        </>
      ),
    },
    {
      title: "Jumlah Keluar",
      dataIndex: "quantity",
      width: 140,
      align: "right" as const,
      render: (v: number, r: any) => (
        <Text strong style={{ color: "#ff4d4f" }}>
          {formatNumber(v)} <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>{r.unit}</Text>
        </Text>
      ),
    },
    {
      title: "Lokasi Pekerjaan",
      dataIndex: "destination",
      width: 200,
      render: (v: string | null) =>
        v ? <Tag icon={<SendOutlined />} color="blue">{v}</Tag> : <Text type="secondary">-</Text>,
    },
    {
      title: "Pengambil (PIC)",
      dataIndex: "person",
      width: 180,
      render: (v: string) => (
        <Text style={{ fontSize: 13 }}><UserOutlined /> {v}</Text>
      ),
    },
  ];

  let tableData: any[] = [];
  if (type === "stock") {
    tableData = (props as StockProps).dataSource;
    // Filter Pencarian Lokal
    if (searchText) {
       tableData = tableData.filter(item => 
          item.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchText.toLowerCase()) || 
          (item.size && item.size.toLowerCase().includes(searchText.toLowerCase()))
       );
    }
  } else if (type === "outbound") {
    tableData = (props as OutboundProps).dataSource.flatMap((exit) =>
      exit.items.map((item) => ({
        ...item,
        transactionId: exit.id,
        time: exit.time,
        person: exit.person,
        destination: exit.destination,
      })),
    );
    // Filter Pencarian Lokal Outbound
    if (searchText) {
       tableData = tableData.filter(item => 
          item.itemName.toLowerCase().includes(searchText.toLowerCase()) || 
          (item.size && item.size.toLowerCase().includes(searchText.toLowerCase())) ||
          item.person.toLowerCase().includes(searchText.toLowerCase())
       );
    }
  }

  return (
    <Card
      variant="borderless"
      style={{ borderRadius: 12, border: "1px solid #f0f0f0" }}
      styles={{ body: { padding: 0 } }}
    >
      {/* Search Bar di Atas Tabel */}
      <div style={{ padding: "16px 20px", borderBottom: "1px solid #f0f0f0", background: "#fafafa", borderRadius: "12px 12px 0 0" }}>
         <Input 
            placeholder="Cari berdasarkan nama, ukuran, atau pengambil..." 
            prefix={<SearchOutlined style={{ color: "#bfbfbf" }} />}
            allowClear
            size="large"
            value={searchText}
            onChange={e => setSearchText(e.target.value)}
            style={{ maxWidth: 400 }}
         />
      </div>

      <Table
        dataSource={tableData}
        rowKey={(record: any) =>
          type === "stock"
            ? record.id
            : `${record.transactionId}-${record.itemId}`
        }
        loading={loading}
        pagination={{ pageSize: 20, size: "small", showSizeChanger: true }}
        size="middle"
        scroll={{ x: 800 }}
        columns={type === "stock" ? stockColumns : outboundColumns}
      />
    </Card>
  );
};

import { useState } from "react";
import { ThemedLayoutV2, ThemedSiderV2 } from "@refinedev/antd";
import { useGetIdentity, useLogout } from "@refinedev/core";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { Button, Tag, Typography } from "antd";
import {
  LogoutOutlined,
  LoginOutlined,
  DownOutlined,
  UpOutlined,
  SafetyCertificateOutlined,
  UserOutlined,
} from "@ant-design/icons";
import type { PropsWithChildren } from "react";

const { Text } = Typography;

interface IdentityUser {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  email?: string;
  role: "admin" | "user";
}

const CustomLogoWithDropdown = ({ collapsed }: { collapsed?: boolean }) => {
  const [openMenu, setOpenMenu] = useState(false);
  const { data: identity } = useGetIdentity<IdentityUser>();
  const { mutate: logout } = useLogout();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const isAdmin = identity?.role === "admin";

  return (
    <div style={{ width: "100%", userSelect: "none" }}>
      {/* Area Logo yang bisa diklik */}
      <div
        onClick={() => setOpenMenu((prev) => !prev)}
        style={{
          display: "flex",
          alignItems: "center",
          justifyContent: collapsed ? "center" : "space-between",
          gap: 10,
          cursor: "pointer",
          padding: "4px 6px",
          borderRadius: 8,
          transition: "background 0.2s",
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 10 }}>
          <div
            style={{
              width: 32,
              height: 32,
              borderRadius: 8,
              background: isAdmin
                ? "linear-gradient(135deg, #1677ff, #0e4fb8)"
                : "linear-gradient(135deg, #52c41a, #389e0d)",
              color: "#fff",
              display: "flex",
              alignItems: "center",
              justifyContent: "center",
              fontWeight: 700,
              fontSize: 14,
              flexShrink: 0,
            }}
          >
            {isAdmin ? "AS" : "US"}
          </div>
          {!collapsed && (
            <div style={{ lineHeight: 1.2 }}>
              <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 15, color: "#1f1f1f" }}>
                Admin Stock
              </div>
              <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
                {isAdmin ? "Mode Admin" : "User (Public)"}
              </Text>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        {!collapsed && (
          <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "#8c8c8c" }}>
            {openMenu ? <UpOutlined /> : <DownOutlined />}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Section kecil di bawah logo yang muncul saat logo diklik */}
      {openMenu && !collapsed && (
        <div
          style={{
            marginTop: 8,
            padding: "10px 12px",
            background: "#f5f7fa",
            borderRadius: 10,
            border: "1px solid #e6ebf1",
          }}
        >
          <div
            style={{
              display: "flex",
              alignItems: "center",
              justifyContent: "space-between",
              marginBottom: 8,
            }}
          >
            <Text style={{ fontSize: 12 }} strong ellipsis>
              {identity?.name ?? "User"}
            </Text>
            <Tag
              color={isAdmin ? "blue" : "green"}
              icon={
                isAdmin ? <SafetyCertificateOutlined /> : <UserOutlined />
              }
              style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 11 }}
            >
              {isAdmin ? "Admin" : "Public"}
            </Tag>
          </div>

          {isAdmin ? (

              danger

              size="small"
              block

            <Button

                setOpenMenu(false);

              }}

            </Button>
          )}

      )}
    </div>
  );

import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { supabaseClient } from "../utility/supabaseClient";
import { TABLES } from "../utility/constants";
import { USE_MOCK } from "../utility/config";
import { getMockDashboardStats } from "../mocks/dashboard";
import type { DashboardStats } from "../types";

// ============================================
// Tipe return eksplisit
// ============================================
export interface UseDashboardStatsResult {
  stats: DashboardStats;
  isLoading: boolean;
  refetch: () => void;
}

const EMPTY_STATS: DashboardStats = {
  totalProducts: 0,
  totalStock: 0,
  todayInbound: 0,
  todayOutbound: 0,
};

export const useDashboardStats = (): UseDashboardStatsResult => {
  const query = useQuery<DashboardStats, Error, DashboardStats>({
    queryKey: ["dashboard-stats"],
    refetchInterval: USE_MOCK ? false : 60_000,
    queryFn: async (): Promise<DashboardStats> => {
      // === MODE MOCK ===
      if (USE_MOCK) {
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300));
        return getMockDashboardStats();
      }

      // === MODE SUPABASE ===
      const today = new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];

      const [productsRes, inboundRes, outboundRes] = await Promise.all([
        supabaseClient.from(TABLES.products).select("stok"),
        supabaseClient
          .from(TABLES.stockEntries)
          .select("jumlah")
          .eq("tanggal", today),
        supabaseClient
          .from(TABLES.stockExits)
          .select("items")
          .eq("date", today),
      ]);

      if (productsRes.error) throw productsRes.error;
      if (inboundRes.error) throw inboundRes.error;
      if (outboundRes.error) throw outboundRes.error;

      const totalProducts = productsRes.data?.length ?? 0;
      const totalStock =
        productsRes.data?.reduce(
          (sum, p: { stok: number | null }) => sum + (p.stok ?? 0),
          0,
        ) ?? 0;
      const todayInbound =
        inboundRes.data?.reduce(
          (sum, e: { jumlah: number | null }) => sum + (e.jumlah ?? 0),
          0,
        ) ?? 0;

      // Hitung total quantity dari items[] di stock exits
      const todayOutbound =
        outboundRes.data?.reduce(
          (sum, exit: { items: Array<{ quantity: number }> }) =>
            sum + (exit.items?.reduce((s, i) => s + (i.quantity ?? 0), 0) ?? 0),
          0,
        ) ?? 0;

      return { totalProducts, totalStock, todayInbound, todayOutbound };
    },
  });

  return {
    stats: query.data ?? EMPTY_STATS,
    isLoading: query.isLoading,
    refetch: query.refetch,
  };
};

FILE   : useEntryFlow.ts

import { useCallback, useState } from "react";
import { mockWorkplaces } from "../mocks/entry";
import { usePersons } from "./usePersons";
import type { EntryLine, Person, SetupStep, Workplace } from "../types/entry";
import type { Product } from "../types";

export type EntryPhase = "search" | "quantity";

export const useEntryFlow = () => {
  const [step, setStep] = useState<SetupStep>("person");
  const [person, setPerson] = useState<Person | null>(null);
  const [workplace, setWorkplace] = useState<Workplace | null>(null);
  const [wizardOpen, setWizardOpen] = useState(false);

  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<EntryPhase>("search");
  const [activeItem, setActiveItem] = useState<Product | null>(null);
  const [activeQty, setActiveQty] = useState(1);
  const [lines, setLines] = useState<EntryLine[]>([]);

  // ✅ Ambil data pekerja langsung dari Database
  const { persons } = usePersons();

  const wizardData = {
    person: {
      value: person,
      options: persons, // Pakai data dari DB
      placeholder: "Ketik atau pilih nama pekerja...",
      title: "Pilih Nama Pekerja",
    },
    workplace: {
      value: workplace,
      options: mockWorkplaces, // Tetap pakai hardcode lokal
      placeholder: "Ketik atau pilih lokasi pekerjaan...",
      title: "Pilih Lokasi Pekerjaan",
    },
  } as const;

  const currentWizardData =
    step === "done"
      ? { value: null, title: "", placeholder: "", options: [] }
      : wizardData[step as "person" | "workplace"];

  const openWizard = useCallback(() => {
    setStep("person");
    setWizardOpen(true);
  }, []);

  const closeWizard = useCallback(() => setWizardOpen(false), []);

  const selectWizardValue = useCallback(
    (value: Person | Workplace) => {
      if (step === "person") {
        setPerson(value as Person);
        setWorkplace(null);
        setStep("workplace");
      } else if (step === "workplace") {
        setWorkplace(value as Workplace);
        setStep("done");
        setWizardOpen(false);
      }
    },
    [step],
  );

  const resetSession = useCallback(() => {
    setStep("person");
    setPerson(null);
    setWorkplace(null);
    setPhase("search");
    setActiveItem(null);
    setActiveQty(1);
    setLines([]);
    setWizardOpen(false);
  }, []);

  const backWizard = useCallback(() => {
    if (step === "workplace") {
      setWorkplace(null);
      setStep("person");
    }
  }, [step]);

  const selectItem = useCallback((item: Product) => {
    setActiveItem(item);
    setActiveQty(1);
    setPhase("quantity");
  }, []);

  const confirmQuantity = useCallback(() => {
    if (!activeItem) return;
    setLines((prev) => {
      const idx = prev.findIndex((l) => l.itemId === activeItem.id);
      if (idx >= 0) {
        const copy = [...prev];
        copy[idx] = { ...copy[idx], quantity: copy[idx].quantity + activeQty };
        return copy;
      }
      return [
        ...prev,
        {
          itemId: activeItem.id,
          itemName: activeItem.name,
          unit: activeItem.unit,
          quantity: activeQty,
        },
      ];
    });
    setActiveItem(null);
    setActiveQty(1);
    setPhase("search");
  }, [activeItem, activeQty]);

  const cancelQuantity = useCallback(() => {
    setActiveItem(null);
    setActiveQty(1);
    setPhase("search");
  }, []);

  const removeLine = useCallback((itemId: number) => {
    setLines((prev) => prev.filter((l) => l.itemId !== itemId));
  }, []);

  const increaseQty = useCallback(() => setActiveQty((q) => q + 1), []);
  const decreaseQty = useCallback(
    () => setActiveQty((q) => Math.max(1, q - 1)),
    [],
  );

  return {
    step,
    person,
    workplace,
    currentWizardData,
    selectWizardValue,
    backWizard,
    wizardOpen,
    openWizard,
    closeWizard,
    phase,
    activeItem,
    activeQty,
    lines,
    selectItem,
    confirmQuantity,
    cancelQuantity,
    increaseQty,
    decreaseQty,
    setActiveQty,
    removeLine,
    resetSession,
    isReady: step === "done",
  };
};

import { useEffect } from "react";

interface UseKeyboardShortcutOptions {
  key: string;
  ctrlKey?: boolean;
  shiftKey?: boolean;
  altKey?: boolean;
  metaKey?: boolean;
  enabled?: boolean;
  preventDefault?: boolean;
  ignoreInputs?: boolean;
  handler: (event: KeyboardEvent) => void;
}

const isEditableElement = (el: EventTarget | null): boolean => {
  if (!(el instanceof HTMLElement)) return false;
  const tag = el.tagName.toLowerCase();
  return (
    tag === "input" ||
    tag === "textarea" ||
    tag === "select" ||
    el.isContentEditable
  );
};

export const useKeyboardShortcut = ({
  key,
  ctrlKey = false,
  shiftKey = false,
  altKey = false,
  metaKey = false,
  enabled = true,
  preventDefault = true,
  ignoreInputs = false,
  handler,
}: UseKeyboardShortcutOptions) => {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return;

    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      // Normalisasi nama key (mengabaikan case untuk huruf 'm' dan 'M')
      const isKeyMatch = event.key.toLowerCase() === key.toLowerCase() || event.key === key;
      
      if (!isKeyMatch) return;
      if (event.ctrlKey !== ctrlKey) return;
      if (event.shiftKey !== shiftKey) return;
      if (event.altKey !== altKey) return;
      if (event.metaKey !== metaKey) return;
      if (ignoreInputs && isEditableElement(event.target)) return;

      if (preventDefault) event.preventDefault();
      handler(event);
    };

    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
  }, [
    key,
    ctrlKey,
    shiftKey,
    altKey,
    metaKey,
    enabled,
    preventDefault,
    ignoreInputs,
    handler,
  ]);
};

import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { supabaseClient } from "../utility/supabaseClient";
import { TABLES } from "../utility/constants";
import { USE_MOCK } from "../utility/config";
import { mockLowStockProducts } from "../mocks/products";
import type { Product } from "../types";

export const useLowStock = (limit = 5) => {
  const { data, isLoading, refetch } = useQuery<Product[]>({
    queryKey: ["low-stock", limit],
    queryFn: async () => {
      // === MODE MOCK ===
      if (USE_MOCK) {
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300));
        return mockLowStockProducts.slice(0, limit);
      }

      // === MODE SUPABASE ===
      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from(TABLES.vLowStock)
        .select("*")
        .order("stok", { ascending: true })
        .limit(limit);

      if (error) throw error;
      return (data ?? []) as Product[];
    },
  });

  return {
    items: data ?? [],
    total: data?.length ?? 0,
    isLoading,
    refetch,
  };
};

import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { supabaseClient } from "../utility/supabaseClient";
import { TABLES } from "../utility/constants";
import { USE_MOCK } from "../utility/config";
import type { Person } from "../types/entry";

export const usePersons = () => {
  const { data, isLoading, refetch } = useQuery<Person[]>({
    queryKey: ["persons"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (USE_MOCK) {
        return []; 
      }

      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from(TABLES.workers)
        .select("*")
        .order("nama_pekerja", { ascending: true }); // ✅ Perbaikan kolom

      if (error) throw error;
      
      return (data ?? []).map((r: any) => ({
        id: r.id.toString(),
        name: r.nama_pekerja, // ✅ Perbaikan kolom
      }));
    },
  });

  return {
    persons: data ?? [],
    isLoading,
    refetch,
  };
};


================================================================================
FILE   : useProductSearch.ts
PATH   : src/hooks/useProductSearch.ts
FOLDER : src/hooks
================================================================================
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { supabaseClient } from "../utility/supabaseClient";
import { TABLES } from "../utility/constants";
import { USE_MOCK } from "../utility/config";
import { mockProducts } from "../mocks/products";
import { mapProduct } from "../utility/mappers";
import type { Product } from "../types";

export const useProductSearch = (keyword: string, limit = 8) => {
  const trimmed = keyword.trim();

  const { data, isLoading, refetch } = useQuery<Product[]>({
    queryKey: ["product-search", trimmed, limit],
    queryFn: async () => {
      // === MOCK ===
      if (USE_MOCK) {
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 150));
        if (!trimmed) return mockProducts.slice(0, limit);
        const lower = trimmed.toLowerCase();
        return mockProducts
          .filter(
            (p) =>
              p.name.toLowerCase().includes(lower) ||
              p.code.toLowerCase().includes(lower),
          )
          .slice(0, limit);
      }

      // === SUPABASE ===
      let query = supabaseClient
        .from(TABLES.products) // "barang"
        .select("*")
        .limit(limit);

      if (trimmed) {
        query = query.or(`nama.ilike.%${trimmed}%,kode.ilike.%${trimmed}%`);
      }

      const { data, error } = await query;
      if (error) throw error;
      return (data ?? []).map(mapProduct);
    },
    staleTime: 10_000,
  });

  return {
    products: data ?? [],
    isLoading,
    refetch,
  };
};



================================================================================
FILE   : useProducts.ts
PATH   : src/hooks/useProducts.ts
FOLDER : src/hooks
================================================================================
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { supabaseClient } from "../utility/supabaseClient";
import { TABLES } from "../utility/constants";
import { USE_MOCK } from "../utility/config";
import { mockProducts } from "../mocks/products";
import { mapProduct } from "../utility/mappers";
import type { Product } from "../types";

export const useProducts = (category?: string) => {
  const { data, isLoading, refetch } = useQuery<Product[]>({
    queryKey: ["products", category ?? "all"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (USE_MOCK) {
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300));
        const filtered = category
          ? mockProducts.filter((p) => p.category === category)
          : mockProducts;
        return [...filtered].sort((a, b) => b.stock - a.stock);
      }

      let query = supabaseClient
        .from(TABLES.products)
        .select("*")
        // ✅ Urutkan berdasarkan stok terbanyak terlebih dahulu
        .order("stok", { ascending: false })
        .order("nama", { ascending: true });

      if (category) {
        query = query.eq("kategori", category);
      }

      const { data, error } = await query;
      if (error) throw error;
      return (data ?? []).map(mapProduct);
    },
  });

  return {
    products: data ?? [],
    isLoading,
    refetch,
  };
};


================================================================================
FILE   : useQuickEntry.ts
PATH   : src/hooks/useQuickEntry.ts
FOLDER : src/hooks
================================================================================
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { App } from "antd";
import dayjs from "dayjs";
import { useProductSearch } from "./useProductSearch";
import { useEntryFlow } from "./useEntryFlow";
import type { Product, StockExit, StockExitItem } from "../types";

// ============================================
// PendingLine — tambah field `size`
// ============================================
export interface PendingLine {
  itemId: number;
  itemName: string;
  size: string | null; // ← TAMBAH
  unit: string;
  quantity: number;
}

interface UseQuickEntryParams {
  onFinish?: (exit: StockExit) => void;
}

export const useQuickEntry = ({ onFinish }: UseQuickEntryParams = {}) => {
  const { message } = App.useApp();
  const flow = useEntryFlow();

  const [keyword, setKeyword] = useState("");
  const [highlightedIdx, setHighlightedIdx] = useState(0);
  const [activeItem, setActiveItem] = useState<Product | null>(null);
  const [activeQty, setActiveQty] = useState(1);
  const [pendingLines, setPendingLines] = useState<PendingLine[]>([]);

  const searchRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const qtyRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const { products: searchResults } = useProductSearch(keyword, 8);
  const phase = activeItem ? "quantity" : "search";

  // ==========================================
  // Auto-focus
  // ==========================================
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!flow.isReady) return;
    if (phase === "search") {
      setTimeout(() => searchRef.current?.focus(), 100);
    } else {
      setTimeout(() => qtyRef.current?.focus(), 100);
    }
  }, [phase, flow.isReady]);

  useEffect(() => setHighlightedIdx(0), [keyword]);

  // ==========================================
  // Ctrl+Enter → selesai
  // ==========================================
  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.ctrlKey && e.key === "Enter" && pendingLines.length > 0) {
        e.preventDefault();
        handleFinish();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", handler);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handler);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [pendingLines.length]);

  // ==========================================
  // Search handlers
  // ==========================================
  const commitItem = useCallback(() => {
    if (searchResults.length === 0) return;
    const chosen = searchResults[highlightedIdx] ?? searchResults[0];
    setActiveItem(chosen);
    setActiveQty(1);
    setKeyword("");
  }, [searchResults, highlightedIdx]);

  const handleSearchKeyDown = useCallback(
    (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
        e.preventDefault();
        setHighlightedIdx((i) => Math.min(i + 1, searchResults.length - 1));
      } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
        e.preventDefault();
        setHighlightedIdx((i) => Math.max(i - 1, 0));
      } else if (e.key === "Enter") {
        e.preventDefault();
        commitItem();
      }
    },
    [searchResults.length, commitItem],
  );

  // ==========================================
  // Quantity handlers
  // ==========================================
  const confirmQuantity = useCallback(() => {
    if (!activeItem) return;
    setPendingLines((prev) => {
      const idx = prev.findIndex((l) => l.itemId === activeItem.id);
      if (idx >= 0) {
        const copy = [...prev];
        copy[idx] = {
          ...copy[idx],
          quantity: copy[idx].quantity + activeQty,
        };
        return copy;
      }
      return [
        ...prev,
        {
          itemId: activeItem.id,
          itemName: activeItem.name,
          size: activeItem.size, // ← TAMBAH
          unit: activeItem.unit,
          quantity: activeQty,
        },
      ];
    });
    setActiveItem(null);
    setActiveQty(1);
  }, [activeItem, activeQty]);

  const handleQtyKeyDown = useCallback(
    (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Enter") {
        e.preventDefault();
        confirmQuantity();
      } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
        e.preventDefault();
        setActiveItem(null);
        setActiveQty(1);
      } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
        e.preventDefault();
        setActiveQty((q) => q + 1);
      } else if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
        e.preventDefault();
        setActiveQty((q) => Math.max(1, q - 1));
      }
    },
    [confirmQuantity],
  );

  const removeLine = useCallback((itemId: number) => {
    setPendingLines((prev) => prev.filter((l) => l.itemId !== itemId));
  }, []);

  const resetEntry = useCallback(() => {
    setPendingLines([]);
    setActiveItem(null);
    setActiveQty(1);
    setKeyword("");
  }, []);

  // ============================================
  // Handle Finish — build StockExit sesuai tipe baru
  // ============================================
  const handleFinish = useCallback(() => {
    if (pendingLines.length === 0) return;
    if (!flow.person || !flow.workplace) return;

    const now = dayjs();
    const exit: StockExit = {
      id: Date.now(),
      nomorTransaksi: "", // akan di-generate DB
      timestamp: now.toISOString(),
      date: now.format("YYYY-MM-DD"),
      time: now.format("HH:mm"),
      person: flow.person.name,
      destination: flow.workplace.name, // ← workplace jadi destination
      isBreakdown: true, // default breakdown
      items: pendingLines.map<StockExitItem>((l) => ({
        itemId: l.itemId,
        itemName: l.itemName,
        size: l.size, // ← TAMBAH
        unit: l.unit,
        quantity: l.quantity,
      })),
    };

    message.success(
      `Tersimpan: ${pendingLines.length} jenis barang di ${flow.workplace.name}`,
    );

    onFinish?.(exit);
    resetEntry();
    flow.resetSession();
  }, [pendingLines, flow, message, onFinish, resetEntry]);

  const handleCancel = useCallback(() => {
    resetEntry();
    flow.resetSession();
  }, [resetEntry, flow]);

  const totalPendingItems = pendingLines.reduce((s, l) => s + l.quantity, 0);

  return {
    flow,
    keyword,
    setKeyword,
    highlightedIdx,
    searchResults,
    searchRef,
    handleSearchKeyDown,
    commitItem,
    activeItem,
    activeQty,
    setActiveQty,
    qtyRef,
    handleQtyKeyDown,
    confirmQuantity,
    pendingLines,
    totalPendingItems,
    removeLine,
    phase,
    handleFinish,
    handleCancel,
  };
};

import { useMutation } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { App } from "antd";
import { supabaseClient } from "../utility/supabaseClient";
import { TABLES } from "../utility/constants";
import { USE_MOCK } from "../utility/config";
import type { StockEntry } from "../types";

export interface CreateStockEntryInput {
  productId: number;
  supplierId: number | null;
  quantity: number;
  unitPrice: number;
  date: string;
  note?: string | null;
}

export const useCreateStockEntry = () => {
  const { message } = App.useApp();

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (input: CreateStockEntryInput) => {
      // === MODE MOCK ===
      if (USE_MOCK) {
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500));
        // Simulasi sukses
        return { id: Date.now(), ...input } as unknown as StockEntry;
      }

      // === MODE SUPABASE ===
      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from(TABLES.stockEntries)
        .insert({
          product_id: input.productId,
          supplier_id: input.supplierId,
          quantity: input.quantity,
          unit_price: input.unitPrice,
          date: input.date,
          note: input.note ?? null,
        })
        .select()
        .single();

      if (error) throw error;
      return data as StockEntry;
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      message.success("Barang masuk berhasil disimpan");
    },
    onError: (error: Error) => {
      message.error(error.message || "Gagal menyimpan barang masuk");
    },
  });
};

FILE   : useStockExits.ts
PATH   : src/hooks/useStockExits.ts
FOLDER : src/hooks
================================================================================
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import dayjs from "dayjs";
import { supabaseClient } from "../utility/supabaseClient";
import { TABLES } from "../utility/constants";
import { USE_MOCK } from "../utility/config";
import { mockStockExits } from "../mocks/stockExitList";
import { mapStockExits } from "../utility/mappers";
import type { StockExit } from "../types";

interface Options {
  onlyToday?: boolean;
  breakdown?: boolean; // true = breakdown, false = non-breakdown, undefined = semua
}

export const useStockExits = ({
  onlyToday = false,
  breakdown,
}: Options = {}) => {
  const { data, isLoading, refetch } = useQuery<StockExit[]>({
    queryKey: ["stock-exits", onlyToday, breakdown],
    queryFn: async () => {
      // === MOCK ===
      if (USE_MOCK) {
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300));
        return mockStockExits;
      }

      // === SUPABASE ===
      let query = supabaseClient
        .from(TABLES.stockExits)
        .select("*")
        .order("created_at", { ascending: false });

      if (onlyToday) {
        const startOfDay = dayjs().startOf("day").toISOString();
        const endOfDay = dayjs().endOf("day").toISOString();
        query = query.gte("created_at", startOfDay).lte("created_at", endOfDay);
      }

      if (breakdown !== undefined) {
        query = query.eq("is_breakdown", breakdown);
      }

      const { data, error } = await query;
      if (error) throw error;

      return mapStockExits(data ?? []);
    },
    refetchInterval: USE_MOCK ? false : 30_000,
  });

  return {
    exits: data ?? [],
    isLoading,
    refetch,
  };
};



================================================================================
FILE   : useStockInChart.ts
PATH   : src/hooks/useStockInChart.ts
FOLDER : src/hooks
================================================================================
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import dayjs from "dayjs";
import { supabaseClient } from "../utility/supabaseClient";
import { TABLES } from "../utility/constants";
import { USE_MOCK } from "../utility/config";
import { mockStockInChart } from "../mocks/stockEntries";
import type { StockInChartItem } from "../types";

export const useStockInChart = (days = 30) => {
  const { data, isLoading, refetch } = useQuery<StockInChartItem[]>({
    queryKey: ["stock-in-chart", days],
    queryFn: async () => {
      // === MODE MOCK ===
      if (USE_MOCK) {
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300));
        return mockStockInChart.slice(-days);
      }

      // === MODE SUPABASE ===
      const fromDate = dayjs().subtract(days, "day").format("YYYY-MM-DD");

      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from(TABLES.stockEntries)
        .select("tanggal, jumlah")
        .gte("tanggal", fromDate)
        .order("tanggal", { ascending: true });

      if (error) throw error;

      // Group by date
      const grouped = (data ?? []).reduce<Record<string, number>>(
        (acc, row: { tanggal: string; jumlah: number }) => {
          acc[row.tanggal] = (acc[row.tanggal] ?? 0) + row.jumlah;
          return acc;
        },
        {},
      );

      return Object.entries(grouped).map(([date, total]) => ({
        date,
        total,
      }));
    },
  });

  return {
    items: data ?? [],
    isLoading,
    refetch,
  };
};

import type { DashboardStats } from "../types";
import { mockProducts } from "./products";
import { getMockTodayInbound } from "./stockEntries";
import { mockStockExits } from "./stockExitList";

export const getMockDashboardStats = (): DashboardStats => {
  const totalProducts = mockProducts.length;
  const totalStock = mockProducts.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.stock, 0);
  const todayInbound = getMockTodayInbound();

  // Hitung barang keluar hari ini dari mockStockExits
  const today = new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];
  const todayOutbound = mockStockExits
    .filter((e) => e.date === today)
    .reduce((sum, e) => sum + e.items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.quantity, 0), 0);

  return { totalProducts, totalStock, todayInbound, todayOutbound };
};

// ============================================
// Data grafik 30 hari terakhir (deterministik, bukan random)
// ============================================
const generateChart = (): StockInChartItem[] => {
  const result: StockInChartItem[] = [];
  // Pola: naik turun natural, bukan random murni (biar test stabil)
  const pattern = [
    0, 0, 45, 80, 120, 60, 0, 30, 95, 140, 70, 0, 0, 55, 110, 85, 40, 0, 20,
    75, 130, 100, 50, 0, 15, 90, 160, 120, 65, 0,
  ];

  for (let i = 29; i >= 0; i--) {
    const date = dayjs().subtract(i, "day").format("YYYY-MM-DD");
    const idx = 29 - i;
    result.push({ date, total: pattern[idx] ?? 0 });
  }
  return result;
};

export const mockStockInChart: StockInChartItem[] = generateChart();

// ============================================
// Helper: total masuk hari ini (dipakai di mocks/dashboard.ts)
// ============================================
export const getMockTodayInbound = (): number => {
  const today = dayjs().format("YYYY-MM-DD");
  return mockStockEntries
    .filter((e) => e.date === today)
    .reduce((sum, e) => sum + e.quantity, 0);
};

    date: dayjs().format("YYYY-MM-DD"),
    time: "14:20",
    team: "Tim Alpha",
    person: "Citra Dewi",
    workplace: "Gudang A",
    items: [
      { itemId: 4, itemName: "Pulpen Standard", unit: "lusin", quantity: 10 },
    ],
  },
];

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { Card, Col, Row, Statistic, Typography } from "antd";
import {
  AppstoreOutlined,
  InboxOutlined,
  ArrowDownOutlined,
  ArrowUpOutlined,
} from "@ant-design/icons";
import { SetupWizard } from "../../components/entry/SetupWizard";
import { QuickEntryPanel } from "../../components/dashboard/QuickPanel";
import { StockTable } from "../../components/dashboard/StockTable";
import { StockExitList } from "../../components/dashboard/StockExitList";
import { useEntryFlow } from "../../hooks/useEntryFlow";
import { useProducts } from "../../hooks/useProducts";
import { useStockExits } from "../../hooks/useStockExits";
import { useKeyboardShortcut } from "../../hooks/useKeyboardShortcut";
import { formatFullDate } from "../../utility/format";
import { COLORS } from "../../utility/constants";

const { Title, Text } = Typography;

interface StatCardProps {
  title: string;
  value: number;
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  color: string;
  suffix?: string;
  loading?: boolean;
}

const StatCard = ({
  title,
  value,
  icon,
  color,
  suffix,
  loading,
}: StatCardProps) => (
  <Card
    variant="borderless"
    style={{ borderRadius: 12 }}
    styles={{ body: { padding: 16 } }}
  >
    <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 12 }}>
      <div
        style={{
          width: 48,
          height: 48,
          borderRadius: 12,
          background: `${color}15`,
          color,
          display: "flex",
          alignItems: "center",
          justifyContent: "center",
          fontSize: 22,
          flexShrink: 0,
        }}
      >
        {icon}
      </div>
      <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
        <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>
          {title}
        </Text>
        <Statistic
          value={loading ? 0 : value}
          suffix={suffix}
          valueStyle={{
            color,
            fontWeight: 600,
            fontSize: 22,
            lineHeight: 1.2,
          }}
          loading={loading}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  </Card>
);

export const DashboardPage = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { products, isLoading: isLoadingProducts } = useProducts();

  const materialProducts = products.filter((p) => p.category === "Material");

  const { exits, isLoading: isLoadingExits } = useStockExits({
    onlyToday: true,
  });

  const flow = useEntryFlow();

  // Shortcut Ctrl + K
  useKeyboardShortcut({
    key: "k",
    ctrlKey: true,
    enabled: !flow.wizardOpen,
    handler: () => flow.openWizard(),
  });

  // Shortcut Tab
  useKeyboardShortcut({
    key: "Tab",
    ignoreInputs: true,
    enabled: !flow.wizardOpen,
    handler: () => flow.openWizard(),
  });

  // ✅ Shortcut M (Tambahan)
  useKeyboardShortcut({
    key: "m",
    ignoreInputs: true,
    enabled: !flow.wizardOpen,
    handler: () => flow.openWizard(),
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (flow.isReady && flow.person && flow.workplace) {
      const personName = encodeURIComponent(flow.person.name);
      const workplaceName = encodeURIComponent(flow.workplace.name);
      flow.resetSession();
      navigate(`/entry?person=${personName}&workplace=${workplaceName}`);
    }
  }, [flow, navigate]);

  const totalProducts = products.length;
  const totalStock = products.reduce((sum, p) => sum + (p.stock ?? 0), 0);
  const todayOutbound = exits.reduce(
    (sum, e) => sum + e.items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.quantity, 0),
    0,
  );
  const todayInbound = 0; // TODO: ambil dari tabel barang_masuk

  return (
    <>
      <SetupWizard
        open={flow.wizardOpen}
        step={
          flow.step === "done"
            ? "person"
            : (flow.step as "person" | "workplace")
        }
        title={flow.currentWizardData?.title ?? ""}
        placeholder={flow.currentWizardData?.placeholder ?? ""}
        options={flow.currentWizardData?.options ?? []}
        onSelect={flow.selectWizardValue}
        onBack={flow.step !== "person" ? flow.backWizard : undefined}
        onClose={() => flow.closeWizard()}
      />

      <div style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
        <Title level={3} style={{ marginBottom: 4 }}>
          Dashboard
        </Title>
        <Text type="secondary">{formatFullDate(new Date())}</Text>
      </div>

      <QuickEntryPanel onTriggerStart={() => flow.openWizard()} />

      <Row gutter={[16, 16]} style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
        <Col xs={24} sm={12} lg={6}>
          <StatCard
            title="Total Barang"
            value={totalProducts}
            icon={<AppstoreOutlined />}
            color={COLORS.primary}
            suffix="item"
            loading={isLoadingProducts}
          />
        </Col>
        <Col xs={24} sm={12} lg={6}>
          <StatCard
            title="Total Stok"
            value={totalStock}
            icon={<InboxOutlined />}
            color={COLORS.success}
            loading={isLoadingProducts}
          />
        </Col>
        <Col xs={24} sm={12} lg={6}>
          <StatCard
            title="Masuk Hari Ini"
            value={todayInbound}
            icon={<ArrowDownOutlined />}
            color={COLORS.warning}
            loading={false}
          />
        </Col>
        <Col xs={24} sm={12} lg={6}>
          <StatCard
            title="Keluar Hari Ini"
            value={todayOutbound}
            icon={<ArrowUpOutlined />}
            color={COLORS.danger}
            loading={isLoadingExits}
          />
        </Col>
      </Row>

      <Row gutter={[16, 16]}>
        <Col xs={24} lg={16}>
          <StockTable products={materialProducts} loading={isLoadingProducts} />
        </Col>
        <Col xs={24} lg={8}>
          <StockExitList exits={exits} loading={isLoadingExits} />
        </Col>
      </Row>
    </>
  );
};

export default DashboardPage;
