import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate, useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import {
  AutoComplete,
  Button,
  Card,
  Col,
  Empty,
  Input,
  InputNumber,
  List,
  Row,
  Space,
  Switch,
  Tag,
  Typography,
  App,
} from "antd";
import {
  ArrowLeftOutlined,
  CheckCircleOutlined,
  CloseCircleOutlined,
  EnvironmentOutlined,
  SearchOutlined,
  SwapOutlined,
  UserOutlined,
} from "@ant-design/icons";
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useProductSearch } from "../../hooks/useProductSearch";
import { usePersons } from "../../hooks/usePersons"; // Data dari DB
import { SetupWizard } from "../../components/entry/SetupWizard";
import { mockWorkplaces } from "../../mocks/entry"; // Data lokal hardcode
import { supabaseClient } from "../../utility/supabaseClient";
import { TABLES } from "../../utility/constants";
import { USE_MOCK } from "../../utility/config";
import { formatNumber } from "../../utility/format";
import type { Product } from "../../types";
import type { Person, Workplace } from "../../types/entry";

const { Title, Text } = Typography;

interface OutboundLine {
  itemId: number;
  itemName: string;
  size: string | null;
  unit: string;
  maxStock: number;
  quantity: number;
}

export const EntryPage = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const { message } = App.useApp();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  // Ambil data pekerja dari database
  const { persons } = usePersons();

  const initialPerson = searchParams.get("person") || "";
  const initialWorkplace = searchParams.get("workplace") || "";

  const [personName, setPersonName] = useState<string>(initialPerson);
  const [workplaceName, setWorkplaceName] = useState<string>(initialWorkplace);

  // Secara default tercatat sebagai Breakdown aktif
  const [isBreakdown, setIsBreakdown] = useState<boolean>(true);

  // Jika URL tidak memiliki parameter person/workplace, buka wizard
  const [wizardOpen, setWizardOpen] = useState<boolean>(
    !initialPerson || !initialWorkplace,
  );
  const [wizardStep, setWizardStep] = useState<"person" | "workplace">("person");

  const [keyword, setKeyword] = useState("");
  const [highlightedIdx, setHighlightedIdx] = useState(0);
  const [activeItem, setActiveItem] = useState<Product | null>(null);
  const [activeQty, setActiveQty] = useState<number>(1);
  const [lines, setLines] = useState<OutboundLine[]>([]);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const searchRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const qtyRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const { products } = useProductSearch(keyword, 10);
  const phase = activeItem ? "quantity" : "search";

  useEffect(() => {
    if (wizardOpen) return;
    if (phase === "search") {
      setTimeout(() => searchRef.current?.focus(), 100);
    } else {
      setTimeout(() => qtyRef.current?.focus(), 100);
    }
  }, [phase, wizardOpen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setHighlightedIdx(0);
  }, [keyword]);

  const handleWizardSelect = (val: Person | Workplace) => {
    if (wizardStep === "person") {
      setPersonName(val.name);
      setWizardStep("workplace");
    } else {
      setWorkplaceName(val.name);
      setWizardOpen(false);
      setSearchParams({ person: personName, workplace: val.name });
    }
  };

  const commitItem = (item?: Product) => {
    const chosen = item ?? products[highlightedIdx] ?? products[0];
    if (!chosen) return;
    setActiveItem(chosen);
    setActiveQty(1);
    setKeyword("");
  };

  const confirmQuantity = () => {
    if (!activeItem) return;
    if (activeQty <= 0) {
      message.warning("Jumlah minimal 1");
      return;
    }
    setLines((prev) => {
      const idx = prev.findIndex((l) => l.itemId === activeItem.id);
      if (idx >= 0) {
        const copy = [...prev];
        copy[idx] = {
          ...copy[idx],
          quantity: copy[idx].quantity + activeQty,
        };
        return copy;
      }
      return [
        ...prev,
        {
          itemId: activeItem.id,
          itemName: activeItem.name,
          size: activeItem.size,
          unit: activeItem.unit,
          maxStock: activeItem.stock,
          quantity: activeQty,
        },
      ];
    });
    setActiveItem(null);
    setActiveQty(1);
  };

  const removeLine = (itemId: number) => {
    setLines((prev) => prev.filter((l) => l.itemId !== itemId));
  };

  const handleFinish = async () => {
    if (lines.length === 0) {
      message.warning("Tambahkan minimal 1 barang terlebih dahulu");
      return;
    }
    if (!personName || !workplaceName) {
      setWizardStep("person");
      setWizardOpen(true);
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const trxNumber = `OUT-${Date.now()}`;

      if (!USE_MOCK) {
        const payload = lines.map((l) => ({
          nomor_transaksi: trxNumber,
          barang_id: l.itemId,
          nama_pekerja: personName,
          nama_barang: l.itemName,
          ukuran_barang: l.size,
          satuan_barang: l.unit,
          jumlah_barang_keluar: l.quantity,
          tujuan: workplaceName,
          is_breakdown: isBreakdown,
        }));

        const { error: insertErr } = await supabaseClient
          .from(TABLES.stockExits)
          .insert(payload);

        if (insertErr) throw insertErr;

        // Update stok berkurang di tabel barang
        for (const line of lines) {
          const newStock = Math.max(0, line.maxStock - line.quantity);
          await supabaseClient
            .from(TABLES.products)
            .update({ stok: newStock })
            .eq("id", line.itemId);
        }
      }

      message.success(
        `Pengeluaran ${lines.length} jenis barang (${
          isBreakdown ? "Breakdown" : "Diluar Breakdown"
        }) berhasil disimpan!`,
      );

      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["products"] });
      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["stock-exits"] });
      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["dashboard-stats"] });

      navigate("/dashboard");
    } catch (err: any) {
      message.error(err?.message || "Gagal menyimpan pengeluaran barang");
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.ctrlKey && e.key === "Enter" && lines.length > 0 && !isSubmitting) {
        e.preventDefault();
        handleFinish();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
  });

  const totalItems = lines.reduce((sum, l) => sum + l.quantity, 0);

  return (
    <div style={{ maxWidth: 920, margin: "0 auto", paddingBottom: 32 }}>
      <SetupWizard
        open={wizardOpen}
        step={wizardStep}
        title={
          wizardStep === "person"
            ? "Pilih Nama Pekerja"
            : "Pilih Lokasi Pekerjaan"
        }
        placeholder={
          wizardStep === "person"
            ? "Ketik nama pekerja..."
            : "Ketik lokasi pekerjaan..."
        }
        options={wizardStep === "person" ? persons : mockWorkplaces}
        onSelect={handleWizardSelect}
        onBack={
          wizardStep === "workplace"
            ? () => setWizardStep("person")
            : undefined
        }
        onClose={() => {
          if (!personName || !workplaceName) {
             navigate("/dashboard");
          } else {
             setWizardOpen(false);
          }
        }}
      />

      <div
        style={{
          marginBottom: 16,
          display: "flex",
          alignItems: "center",
          justifyContent: "space-between",
          flexWrap: "wrap",
          gap: 12,
        }}
      >
        <Space align="center">
          <Button
            icon={<ArrowLeftOutlined />}
            onClick={() => navigate("/dashboard")}
            type="text"
            size="large"
          />
          <div>
            <Title level={3} style={{ margin: 0 }}>
              Pengeluaran Barang
            </Title>
            <Text type="secondary">
              Pilih barang yang diambil dan tentukan jumlahnya
            </Text>
          </div>
        </Space>

        <Card
          size="small"
          style={{
            borderRadius: 10,
            background: isBreakdown ? "#e6f4ff" : "#fffbe6",
            borderColor: isBreakdown ? "#91caff" : "#ffe58f",
          }}
          styles={{ body: { padding: "8px 14px" } }}
        >
          <Space align="center" size={10}>
            <div>
              <Text strong style={{ fontSize: 13, display: "block" }}>
                Status: {isBreakdown ? "Masuk Breakdown" : "Diluar Breakdown"}
              </Text>
              <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
                {isBreakdown
                  ? "Otomatis tercatat di daftar Breakdown"
                  : "Tercatat sebagai Non-Breakdown"}
              </Text>
            </div>
            <Switch
              checked={isBreakdown}
              onChange={setIsBreakdown}
              checkedChildren="Breakdown"
              unCheckedChildren="Non"
            />
          </Space>
        </Card>
      </div>

      <Card
        variant="borderless"
        style={{ borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 16 }}
        styles={{ body: { padding: 16 } }}
      >
        <Row justify="space-between" align="middle" gutter={[12, 12]}>
          <Col>
            <Space size={12} wrap>
              <Tag
                icon={<UserOutlined />}
                color="blue"
                style={{ fontSize: 14, padding: "6px 12px", borderRadius: 8 }}
              >
                Pekerja: <strong>{personName || "Belum dipilih"}</strong>
              </Tag>
              <Tag
                icon={<EnvironmentOutlined />}
                color="cyan"
                style={{ fontSize: 14, padding: "6px 12px", borderRadius: 8 }}
              >
                Lokasi: <strong>{workplaceName || "Belum dipilih"}</strong>
              </Tag>
            </Space>
          </Col>
          <Col>
            <Button
              size="small"
              icon={<SwapOutlined />}
              onClick={() => {
                setWizardStep("person");
                setWizardOpen(true);
              }}
            >
              Ubah Nama / Lokasi
            </Button>
          </Col>
        </Row>
      </Card>

      <Card
        variant="borderless"
        style={{ borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 16 }}
        styles={{ body: { padding: 20 } }}
      >
        {phase === "search" && (
          <>
            <Text strong style={{ fontSize: 14 }}>
              Cari Material / Alat
            </Text>
            <AutoComplete
              value={keyword}
              onChange={setKeyword}
              options={products.map((p, idx) => ({
                value: p.name,
                label: (
                  <div
                    style={{
                      display: "flex",
                      justifyContent: "space-between",
                      padding: "4px 0",
                      background:
                        idx === highlightedIdx ? "#e6f4ff" : "transparent",
                    }}
                  >
                    <span>
                      <strong style={{ fontSize: 14 }}>{p.name}</strong>{" "}
                      {p.size && (
                        <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 13, marginLeft: 4 }}>
                          ({p.size})
                        </Text>
                      )}
                    </span>
                    <Tag color={p.stock > 0 ? "green" : "red"}>
                      Stok: {p.stock} {p.unit}
                    </Tag>
                  </div>
                ),
                data: p,
              }))}
              onSelect={(_, opt) => commitItem((opt as { data: Product }).data)}
              style={{ width: "100%", marginTop: 8 }}
            >
              <Input
                ref={searchRef as never}
                size="large"
                prefix={<SearchOutlined />}
                placeholder="Ketik nama barang, lalu tekan Enter..."
                onKeyDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    setHighlightedIdx((i) =>
                      Math.min(i + 1, products.length - 1),
                    );
                  } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    setHighlightedIdx((i) => Math.max(i - 1, 0));
                  } else if (e.key === "Enter") {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    commitItem();
                  }
                }}
              />
            </AutoComplete>
            <Space style={{ marginTop: 10 }} size="small" wrap>
              <Tag>↑↓</Tag>
              <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                navigasi
              </Text>
              <Tag>Enter</Tag>
              <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                pilih barang
              </Text>
              <Tag>Ctrl + Enter</Tag>
              <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                simpan pengeluaran
              </Text>
            </Space>
          </>
        )}

        {phase === "quantity" && activeItem && (
          <div>
            <div
              style={{
                display: "flex",
                justifyContent: "space-between",
                alignItems: "center",
                marginBottom: 12,
                flexWrap: "wrap",
                gap: 8,
              }}
            >
              <div>
                <Text strong style={{ fontSize: 16 }}>
                  {activeItem.name}{" "}
                  {activeItem.size ? `(${activeItem.size})` : ""}
                </Text>
              </div>
              <Tag color="blue" style={{ fontSize: 13, padding: "4px 10px" }}>
                Stok Tersedia: {activeItem.stock} {activeItem.unit}
              </Tag>
            </div>

            <Space.Compact style={{ width: "100%" }}>
              <Button
                size="large"
                onClick={() => setActiveQty((q) => Math.max(1, q - 1))}
                style={{ width: 64, height: 50, fontSize: 22 }}
              >
                −
              </Button>
              <InputNumber
                ref={qtyRef as never}
                value={activeQty}
                onChange={(val) => setActiveQty(Number(val) || 1)}
                size="large"
                min={1}
                controls={false}
                onKeyDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.key === "Enter") {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    confirmQuantity();
                  } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    setActiveItem(null);
                  } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    setActiveQty((q) => q + 1);
                  } else if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    setActiveQty((q) => Math.max(1, q - 1));
                  }
                }}
                style={{
                  flex: 1,
                  textAlign: "center",
                  fontSize: 22,
                  fontWeight: 600,
                  height: 50,
                }}
              />
              <Button
                size="large"
                onClick={() => setActiveQty((q) => q + 1)}
                style={{ width: 64, height: 50, fontSize: 22 }}
              >
                +
              </Button>
            </Space.Compact>

            <Space style={{ marginTop: 14, width: "100%", justifyContent: "space-between" }} wrap>
              <Space size="small" wrap>
                <Tag>Enter</Tag>
                <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                  tambahkan ke daftar
                </Text>
                <Tag>Esc</Tag>
                <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                  batal
                </Text>
              </Space>
              <Space>
                <Button onClick={() => setActiveItem(null)}>Batal</Button>
                <Button type="primary" onClick={confirmQuantity}>
                  Tambah Barang
                </Button>
              </Space>
            </Space>
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>

      <Card
        title={`📦 Daftar Pengeluaran (${lines.length} jenis · ${formatNumber(
          totalItems,
        )} item)`}
        variant="borderless"
        style={{ borderRadius: 12 }}
        extra={
          <Button
            type="primary"
            size="large"
            icon={<CheckCircleOutlined />}
            disabled={lines.length === 0}
            loading={isSubmitting}
            onClick={handleFinish}
          >
            Simpan (Ctrl+Enter)
          </Button>
        }
      >
        {lines.length === 0 ? (
          <Empty
            description="Belum ada barang yang dipilih"
            image={Empty.PRESENTED_IMAGE_SIMPLE}
          />
        ) : (
          <List
            dataSource={lines}
            renderItem={(line) => (
              <List.Item
                actions={[
                  <Button
                    key="del"
                    type="text"
                    danger
                    icon={<CloseCircleOutlined />}
                    onClick={() => removeLine(line.itemId)}
                  >
                    Hapus
                  </Button>,
                ]}
              >
                <List.Item.Meta
                  title={
                    <Space>
                      <Text strong style={{ fontSize: 15 }}>{line.itemName}</Text>
                      {line.size && <Tag style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>{line.size}</Tag>}
                    </Space>
                  }
                />
                <Tag
                  color="red"
                  style={{ fontSize: 15, padding: "4px 12px", fontWeight: 600 }}
                >
                  {formatNumber(line.quantity)} {line.unit}
                </Tag>
              </List.Item>
            )}
          />
        )}
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
};

export default EntryPage;

PATH   : src/pages/inventory/index.tsx
FOLDER : src/pages/inventory

import { useState } from "react";
import { Typography, Tabs, Space } from "antd";
import { formatFullDate } from "../../utility/format";
import { InventoryTable } from "../../components/inventory/InventoryTable";
import { useProducts } from "../../hooks/useProducts";
import { useStockExits } from "../../hooks/useStockExits";

const { Title, Text } = Typography;

enum InventoryTabKey {
  MATERIAL = "material",
  TOOLS = "tools",
  OUTBOUND_BREAKDOWN = "outbound-breakdown",
  OUTBOUND_NON_BREAKDOWN = "outbound-non-breakdown",
}

export const InventoryPage = () => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<string>(InventoryTabKey.MATERIAL);

  const { products: materials, isLoading: isLoadingMaterials } =
    useProducts("Material");

  const { products: tools, isLoading: isLoadingTools } =
    useProducts("Alat Bantu");

  const { exits: breakdownExits, isLoading: isLoadingBreakdown } =
    useStockExits({ breakdown: true });

  const { exits: nonBreakdownExits, isLoading: isLoadingNonBreakdown } =
    useStockExits({ breakdown: false });

  const tabItems = [
    {
      key: InventoryTabKey.MATERIAL,
      label: `Stok Persediaan Material (${materials.length})`,
      children: (
        <InventoryTable
          type="stock"
          dataSource={materials}
          loading={isLoadingMaterials}
        />
      ),
    },
    {
      key: InventoryTabKey.TOOLS,
      // ✅ Rename jadi Stok Persediaan Alat
      label: `Stok Persediaan Alat (${tools.length})`,
      children: (
        <InventoryTable
          type="stock"
          dataSource={tools}
          loading={isLoadingTools}
        />
      ),
    },
    {
      key: InventoryTabKey.OUTBOUND_BREAKDOWN,
      label: `Pengeluaran (Breakdown) (${breakdownExits.length})`,
      children: (
        <InventoryTable
          type="outbound"
          dataSource={breakdownExits}
          loading={isLoadingBreakdown}
        />
      ),
    },
    {
      key: InventoryTabKey.OUTBOUND_NON_BREAKDOWN,
      label: `Pengeluaran (Diluar Breakdown) (${nonBreakdownExits.length})`,
      children: (
        <InventoryTable
          type="outbound"
          dataSource={nonBreakdownExits}
          loading={isLoadingNonBreakdown}
        />
      ),
    },
  ];

  return (
    <Space direction="vertical" size="large" style={{ width: "100%" }}>
      <div>
        <Title level={3} style={{ marginBottom: 4 }}>
          Manajemen Persediaan & Pengeluaran
        </Title>
        <Text type="secondary">{formatFullDate(new Date())}</Text>
      </div>

      <Tabs
        activeKey={activeTab}
        onChange={setActiveTab}
        type="card"
        size="large"
        items={tabItems}
        destroyInactiveTabPane={false}
      />
    </Space>
  );
};

export default InventoryPage;

import { useState } from "react";
import { useLogin } from "@refinedev/core";
import { Button, Card, Form, Input, Typography, Alert, Space } from "antd";
import { UserOutlined, LockOutlined } from "@ant-design/icons";
import { USE_MOCK } from "../../utility/config";

const { Title, Text } = Typography;

interface LoginForm {
  email: string;
  password: string;
}

export const LoginPage = () => {
  const { mutate: login, isLoading } = useLogin<LoginForm>();
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleSubmit = (values: LoginForm) => {
    setErrorMsg(null);
    login(values, {
      onError: (error) => {
        setErrorMsg(error?.message ?? "Login gagal, coba lagi");
      },
    });
  };

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        minHeight: "100vh",
        display: "flex",
        alignItems: "center",
        justifyContent: "center",
        background:
          "linear-gradient(135deg, #1677ff 0%, #0e4fb8 50%, #062d6e 100%)",
        padding: 16,
      }}
    >
      <Card
        style={{
          width: "100%",
          maxWidth: 420,
          borderRadius: 16,
          boxShadow: "0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)",
        }}
        styles={{ body: { padding: 32 } }}
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <div style={{ textAlign: "center", marginBottom: 28 }}>
          <div
            style={{
              width: 64,
              height: 64,
              margin: "0 auto 12px",
              borderRadius: 16,

              display: "flex",
              alignItems: "center",
              justifyContent: "center",
              color: "#fff",
              fontSize: 28,
              fontWeight: 700,
            }}
          >
            AS
          </div>
          <Title level={3} style={{ margin: 0 }}>
            Admin Stok
          </Title>
          <Text type="secondary">Masuk untuk mengelola inventaris</Text>
        </div>

        {/* Error */}
        {errorMsg && (
          <Alert
            type="error"
            message={errorMsg}
            showIcon
            closable
            onClose={() => setErrorMsg(null)}
            style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}
          />
        )}

        {/* Form */}
        <Form<LoginForm>
          layout="vertical"
          onFinish={handleSubmit}
          autoComplete="off"
          requiredMark={false}
          initialValues={
            USE_MOCK
              ? { email: "admin@admin.com", password: "admin123" }
              : undefined
          }
        >
          <Form.Item
            name="email"
            label="Email"
            rules={[
              { required: true, message: "Email wajib diisi" },
              { type: "email", message: "Format email tidak valid" },

          >
            <Input
              size="large"
              prefix={<UserOutlined />}
              placeholder="admin@admin.com"
              autoFocus
            />
          </Form.Item>

          <Form.Item
            name="password"
            label="Password"
            rules={[{ required: true, message: "Password wajib diisi" }]}
          >
            <Input.Password
              size="large"
              prefix={<LockOutlined />}
              placeholder="••••••••"
            />
          </Form.Item>

          <Form.Item style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
            <Button
              type="primary"
              htmlType="submit"
              size="large"
              block
              loading={isLoading}
            >
              Masuk
            </Button>
          </Form.Item>
        </Form>

        {/* Info mock */}
        {USE_MOCK && (
          <Alert
            type="info"
            showIcon
            style={{ marginTop: 8 }}
            message="Mode Demo"
            description={
              <Space direction="vertical" size={2}>
                <Text style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                  Email: <Text code>admin@admin.com</Text>
                </Text>
                <Text style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                  Password: <Text code>admin123</Text>

import { useState } from "react";
import {
  Button,
  Card,
  Col,
  DatePicker,
  Form,
  Input,
  InputNumber,
  Row,
  Select,
  Space,
  Table,
  Typography,
  App,
} from "antd";
import {
  PlusOutlined,
  SaveOutlined,
  AppstoreAddOutlined,
} from "@ant-design/icons";
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import dayjs from "dayjs";
import { supabaseClient } from "../../utility/supabaseClient";
import { TABLES } from "../../utility/constants";
import { USE_MOCK } from "../../utility/config";
import { useProducts } from "../../hooks/useProducts";
import { formatNumber, formatDate } from "../../utility/format";
import type { Product } from "../../types";

const { Title, Text } = Typography;

interface StockEntryFormValues {
  productId: number;
  jumlah: number;
  tanggal_pengiriman: dayjs.Dayjs;
  spesifikasi?: string;
  merk?: string;
}

export const ProductCreatePage = () => {
  const [form] = Form.useForm<StockEntryFormValues>();
  const { message } = App.useApp();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  const { products, isLoading } = useProducts();
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [selectedProduct, setSelectedProduct] = useState<Product | null>(null);

  // Menyimpan riwayat lokal sementara setelah diinput
  const [recentEntries, setRecentEntries] = useState<any[]>([]);

  const handleProductSelect = (val: number) => {
    const prod = products.find((p) => p.id === val);
    setSelectedProduct(prod || null);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (values: StockEntryFormValues) => {
    if (!selectedProduct) return;
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    
    try {
      if (!USE_MOCK) {
        // 1. Catat di tabel barang_masuk
        const payload = {
          kode_barang: selectedProduct.code,
          nama_barang: selectedProduct.name,
          ukuran_barang: selectedProduct.size,
          spesifikasi_barang: values.spesifikasi || null,
          satuan_barang: selectedProduct.unit,
          kategori: selectedProduct.category,
          jumlah_barang_masuk: values.jumlah,
          tanggal_pengiriman: values.tanggal_pengiriman.format("YYYY-MM-DD"),
          keterangan: values.merk ? `Merk: ${values.merk}` : null,
        };

        const { error: insertErr } = await supabaseClient
          .from("barang_masuk")
          .insert(payload);

        if (insertErr) throw insertErr;

        // 2. Tambah stok di tabel barang
        const newStock = selectedProduct.stock + values.jumlah;
        const { error: updateErr } = await supabaseClient
          .from(TABLES.products)
          .update({ stok: newStock })
          .eq("id", selectedProduct.id);

        if (updateErr) throw updateErr;
      }

      message.success(`Berhasil menambahkan ${values.jumlah} ${selectedProduct.unit} ke stok ${selectedProduct.name}!`);
      
      setRecentEntries((prev) => [
        {
          key: Date.now(),
          nama: selectedProduct.name,
          ukuran: selectedProduct.size,
          jumlah: values.jumlah,
          satuan: selectedProduct.unit,
          tanggal: values.tanggal_pengiriman.format("YYYY-MM-DD"),
        },
        ...prev,
      ]);

      form.resetFields(["jumlah", "spesifikasi", "merk"]);
      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["products"] });
      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["dashboard-stats"] });

    } catch (err: any) {
      message.error(err?.message || "Gagal menyimpan data barang masuk");
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ maxWidth: 860, margin: "0 auto", paddingBottom: 32 }}>
      <div style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
        <Space align="center" size={10}>
          <div
            style={{
              width: 42,
              height: 42,
              borderRadius: 10,
              background: "#1677ff15",
              color: "#1677ff",
              display: "flex",
              alignItems: "center",
              justifyContent: "center",
              fontSize: 20,
            }}
          >
            <AppstoreAddOutlined />
          </div>
          <div>
            <Title level={3} style={{ margin: 0 }}>
              Tambah Barang Masuk
            </Title>
            <Text type="secondary">
              Pilih barang dari database dan tambahkan jumlah stoknya
            </Text>
          </div>
        </Space>
      </div>

      <Card
        variant="borderless"
        style={{
          borderRadius: 14,
          boxShadow: "0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)",
          marginBottom: 24,
        }}
        styles={{ body: { padding: 24 } }}
      >
        <Form<StockEntryFormValues>
          form={form}
          layout="vertical"
          onFinish={handleSubmit}
          initialValues={{
            tanggal_pengiriman: dayjs(),
          }}
          requiredMark={false}
        >
          <Row gutter={[16, 8]}>
            <Col xs={24}>
              <Form.Item
                name="productId"
                label="Nama Barang (Pilih dari Database)"
                rules={[{ required: true, message: "Pilih barang terlebih dahulu" }]}
              >
                <Select
                  showSearch
                  size="large"
                  placeholder="Ketik nama barang..."
                  optionFilterProp="children"
                  loading={isLoading}
                  onChange={handleProductSelect}
                  options={products.map((p) => ({
                    value: p.id,
                    label: `${p.name} ${p.size ? `(${p.size})` : ""} - Sisa Stok: ${p.stock}`,
                  }))}
                />
              </Form.Item>
            </Col>

            <Col xs={12} sm={8}>
              <Form.Item
                name="jumlah"
                label="Jumlah Masuk"
                rules={[{ required: true, message: "Wajib diisi" }]}
              >
                <InputNumber
                  size="large"
                  min={1}
                  style={{ width: "100%" }}
                  placeholder="0"
                  addonAfter={selectedProduct?.unit || ""}
                />
              </Form.Item>
            </Col>

            <Col xs={12} sm={16}>
              <Form.Item
                name="tanggal_pengiriman"
                label="Tanggal Pengiriman"
                rules={[{ required: true, message: "Wajib diisi" }]}
              >
                <DatePicker
                  size="large"
                  style={{ width: "100%" }}
                  format="DD MMMM YYYY"
                />
              </Form.Item>
            </Col>

            <Col xs={24} sm={12}>
              <Form.Item name="merk" label="Merk (Opsional)">
                <Input size="large" placeholder="Contoh: Rucika, Panasonic" />
              </Form.Item>
            </Col>

            <Col xs={24} sm={12}>
              <Form.Item name="spesifikasi" label="Spesifikasi (Opsional)">
                <Input size="large" placeholder="Keterangan tambahan..." />
              </Form.Item>
            </Col>
          </Row>

          <div
            style={{
              marginTop: 16,
              display: "flex",
              justifyContent: "flex-end",
            }}
          >
            <Button
              type="primary"
              size="large"
              htmlType="submit"
              icon={<SaveOutlined />}
              loading={isSubmitting}
              style={{ minWidth: 200 }}
              disabled={!selectedProduct}
            >
              Simpan Stok
            </Button>
          </div>
        </Form>
      </Card>

      {/* Daftar Riwayat Input Sesi Ini */}
      {recentEntries.length > 0 && (
        <Card
          title={
            <Space>
              <PlusOutlined />
              <span>Baru Saja Ditambahkan</span>
            </Space>
          }
          variant="borderless"
          style={{ borderRadius: 14 }}
          styles={{ body: { padding: 0 } }}
        >
          <Table
            dataSource={recentEntries}
            pagination={false}
            size="small"
            scroll={{ x: 500 }}
            columns={[
              { dataIndex: "nama", title: "Nama Barang", ellipsis: true },
              {
                dataIndex: "ukuran",
                title: "Ukuran",
                width: 140,
                render: (v) => v ?? "-",
              },
              {
                title: "Jumlah",
                width: 120,
                align: "right",
                render: (_, r) => (
                  <Text strong style={{ color: "#52c41a" }}>
                    +{formatNumber(r.jumlah)} <Text type="secondary" style={{fontSize: 12}}>{r.satuan}</Text>
                  </Text>
                ),
              },
              {
                dataIndex: "tanggal",
                title: "Tgl Kirim",
                width: 110,
                render: (v) => formatDate(v),
              },
            ]}
          />
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default ProductCreatePage;

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate, useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import {
  Button,
  Card,
  Col,
  DatePicker,
  Divider,
  Form,
  Input,
  InputNumber,
  Row,
  Select,
  Space,
  Typography,
  Tag,
} from "antd";
import {
  ArrowLeftOutlined,
  SaveOutlined,
  ThunderboltOutlined,
} from "@ant-design/icons";
import dayjs from "dayjs";
import { useKeyboardShortcut } from "../../hooks/useKeyboardShortcut";
import { useProductSearch } from "../../hooks/useProductSearch";
import { useCreateStockEntry } from "../../hooks/useStockEntryMutations";
import { formatRupiah } from "../../utility/format";
import type { Product } from "../../types";

const { Title, Text } = Typography;

interface FormValues {
  productId: number;
  supplierId: number | null;
  quantity: number;
  unitPrice: number;
  date: dayjs.Dayjs;
  note?: string;
}

export const StockEntryCreatePage = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const [form] = Form.useForm<FormValues>();
  const productSearchRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const preselectedId = searchParams.get("productId");
  const [searchKeyword, setSearchKeyword] = useState("");
  const [selectedProduct, setSelectedProduct] = useState<Product | null>(null);

  const { products, isLoading: isSearching } = useProductSearch(searchKeyword);
  const createMutation = useCreateStockEntry();

  // Auto-focus ke product search saat halaman dibuka
  useEffect(() => {
    setTimeout(() => productSearchRef.current?.focus(), 100);
  }, []);

  // Jika ada productId di URL, langsung set
  useEffect(() => {
    if (preselectedId) {
      const found = products.find((p) => p.id === Number(preselectedId));
      if (found) {
        setSelectedProduct(found);
        form.setFieldsValue({
          productId: found.id,
          unitPrice: found.costPrice,
        });
      }
    }
  }, [preselectedId, products, form]);

  // ⌨️ Ctrl+Enter → submit
  useKeyboardShortcut({
    key: "Enter",
    ctrlKey: true,
    handler: () => form.submit(),
  });

  // ⌨️ Esc → kembali
  useKeyboardShortcut({
    key: "Escape",
    handler: () => navigate(-1),
  });

  const handleProductChange = (productId: number) => {
    const product = products.find((p) => p.id === productId);
    if (!product) return;
    setSelectedProduct(product);
    setSearchKeyword("");
    form.setFieldsValue({
      productId: product.id,
      unitPrice: product.costPrice,
    });
    // Fokus ke quantity setelah pilih produk
    setTimeout(() => {
      form.getFieldInstance("quantity")?.focus?.();
    }, 50);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (values: FormValues) => {
    await createMutation.mutateAsync({
      productId: values.productId,
      supplierId: values.supplierId ?? null,
      quantity: values.quantity,
      unitPrice: values.unitPrice,
      date: values.date.format("YYYY-MM-DD"),
      note: values.note,
    });

    form.resetFields();
    setSelectedProduct(null);
    // Balik ke search produk untuk entri berikutnya
    setTimeout(() => productSearchRef.current?.focus(), 100);
  };

  const quantity = Form.useWatch("quantity", form) ?? 0;
  const unitPrice = Form.useWatch("unitPrice", form) ?? 0;
  const total = quantity * unitPrice;

  return (
    <div style={{ maxWidth: 900, margin: "0 auto" }}>
      {/* Header */}
      <div style={{ marginBottom: 16, display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 12 }}>
        <Button
          icon={<ArrowLeftOutlined />}
          onClick={() => navigate(-1)}
          type="text"
        />
        <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <Title level={3} style={{ margin: 0 }}>
            Input Barang Masuk
          </Title>
          <Text type="secondary">
            Tekan <Tag>Ctrl</Tag> + <Tag>Enter</Tag> untuk simpan ·{" "}
            <Tag>Esc</Tag> untuk batal
          </Text>
        </div>
      </div>

      <Card style={{ borderRadius: 12 }}>
        <Form<FormValues>
          form={form}
          layout="vertical"
          onFinish={handleSubmit}
          initialValues={{ date: dayjs() }}
          requiredMark={false}
        >
          {/* Produk */}
          <Form.Item
            name="productId"
            label="Produk"
            rules={[{ required: true, message: "Pilih produk" }]}
          >
            <Select
              showSearch
              size="large"
              placeholder="Ketik nama atau kode produk..."
              loading={isSearching}
              onSearch={setSearchKeyword}
              filterOption={false}
              onChange={handleProductChange}
              autoFocus
              ref={productSearchRef as never}
              notFoundContent={isSearching ? "Mencari..." : "Tidak ditemukan"}
              options={products.map((p) => ({
                value: p.id,
                label: `${p.name} · ${p.code} (stok: ${p.stock} ${p.unit})`,
              }))}
            />
          </Form.Item>

          {/* Info produk terpilih */}
          {selectedProduct && (
            <Card
              size="small"
              style={{
                marginBottom: 16,
                background: "#f6ffed",
                borderColor: "#b7eb8f",
              }}
            >
              <Row gutter={16}>
                <Col span={8}>
                  <Text type="secondary">Stok saat ini</Text>
                  <div>
                    <Text strong>
                      {selectedProduct.stock} {selectedProduct.unit}
                    </Text>
                  </div>
                </Col>
                <Col span={8}>
                  <Text type="secondary">Kategori</Text>
                  <div>
                    <Text strong>{selectedProduct.categoryName ?? "-"}</Text>
                  </div>
                </Col>
                <Col span={8}>
                  <Text type="secondary">Harga beli terakhir</Text>
                  <div>
                    <Text strong>{formatRupiah(selectedProduct.costPrice)}</Text>
                  </div>
                </Col>
              </Row>
            </Card>
          )}

          <Row gutter={16}>
            <Col xs={24} sm={12} md={8}>
              <Form.Item
                name="quantity"
                label="Jumlah"
                rules={[
                  { required: true, message: "Isi jumlah" },
                  {
                    type: "number",
                    min: 1,
                    message: "Minimal 1",
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <InputNumber
                  size="large"
                  style={{ width: "100%" }}
                  placeholder="0"
                  min={1}
                  addonAfter={selectedProduct?.unit ?? ""}
                />
              </Form.Item>
            </Col>

            <Col xs={24} sm={12} md={8}>
              <Form.Item name="unitPrice" label="Harga Satuan">
                <InputNumber
                  size="large"
                  style={{ width: "100%" }}
                  placeholder="0"
                  min={0}
                  formatter={(v) =>
                    `${v}`.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ".")
                  }
                  parser={(v) => Number(`${v}`.replace(/\./g, "")) as never}
                  addonBefore="Rp"
                />
              </Form.Item>
            </Col>

            <Col xs={24} sm={12} md={8}>
              <Form.Item name="date" label="Tanggal">
                <DatePicker
                  size="large"
                  style={{ width: "100%" }}
                  format="DD MMM YYYY"
                />
              </Form.Item>
            </Col>
          </Row>

          <Form.Item name="note" label="Catatan (opsional)">
            <Input.TextArea rows={2} placeholder="Contoh: pembelian rutin" />
          </Form.Item>

          <Divider style={{ margin: "12px 0 16px" }} />

          {/* Total */}
          <div
            style={{
              display: "flex",
              justifyContent: "space-between",
              alignItems: "center",
              padding: "12px 16px",
              background: "#fafafa",
              borderRadius: 8,
              marginBottom: 16,
            }}
          >
            <Text strong>Total</Text>
            <Text strong style={{ fontSize: 20, color: "#1677ff" }}>
              {formatRupiah(total)}
            </Text>
          </div>

          <Space>
            <Button
              type="primary"
              size="large"
              htmlType="submit"
              icon={<SaveOutlined />}
              loading={createMutation.isPending}
            >
              Simpan (Ctrl+Enter)
            </Button>
            <Button size="large" onClick={() => navigate(-1)}>
              Batal (Esc)
            </Button>
            <Text type="secondary" style={{ marginLeft: 8 }}>
              <ThunderboltOutlined /> Setelah simpan, form siap untuk entri
              berikutnya
            </Text>
          </Space>
        </Form>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
};

// ============================================
// Master entities
// ============================================

export interface Category {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  createdAt: string;
}

export interface Supplier {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  contact: string | null;
  phone: string | null;
  address: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
}

export type StockStatus = "safe" | "low" | "out";

export interface Product {
  id: number;
  code: string;
  name: string;

import dayjs from "dayjs";
import "dayjs/locale/id";

dayjs.locale("id");

export const formatRupiah = (value: number | null | undefined): string =>
  new Intl.NumberFormat("id-ID", {
    style: "currency",
    currency: "IDR",
    minimumFractionDigits: 0,
  }).format(value ?? 0);

export const formatNumber = (value: number | null | undefined): string =>
  new Intl.NumberFormat("id-ID").format(value ?? 0);

export const formatDate = (date: string | Date): string =>
  dayjs(date).format("DD MMM YYYY");

export const formatFullDate = (date: string | Date): string =>
  dayjs(date).format("dddd, DD MMMM YYYY");

export const formatShortDate = (date: string | Date): string =>
  dayjs(date).format("DD/MM");

import type { Product, StockExit, StockExitItem } from "../types";

// ============================================
// Product — DB row → Product
// ============================================
export const mapProduct = (row: Record<string, unknown>): Product => ({
  id: row.id as number,
  code: row.kode as string,
  name: row.nama as string,
  size: (row.ukuran as string) ?? null,
  specification: (row.spesifikasi as string) ?? null,
  category: (row.kategori as string) ?? "Material",
  categoryId: null,
  categoryName: null,
  unit: (row.satuan as string) ?? "pcs",
  stock: (row.stok as number) ?? 0,
  minStock: 0,
  costPrice: 0,
  status: undefined,
  createdAt: (row.created_at as string) ?? new Date().toISOString(),
});

// ============================================
// Stock Exit — group by nomor_transaksi
// ============================================
interface StockExitRow {
  id: number;
  nomor_transaksi: string | null;
  barang_id: number;
  nama_pekerja: string | null;
  nama_barang: string;
  ukuran_barang: string | null;
  satuan_barang: string | null;
  jumlah_barang_keluar: number;
  tujuan: string | null;
  is_breakdown: boolean | null;
  created_at: string;
}

export const mapStockExits = (rows: StockExitRow[]): StockExit[] => {
  const grouped = new Map<string, StockExit>();

  for (const row of rows) {
    const key = row.nomor_transaksi ?? `temp-${row.id}`;

    if (!grouped.has(key)) {
      const created = new Date(row.created_at);
      grouped.set(key, {
        id: row.id,
        nomorTransaksi: key,
        timestamp: row.created_at,
        date: created.toISOString().split("T")[0],
        time: created.toISOString().slice(11, 16),
        person: row.nama_pekerja ?? "-",
        destination: row.tujuan,
        isBreakdown: row.is_breakdown ?? true,
        items: [],
      });
    }

    const item: StockExitItem = {
      itemId: row.barang_id,
      itemName: row.nama_barang,
      size: row.ukuran_barang,
      unit: row.satuan_barang ?? "pcs",
      quantity: row.jumlah_barang_keluar,
    };

    grouped.get(key)!.items.push(item);
  }

  return Array.from(grouped.values());
};

const FILENAME = "databarang.xlsx";

// Kata-kata yang dianggap "kata umum" → ambil 2 kata
// Kata lain → ambil 1 kata saja
// Silakan tambah/edit sesuai kebutuhan
const GENERIC_WORDS = new Set([
  "mata",

// ============================================
// 1. Cek file
// ============================================
if (!fs.existsSync(FILENAME)) {
  console.error(`❌ File "${FILENAME}" tidak ditemukan`);
  process.exit(1);
}

// ============================================
// 2. Baca Excel
// ============================================
const wb = XLSX.readFile(FILENAME);
const sheetName = wb.SheetNames[0];
const ws = wb.Sheets[sheetName];

const allRows = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(ws, {
  header: 1,
  defval: "",
  blankrows: false,
});

console.log(`📖 Baca file: ${FILENAME}`);
console.log(`📄 Sheet: ${sheetName}`);
console.log(`📊 Total baris: ${allRows.length}\n`);

// ============================================
// 3. Auto-detect header
// ============================================
let headerRowIndex = -1;
const cols = {
  no: -1,
  nama: -1,
  ukuran: -1,
  stock: -1,
  satuan: -1,
  kategori: -1,
};

for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(20, allRows.length); i++) {
  const row = allRows[i];
  const rowLower = row.map((c) => String(c).toLowerCase().trim());
  const namaIdx = rowLower.findIndex((c) => c === "nama barang");

  if (namaIdx >= 0) {
    headerRowIndex = i;
    rowLower.forEach((cell, idx) => {
      if (cell === "no") cols.no = idx;
      if (cell === "nama barang") cols.nama = idx;
      if (cell === "ukuran") cols.ukuran = idx;
      if (cell === "stock awal" || cell === "stok awal") cols.stock = idx;
      if (cell === "satuan") cols.satuan = idx;
      if (cell === "kategori") cols.kategori = idx;
    });
    break;
  }
}

if (headerRowIndex < 0) {
  console.error("❌ Header 'Nama Barang' tidak ditemukan");
  process.exit(1);
}

console.log(`📌 Header di baris ke-${headerRowIndex + 1}\n`);

// ============================================
// 4. Fungsi ekstrak jenis
// ============================================
function extractType(nama) {
  // Bersihkan karakter khusus di depan
  let clean = nama.trim().replace(/^[-.\s]+/, "");

  // Split by spasi & dash
  const words = clean.split(/[\s\-]+/).filter(Boolean);

  if (words.length === 0) return "UNKNOWN";
  if (words.length === 1) return words[0].toUpperCase();

  // Kalau kata pertama 1 huruf (misal "U-bolt" → "U")
  // → ambil 2 kata
  if (words[0].length === 1) {
    return `${words[0]} ${words[1]}`.toUpperCase();
  }

  const firstLower = words[0].toLowerCase();

  // Kalau kata pertama generic → ambil 2 kata
  if (GENERIC_WORDS.has(firstLower)) {
    return `${words[0]} ${words[1]}`.toUpperCase();
  }

  // Default: 1 kata
  return words[0].toUpperCase();
}

// ============================================
// 5. Parse data
// ============================================
const products = [];

for (let i = headerRowIndex + 1; i < allRows.length; i++) {
  const row = allRows[i];
  const nama = String(row[cols.nama] || "").trim();
  const ukuran = cols.ukuran >= 0 ? String(row[cols.ukuran] || "").trim() : "";
  const satuan =
    cols.satuan >= 0 ? String(row[cols.satuan] || "pcs").trim() : "pcs";
  const kategori =
    cols.kategori >= 0 ? String(row[cols.kategori] || "").trim() : "";

  if (!nama || !kategori) continue;
  if (!["Material", "Alat Bantu"].includes(kategori)) continue;

  products.push({
    nama,
    ukuran: ukuran || null,
    satuan: satuan || "pcs",
    stok: 0,
    kategori,
  });
}

// ============================================
// 6. Generate kode per jenis
// ============================================
const typeCounters = {};

const productsWithCode = products.map((p) => {
  const type = extractType(p.nama);
  typeCounters[type] = (typeCounters[type] || 0) + 1;

  const kode = `${type.replace(/\s+/g, "-")}-${String(typeCounters[type]).padStart(3, "0")}`;

  return {
    kode,
    nama: p.nama,
    ukuran: p.ukuran,
    satuan: p.satuan,
    stok: p.stok,
    kategori: p.kategori,
  };
});

// ============================================
// 7. Report
// ============================================
console.log(`📊 Total produk: ${productsWithCode.length}`);
console.log(`📦 Total jenis   : ${Object.keys(typeCounters).length}\n`);

console.log("📋 Top 20 jenis terbanyak:");
console.log("─".repeat(60));
const sorted = Object.entries(typeCounters).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
sorted.slice(0, 20).forEach(([type, count]) => {
  console.log(`   ${type.padEnd(30)} ${String(count).padStart(4)} item`);
});
if (sorted.length > 20) {
  console.log(`   ... dan ${sorted.length - 20} jenis lainnya\n`);
} else {
  console.log("");
}

console.log("📋 Sample 15 pertama:");
console.log("─".repeat(100));
productsWithCode.slice(0, 15).forEach((p, i) => {
  console.log(
    `${String(i + 1).padStart(3)}. ${p.kode.padEnd(25)} | ${p.nama.padEnd(32)} | ${String(p.ukuran ?? "-").padEnd(15)} | ${p.satuan}`,
  );
});

console.log("\n📋 Sample per jenis (5 jenis):");
console.log("─".repeat(100));
const sampleTypes = sorted.slice(0, 5).map(([t]) => t);
sampleTypes.forEach((type) => {
  const items = productsWithCode.filter((p) =>
    p.kode.startsWith(type.replace(/\s+/g, "-")),
  );
  console.log(`\n🔖 ${type}:`);
  items.slice(0, 3).forEach((p) => {
    console.log(
      `   ${p.kode.padEnd(25)} | ${p.nama.padEnd(32)} | ${p.ukuran ?? "-"}`,
    );
  });
  if (items.length > 3) {
    console.log(`   ... (${items.length} total)`);
  }
});

// ============================================
// 8. Simpan ke JSON
// ============================================
fs.writeFileSync("products.json", JSON.stringify(productsWithCode, null, 2));
console.log(
  `\n💾 Disimpan ke products.json (${productsWithCode.length} produk)`,
);

FILE: copy-project.cjs

const fs = require("node:fs");
const path = require("node:path");

const ROOT_DIR = path.resolve(__dirname);
const OUTPUT_FILE = path.join(ROOT_DIR, "admin-stok-dump.txt");

const SKIP_DIRS = new Set([
  "node_modules",
  ".git",
  "dist",
  "build",
]);

const chunks = [];

function isEnvFile(filename) {
  return filename === ".env" || filename.startsWith(".env.");
}

function isBinary(buffer) {
  // Deteksi byte NUL yang umum pada file biner
  return buffer.includes(0);
}

function walkDirectory(dir) {
  const entries = fs.readdirSync(dir, {
    withFileTypes: true,
  });

  for (const entry of entries) {
    const fullPath = path.join(dir, entry.name);

    if (entry.isDirectory()) {
      if (SKIP_DIRS.has(entry.name)) continue;

      walkDirectory(fullPath);
      continue;
    }

    if (!entry.isFile()) continue;

    // Jangan salin file environment atau file output
    if (isEnvFile(entry.name)) continue;
    if (fullPath === OUTPUT_FILE) continue;

    const relativePath = path.relative(ROOT_DIR, fullPath);
    const buffer = fs.readFileSync(fullPath);

    // Lewati file biner, misalnya gambar dan font
    if (isBinary(buffer)) {
      console.log(`SKIP binary: ${relativePath}`);
      continue;
    }

    const content = buffer.toString("utf8");

    chunks.push([
      "=".repeat(80),
      `FILE: ${relativePath}`,
      "=".repeat(80),
      content,
      "",
      "",
    ].join("\n"));

    console.log(`Copied: ${relativePath}`);
  }
}

try {
  walkDirectory(ROOT_DIR);

  fs.writeFileSync(
    OUTPUT_FILE,
    chunks.join("\n"),
    "utf8"
  );

  console.log(`\nSelesai! ${chunks.length} file disalin.`);
  console.log(`Output: ${OUTPUT_FILE}`);
} catch (error) {
  console.error("Gagal menyalin file:", error.message);
  process.exitCode = 1;
}

FILE: debug.cjs
================================================================================
const XLSX = require("xlsx");

// 1. Cek file ada
const fs = require("fs");
const files = fs.readdirSync(".").filter((f) => f.endsWith(".xlsx"));
console.log("📁 File .xlsx di folder ini:", files);

if (files.length === 0) {
  console.error("❌ Tidak ada file .xlsx di folder ini!");
  process.exit(1);
}

const filename = files[0];
console.log(`\n📖 Baca file: ${filename}\n`);

// 2. Baca workbook
const wb = XLSX.readFile(filename);
console.log("📄 Sheet names:", wb.SheetNames);
console.log("");

// 3. Ambil sheet pertama
const sheetName = wb.SheetNames[0];
const ws = wb.Sheets[sheetName];
console.log(`📄 Menggunakan sheet: ${sheetName}\n`);

// 4. Baca 10 baris pertama sebagai array 2D
const rows = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(ws, {
  header: 1,
  defval: "",
  blankrows: true,
});

console.log(`📊 Total baris: ${rows.length}\n`);
console.log("📋 10 baris pertama:");
console.log("─".repeat(100));

for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(10, rows.length); i++) {
  const row = rows[i];
  console.log(`Row ${i}:`, JSON.stringify(row));
}

console.log("─".repeat(100));

FILE: generate.cjs

const fs = require('fs');

// 1. Baca data Master Produk
const products = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('products.json', 'utf-8'));

// Fungsi untuk konversi format tanggal Indonesia ke YYYY-MM-DD
function parseDate(indoDateStr) {
    if (!indoDateStr) return null;
    const months = {
        "Januari": "01", "Februari": "02", "Maret": "03", "April": "04",
        "Mei": "05", "Juni": "06", "Juli": "07", "Agustus": "08",
        "September": "09", "Oktober": "10", "November": "11", "Desember": "12"
    };
    for (const [name, num] of Object.entries(months)) {
        if (indoDateStr.includes(name)) {
            const parts = indoDateStr.replace(name, num).split(' ');
            if (parts.length >= 3) {
                return `${parts[2]}-${parts[1]}-${parts[0].padStart(2, '0')}`;
            }
        }
    }
    return indoDateStr;
}

// Fungsi untuk mencari kecocokan barang di surat jalan dengan database produk
function findProduct(nama, ukuran) {
    if (!nama) return null;
    const nameLower = nama.toLowerCase().trim();
    const sizeLower = ukuran && ukuran !== '-' ? ukuran.toLowerCase().trim() : '';

    // Cari berdasarkan nama
    const candidates = products.filter(p => 
        p.nama.toLowerCase().trim() === nameLower || 
        nameLower.includes(p.nama.toLowerCase().trim())
    );

    if (candidates.length > 0) {
        // Jika ada ukuran, coba cocokkan ukurannya
        if (sizeLower) {
            const sizeMatch = candidates.find(c => 
                (c.ukuran || '').toLowerCase().includes(sizeLower) || 
                sizeLower.includes((c.ukuran || '').toLowerCase())
            );
            if (sizeMatch) return sizeMatch;
        }
        return candidates[0]; // Kembalikan kecocokan pertama jika ukuran tidak ada/tidak cocok
    }
    return null;
}

// Fungsi utama untuk memproses file text surat jalan (format TSV / Tab-Separated)
function processSuratJalan(filename) {
    const content = fs.readFileSync(filename, 'utf-8');
    const lines = content.split('\n').map(l => l.trim()).filter(l => l);

    // Cari baris header untuk dilewati
    let headerIdx = lines.findIndex(l => l.startsWith('No.') || l.includes('No.PO'));
    if (headerIdx === -1) return [];

    const records = [];
    for (let i = headerIdx + 1; i < lines.length; i++) {
        const parts = lines[i].split('\t'); // Pisahkan berdasarkan TAB
        
        if (parts.length >= 8) { 
            const nama_barang = parts[2]?.trim();
            const merk = parts[3]?.trim();
            const ukuran = parts[4]?.trim();
            const spesifikasi = parts[5]?.trim();
            const jml = parseInt(parts[6]?.trim() || '0', 10);
            const satuan = parts[7]?.trim();
            const tgl_kirim = parts[8]?.trim();

            const prod = findProduct(nama_barang, ukuran);

            records.push({
                kode_barang: prod ? prod.kode : null,
                nama_barang: prod ? prod.nama : nama_barang,
                ukuran_barang: prod ? prod.ukuran : (ukuran !== '-' ? ukuran : null),
                spesifikasi_barang: spesifikasi !== '-' ? spesifikasi : null,
                satuan_barang: prod ? prod.satuan : satuan,
                kategori: prod ? prod.kategori : "Material",
                jumlah_barang_masuk: jml,
                tanggal_pengiriman: parseDate(tgl_kirim),
                keterangan: (merk && merk !== '-') ? `Merk: ${merk}` : null
            });
        }
    }
    return records;
}

// ==========================================
// EKSEKUSI
// ==========================================
try {
    console.log("⏳ Membaca file surat jalan...");
    const sj1 = processSuratJalan('suratjalan05092026.txt');
    const sj2 = processSuratJalan('suratjalan28072026.txt');

    const gabungan = [...sj1, ...sj2];
    
    // Tambahkan ID
    const finalData = gabungan.map((item, idx) => ({ id: idx + 1, ...item }));

    // Simpan ke file
    fs.writeFileSync('gabungan_masuk.json', JSON.stringify(finalData, null, 2));
    
    console.log(`✅ BERHASIL! File 'gabungan_masuk.json' telah dibuat dengan total ${finalData.length} data.`);
} catch (error) {
    console.error("❌ Terjadi kesalahan:", error.message);
    console.log("Pastikan file products.json, suratjalan05092026.txt, dan suratjalan28072026.txt ada di folder yang sama.");
}

const { createClient } = require("@supabase/supabase-js");
const fs = require("fs");
require("dotenv").config();

const SUPABASE_URL = process.env.SUPABASE_URL;
const SUPABASE_KEY = process.env.SUPABASE_KEY;

if (!SUPABASE_URL || !SUPABASE_KEY) {
  console.error("❌ SUPABASE_URL atau SUPABASE_KEY belum diisi di .env");
  process.exit(1);
}

const supabase = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_KEY);

// ============================================
// 1. Baca products.json
// ============================================
if (!fs.existsSync("products.json")) {
  console.error("❌ File products.json tidak ditemukan");
  console.error("   Jalankan dulu: node convert.cjs");
  process.exit(1);
}

const rawProducts = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("products.json", "utf8"));

// Mapping JSON → schema baru
const products = rawProducts.map((p) => ({
  kode: p.kode,
  nama: p.nama,
  ukuran: p.ukuran ?? null,
  spesifikasi: null, // ← kosong dulu, diisi manual nanti
  satuan: p.satuan ?? "pcs",
  stok: p.stok ?? 0,
  kategori: p.kategori ?? "Material",
}));

console.log(`📦 Total produk: ${products.length}`);
console.log(
  `   ├─ Material   : ${products.filter((p) => p.kategori === "Material").length}`,
);
console.log(
  `   └─ Alat Bantu : ${products.filter((p) => p.kategori === "Alat Bantu").length}\n`,
);

// ============================================
// 2. Insert batch
// ============================================
async function main() {
  const BATCH = 100;
  let total = 0;
  let failed = 0;

  console.log("📤 Insert ke Supabase...\n");

  for (let i = 0; i < products.length; i += BATCH) {
    const batch = products.slice(i, i + BATCH);

    const { error } = await supabase.from("barang").insert(batch);

    if (error) {
      console.error(`❌ Batch ${Math.floor(i / BATCH) + 1}: ${error.message}`);
      failed += batch.length;
      continue;
    }

    total += batch.length;
    console.log(`✅ ${total}/${products.length}`);
  }

  console.log(`\n🎉 Selesai!`);
  console.log(`   Berhasil: ${total}`);
  console.log(`   Gagal:    ${failed}`);

  // Verifikasi
  const { count } = await supabase
    .from("barang")
    .select("*", { count: "exact", head: true });

  console.log(`\n📊 Total di database: ${count} baris`);
}

main().catch(console.error);

// Load dotenv agar bisa membaca file .env di root project
require('dotenv').config();

const { createClient } = require('@supabase/supabase-js');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

// ==========================================
// 1. Konfigurasi Supabase menggunakan .env
// ==========================================
// Kita ambil dari VITE_SUPABASE_URL dan VITE_SUPABASE_KEY
const SUPABASE_URL = process.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL; 
const SUPABASE_KEY = process.env.VITE_SUPABASE_KEY;

// Validasi jika .env kosong atau belum terisi
if (!SUPABASE_URL || !SUPABASE_KEY) {
  console.error("❌ ERROR: VITE_SUPABASE_URL atau VITE_SUPABASE_KEY tidak ditemukan di file .env!");
  console.log("Pastikan file .env ada di folder root project dan berisi kredensial yang benar.");
  process.exit(1);
}

const supabase = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_KEY);

async function insertData() {
  try {
    // ==========================================
    // 2. Tambahkan Bitumen Tape ke tabel 'barang'
    // ==========================================
    console.log("⏳ Memeriksa/menambahkan Bitumen Tape ke tabel 'barang'...");
    
    const { data: existingBitumen, error: checkError } = await supabase
      .from('barang')
      .select('kode')
      .eq('kode', 'BITUMEN-001')
      .single();

    if (checkError && checkError.code !== 'PGRST116') {
         // PGRST116 = Data tidak ditemukan (ini wajar). Error lain berarti ada masalah koneksi/tabel
         console.error('❌ Gagal cek barang:', checkError.message);
    }

    if (!existingBitumen) {
      const { error: insertBitumenError } = await supabase
        .from('barang')
        .insert({
          kode: 'BITUMEN-001',
          nama: 'Bitumen Tape',
          ukuran: '100mm x 10m',
          spesifikasi: null,
          satuan: 'roll',
          stok: 0,
          kategori: 'Material'
        });

      if (insertBitumenError) {
        console.error('❌ Gagal menambahkan Bitumen Tape:', insertBitumenError.message);
      } else {
        console.log('✅ Bitumen Tape (BITUMEN-001) berhasil ditambahkan ke tabel barang!');
      }
    } else {
      console.log('ℹ️ Bitumen Tape sudah ada di tabel barang, melewati proses insert.');
    }

    // ==========================================
    // 3. Insert ke tabel 'barang_masuk'
    // ==========================================
    const jsonPath = path.join(__dirname, 'gabungan_masuk_final.json');
    if (!fs.existsSync(jsonPath)) {
        console.error(`❌ File tidak ditemukan: ${jsonPath}`);
        return;
    }

    const rawData = fs.readFileSync(jsonPath, 'utf-8');
    const dataMasuk = JSON.parse(rawData);

    console.log(`\n⏳ Menyiapkan ${dataMasuk.length} baris data barang masuk...`);

    const formattedData = dataMasuk.map((item) => {
      if (item.nama_barang.toLowerCase() === 'bitumen tape') {
        item.kode_barang = 'BITUMEN-001';
        item.satuan_barang = 'roll';
        item.kategori = 'Material';
      }

      return {
        kode_barang: item.kode_barang,
        nama_barang: item.nama_barang,
        ukuran_barang: item.ukuran_barang,
        spesifikasi_barang: item.spesifikasi_barang,
        satuan_barang: item.satuan_barang,
        kategori: item.kategori,
        jumlah_barang_masuk: item.jumlah_barang_masuk,
        tanggal_pengiriman: item.tanggal_pengiriman,
        keterangan: item.keterangan
      };
    });

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('barang_masuk')
      .insert(formattedData)
      .select();

    if (error) {
      console.error('❌ Terjadi kesalahan saat insert data masuk:', error.message);
      return;
    }

    console.log(`✅ BERHASIL! ${data.length} data sukses masuk ke tabel 'barang_masuk'.`);

  } catch (err) {
    console.error('❌ Gagal menjalankan skrip:', err);
  }
}

insertData();

FILE: nginx.conf

server {
    listen 80;
    server_name _;
    root /usr/share/nginx/html;
    index index.html;

    gzip on;
    gzip_vary on;
    gzip_min_length 1024;
    gzip_types text/plain text/css text/javascript application/javascript application/json image/svg+xml;

    # Cache statis 1 tahun
    location ~* \.(js|css|png|jpg|jpeg|gif|ico|svg|woff|woff2|ttf|eot)$ {
        expires 1y;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, immutable";
        access_log off;
    }

    # SPA fallback — WAJIB
    location / {
        try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;
        add_header Cache-Control "no-cache";
    }

    # Health check
    location /health {
        access_log off;
        return 200 "ok\n";
        add_header Content-Type text/plain;
    }
}

import { Refine } from "@refinedev/core";
import { RefineKbarProvider } from "@refinedev/kbar";
import routerProvider, {
  NavigateToResource,
  UnsavedChangesNotifier,
  DocumentTitleHandler,
} from "@refinedev/react-router-v6";
import { dataProvider, liveProvider } from "@refinedev/supabase";
import { BrowserRouter, Route, Routes, Outlet } from "react-router-dom";
import { useNotificationProvider, ErrorComponent } from "@refinedev/antd";
import { App as AntdApp, ConfigProvider } from "antd";
import {
  DashboardOutlined,
  AppstoreOutlined,
  AppstoreAddOutlined,
  FileTextOutlined,
} from "@ant-design/icons";
import "@refinedev/antd/dist/reset.css";

import { supabaseClient } from "./utility/supabaseClient";
import { USE_MOCK } from "./utility/config";
import { DashboardPage } from "./pages/dashboard";
import { InventoryPage } from "./pages/inventory";
import { LoginPage } from "./pages/login";
import { ProductCreatePage } from "./pages/products/create";
import { EntryPage } from "./pages/entry";
import { MonitoringSPBPage } from "./pages/monitoring-spb"; // ✅ Import halaman SPB
import { AdminLayout } from "./components/layout/AdminLayout";
import { authProvider } from "./authProvider";

const mockDataProvider = {
  getList: async () => ({ data: [], total: 0 }),
  getOne: async () => ({ data: {} }),
  create: async () => ({ data: {} }),
  update: async () => ({ data: {} }),
  deleteOne: async () => ({ data: {} }),
  getApiUrl: () => "",
  custom: async () => ({ data: {} }),
} as never;

function App() {
  const dataProviderConfig = USE_MOCK
    ? mockDataProvider
    : dataProvider(supabaseClient);

  const liveProviderConfig = USE_MOCK
    ? undefined
    : liveProvider(supabaseClient);

  return (
    <BrowserRouter>
      <ConfigProvider
        theme={{ token: { borderRadius: 8, colorPrimary: "#1677ff" } }}
      >
        <AntdApp>
          <RefineKbarProvider>
            <Refine
              dataProvider={dataProviderConfig}
              liveProvider={liveProviderConfig}
              routerProvider={routerProvider}
              notificationProvider={useNotificationProvider}
              authProvider={authProvider}
              options={{
                syncWithLocation: true,
                warnWhenUnsavedChanges: true,
                projectId: "admin-stock",
                title: { text: "Admin Stock" },
              }}
              resources={[
                {
                  name: "dashboard",
                  list: "/dashboard",
                  meta: {
                    label: "Dashboard",
                    icon: <DashboardOutlined />,
                  },
                },
                {
                  name: "monitoring-spb",
                  list: "/monitoring-spb",
                  meta: {
                    label: "Monitoring SPB",
                    icon: <FileTextOutlined />,
                  },
                },
                {
                  name: "products-create",
                  list: "/products/create",
                  meta: {
                    label: "Tambah Barang +",
                    icon: <AppstoreAddOutlined />,
                  },
                },
                {
                  name: "inventory",
                  list: "/inventory",
                  meta: {
                    label: "Data Persediaan",
                    icon: <AppstoreOutlined />,
                  },
                },
              ]}
            >
              <Routes>
                <Route
                  element={
                    <AdminLayout>
                      <Outlet />
                    </AdminLayout>
                  }
                >
                  <Route index element={<NavigateToResource resource="dashboard" />} />
                  <Route path="/dashboard" element={<DashboardPage />} />
                  <Route path="/monitoring-spb" element={<MonitoringSPBPage />} />
                  <Route path="/products/create" element={<ProductCreatePage />} />
                  <Route path="/inventory" element={<InventoryPage />} />
                  <Route path="/entry" element={<EntryPage />} />
                </Route>

                <Route path="/login" element={<LoginPage />} />
                <Route path="*" element={<ErrorComponent />} />
              </Routes>

              <UnsavedChangesNotifier />
              <DocumentTitleHandler />
            </Refine>
          </RefineKbarProvider>
        </AntdApp>
      </ConfigProvider>
    </BrowserRouter>
  );
}

export default App;

FILE: src/authProvider.ts
================================================================================
import type {
  AuthProvider,
  AuthActionResponse,
  CheckResponse,
} from "@refinedev/core";
import { supabaseClient } from "./utility/supabaseClient";
import { USE_MOCK } from "./utility/config";

const MOCK_USER = {
  email: "admin@admin.com",
  password: "admin123",
  name: "Administrator",
};

const STORAGE_KEY = "mock-auth-user";

const getMockUser = () => {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};

export const authProvider: AuthProvider = {
  login: async ({ email, password }): Promise<AuthActionResponse> => {
    if (USE_MOCK) {
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400));
      if (email === MOCK_USER.email && password === MOCK_USER.password) {
        localStorage.setItem(
          STORAGE_KEY,
          JSON.stringify({ email, name: MOCK_USER.name, role: "admin" }),
        );
        return { success: true, redirectTo: "/dashboard" };
      }
      return {
        success: false,
        error: {
          name: "LoginError",
          message: "Email atau password salah",
        },
      };
    }

    const { data, error } = await supabaseClient.auth.signInWithPassword({
      email,
      password,
    });

    if (error) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: { name: "LoginError", message: error.message },
      };
    }
    if (!data?.user) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: { name: "LoginError", message: "User tidak ditemukan" },
      };
    }
    return { success: true, redirectTo: "/dashboard" };
  },

  logout: async (): Promise<AuthActionResponse> => {
    if (USE_MOCK) {
      localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      return { success: true, redirectTo: "/dashboard" };
    }
    await supabaseClient.auth.signOut();
    return { success: true, redirectTo: "/dashboard" };
  },

  // ✅ Selalu izinkan akses agar User (Public) bisa melihat stok tanpa harus login
  check: async (): Promise<CheckResponse> => {
    return { authenticated: true };
  },

  getIdentity: async () => {
    if (USE_MOCK) {
      const user = getMockUser();
      if (user) {
        return {
          id: "admin-1",
          name: user.name,
          email: user.email,
          role: "admin",
        };
      }
      return {
        id: "public-user",
        name: "User (Public)",
        email: "",
        role: "user",
      };
    }

    const { data } = await supabaseClient.auth.getUser();
    if (data?.user) {
      return {
        id: data.user.id,
        name: data.user.email?.split("@")[0] ?? "Admin",
        email: data.user.email,
        role: "admin",
      };
    }

    return {
      id: "public-user",
      name: "User (Public)",
      email: "",
      role: "user",
    };
  },

  getPermissions: async () => {
    if (USE_MOCK) {
      const user = getMockUser();
      return user ? ["admin"] : ["user"];
    }
    const { data } = await supabaseClient.auth.getSession();
    return data.session ? ["admin"] : ["user"];
  },

  onError: async (error) => {
    return { error };
  },
};
