import { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { Input, Modal, Spin, Empty, Tag, Typography } from "antd";
import { SearchOutlined } from "@ant-design/icons";
import { useKeyboardShortcut } from "../../hooks/useKeyboardShortcut";
import { useProductSearch } from "../../hooks/useProductSearch";
import type { Product } from "../../types";

const { Text } = Typography;

export const GlobalSearch = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [keyword, setKeyword] = useState("");
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(0);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const { products, isLoading } = useProductSearch(keyword);

  // Reset state saat modal terbuka
  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setKeyword("");
      setActiveIndex(0);
      setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 50);
    }
  }, [open]);

  // Clamp active index saat hasil berubah
  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeIndex >= products.length) setActiveIndex(0);
  }, [products.length, activeIndex]);

  const handleSelect = useCallback(
    (product: Product) => {
      setOpen(false);
      navigate(`/stock-entries/create?productId=${product.id}`);
    },
    [navigate],
  );

  // ⌨️ Space → buka palette (kecuali sedang mengetik di input)
  useKeyboardShortcut({
    key: " ",
    ignoreInputs: true,
    enabled: !open,
    handler: () => setOpen(true),
  });

  // ⌨️ Ctrl+K → buka palette juga (opsional, umum dipakai)
  useKeyboardShortcut({
    key: "k",
    ctrlKey: true,
    enabled: !open,
    handler: () => setOpen(true),
  });

  const handleKeyDown = (event: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (event.key === "ArrowDown") {
      event.preventDefault();
      setActiveIndex((i) => Math.min(i + 1, products.length - 1));
    } else if (event.key === "ArrowUp") {
      event.preventDefault();
      setActiveIndex((i) => Math.max(i - 1, 0));
    } else if (event.key === "Enter") {
      event.preventDefault();
      const selected = products[activeIndex];
      if (selected) handleSelect(selected);
    } else if (event.key === "Escape") {
      event.preventDefault();
      setOpen(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onCancel={() => setOpen(false)}
      footer={null}
      closable={false}
      width={560}
      destroyOnClose
      styles={{ body: { padding: 0 } }}
      style={{ top: 80 }}
    >
      <div style={{ padding: 12, borderBottom: "1px solid #f0f0f0" }}>
        <Input
          ref={inputRef as never}
          size="large"
          prefix={<SearchOutlined />}
          placeholder="Cari produk berdasarkan nama atau kode..."
          value={keyword}
          onChange={(e) => setKeyword(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
          variant="borderless"
          autoFocus
        />
      </div>

      <div style={{ maxHeight: 360, overflowY: "auto", padding: 8 }}>
        {isLoading && (
          <div style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: 24 }}>
            <Spin />
          </div>
        )}

        {!isLoading && products.length === 0 && (
          <Empty
            description="Produk tidak ditemukan"
            image={Empty.PRESENTED_IMAGE_SIMPLE}
            style={{ padding: 24 }}
          />
        )}

        {!isLoading &&
          products.map((product, index) => (
            <div
              key={product.id}
              onMouseEnter={() => setActiveIndex(index)}
              onClick={() => handleSelect(product)}
              style={{
                padding: "10px 12px",
                borderRadius: 8,
                cursor: "pointer",
                display: "flex",
                alignItems: "center",
                justifyContent: "space-between",
                gap: 12,
                background:
                  index === activeIndex ? "#e6f4ff" : "transparent",
              }}
            >
              <div style={{ minWidth: 0, flex: 1 }}>
                <div style={{ fontWeight: 500, fontSize: 14 }}>
                  {product.name}
                </div>
                <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                  {product.code} · Stok: {product.stock} {product.unit}
                </Text>
              </div>
              <Tag color="blue" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
                Input
              </Tag>
            </div>
          ))}
      </div>

      <div
        style={{
          padding: "8px 16px",
          borderTop: "1px solid #f0f0f0",
          display: "flex",
          gap: 16,
          fontSize: 12,
          color: "#8c8c8c",
        }}
      >
        <span>↑↓ navigasi</span>
        <span>↵ pilih</span>
        <span>esc tutup</span>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
};

import { Card, Empty, Skeleton } from "antd";

export const StockInChart = () => {
  const { items, isLoading } = useStockInChart(30);

  if (isLoading) {

      <Card
        title="📈 Barang Masuk 30 Hari Terakhir"
        style={{ borderRadius: 12 }}
      >
        <Skeleton active paragraph={{ rows: 6 }} />

  return (

          },
        }}

FILE: src/components/entry/SetupWizard.tsx
================================================================================
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  AutoComplete,
  Button,
  Card,
  Input,
  Modal,
  Space,
  Steps,
  Tag,
  Typography,
} from "antd";
import { SearchOutlined, UserOutlined, EnvironmentOutlined } from "@ant-design/icons";
import type { Person, Workplace } from "../../types/entry";

const { Title, Text } = Typography;

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  step: "person" | "workplace";
  title: string;
  placeholder: string;
  options: readonly (Person | Workplace)[];
  onSelect: (value: Person | Workplace) => void;
  onBack?: () => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

const STEP_INDEX: Record<"person" | "workplace", number> = {
  person: 0,
  workplace: 1,
};

export const SetupWizard = ({
  open,
  step,
  title,
  placeholder,
  options,
  onSelect,
  onBack,
  onClose,
}: Props) => {
  const [keyword, setKeyword] = useState("");
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setKeyword("");
      setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 100);
    }
  }, [open, step]);

  const filtered = options.filter((o) =>
    o.name.toLowerCase().includes(keyword.trim().toLowerCase()),
  );

  const handleEnter = () => {
    if (filtered.length > 0) {
      onSelect(filtered[0]);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onCancel={onClose}
      footer={null}
      closable
      maskClosable
      keyboard
      width={520}
      styles={{ body: { padding: 0 } }}
      style={{ top: 80 }}
    >
      <Card
        variant="borderless"
        style={{ borderRadius: 16 }}
        styles={{ body: { padding: 24 } }}
      >
        <Steps
          current={STEP_INDEX[step]}
          size="small"
          items={[
            { title: "Nama Pekerja", icon: <UserOutlined /> },
            { title: "Lokasi Pekerjaan", icon: <EnvironmentOutlined /> },
          ]}
          style={{ marginBottom: 20 }}
        />

        <Title level={4} style={{ marginBottom: 4 }}>
          {title}
        </Title>

        <div style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
          <AutoComplete
            value={keyword}
            onChange={setKeyword}
            options={filtered.map((o) => ({
              value: o.name,
              label: o.name,
              data: o,
            }))}
            onSelect={(_, option) => {
              const data = (option as { data: Person | Workplace }).data;
              onSelect(data);
            }}
            style={{ width: "100%" }}
            placeholder={placeholder}
          >
            <Input
              ref={inputRef as never}
              size="large"
              prefix={<SearchOutlined />}
              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                if (e.key === "Enter") {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  handleEnter();
                } else if (e.key === "Escape" && onBack) {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  onBack();
                }
              }}
              autoFocus
            />
          </AutoComplete>
        </div>

        {/* Tombol Pilihan Cepat (Sangat memudahkan di Mobile & Desktop) */}
        <div style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
          <Space size={[8, 8]} wrap>
            {filtered.map((item) => (
              <Button
                key={item.id}
                size="middle"
                style={{ borderRadius: 8, fontWeight: 500 }}
                onClick={() => onSelect(item)}
              >
                {item.name}
              </Button>
            ))}
          </Space>
        </div>

        <Space style={{ marginTop: 20 }} size="small" wrap>
          <Tag>Enter</Tag>
          <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
            pilih item pertama
          </Text>
          {onBack && (
            <>
              <Tag style={{ cursor: "pointer" }} onClick={onBack}>
                Esc / Kembali
              </Tag>
              <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                kembali ke pilih nama
              </Text>
            </>
          )}
        </Space>
      </Card>
    </Modal>
  );
};

FILE: src/components/inventory/InventoryTable.tsx
================================================================================
import { useState } from "react";
import { Table, Typography, Tag, Space, Card, Input } from "antd";
import { formatNumber } from "../../utility/format";
import { SendOutlined, UserOutlined, SearchOutlined } from "@ant-design/icons";
import type { Product, StockExit } from "../../types";

const { Text } = Typography;

type TableType = "stock" | "outbound";

interface BaseProps {
  type: TableType;
  loading?: boolean;
}

interface StockProps extends BaseProps {
  type: "stock";
  dataSource: Product[];
}

interface OutboundProps extends BaseProps {
  type: "outbound";
  dataSource: StockExit[];
}

type InventoryTableProps = StockProps | OutboundProps;

export const InventoryTable = (props: InventoryTableProps) => {
  const { type, loading } = props;
  const [searchText, setSearchText] = useState("");

  const stockColumns = [
    { 
      dataIndex: "name", 
      title: "Nama Item",
      render: (v: string) => <Text strong style={{ fontSize: 14 }}>{v}</Text>
    },
    {
      dataIndex: "size",
      title: "Ukuran",
      width: 200,
      render: (v: string | null) => v ? <Text type="secondary">{v}</Text> : "-",
    },
    {
      dataIndex: "stock",
      title: "Stok Tersedia",
      width: 160,
      align: "right" as const,
      defaultSortOrder: "descend" as const,
      sorter: (a: Product, b: Product) => a.stock - b.stock,
      render: (v: number, r: Product) => (
        <Tag color={v > 0 ? "blue" : "red"} style={{ fontSize: 13, padding: "2px 8px" }}>
          {formatNumber(v)} {r.unit}
        </Tag>
      ),
    },
  ];

  const outboundColumns = [
    {
      title: "Waktu",
      dataIndex: "time",
      width: 100,
      render: (v: string) => <Text strong style={{ color: "#1677ff" }}>{v}</Text>,
    },
    {
      title: "Nama Item",
      dataIndex: "itemName",
      render: (v: string, r: any) => (
        <Space direction="vertical" size={0}>
          <Text strong>{v}</Text>
          {r.size && <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>{r.size}</Text>}
        </Space>
      ),
    },
    {
      title: "Jumlah Keluar",
      dataIndex: "quantity",
      width: 140,
      align: "right" as const,
      render: (v: number, r: any) => (
        <Text strong style={{ color: "#ff4d4f", fontSize: 14 }}>
          {formatNumber(v)} <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>{r.unit}</Text>
        </Text>
      ),
    },
    {
      title: "Lokasi Pekerjaan",
      dataIndex: "destination",
      width: 200,
      render: (v: string | null) =>
        v ? <Tag icon={<SendOutlined />} color="cyan">{v}</Tag> : <Text type="secondary">-</Text>,
    },
    {
      title: "Pengambil (PIC)",
      dataIndex: "person",
      width: 180,
      render: (v: string) => (
        <Text style={{ fontSize: 13, color: "#595959" }}><UserOutlined /> {v}</Text>
      ),
    },
  ];

  let tableData: any[] = [];
  if (type === "stock") {
    tableData = (props as StockProps).dataSource;
    if (searchText) {
       tableData = tableData.filter(item => 
          item.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchText.toLowerCase()) || 
          (item.size && item.size.toLowerCase().includes(searchText.toLowerCase()))
       );
    }
  } else if (type === "outbound") {
    tableData = (props as OutboundProps).dataSource.flatMap((exit) =>
      exit.items.map((item) => ({
        ...item,
        transactionId: exit.id,
        time: exit.time,
        person: exit.person,
        destination: exit.destination,
      }))
    );
    if (searchText) {
       tableData = tableData.filter(item => 
          item.itemName.toLowerCase().includes(searchText.toLowerCase()) || 
          (item.size && item.size.toLowerCase().includes(searchText.toLowerCase())) ||
          item.person.toLowerCase().includes(searchText.toLowerCase())
       );
    }
  }

  return (
    <Card
      variant="borderless"
      style={{ borderRadius: 12, border: "1px solid #f0f0f0", overflow: "hidden" }}
      styles={{ body: { padding: 0 } }}
    >
      <div style={{ padding: "16px 20px", borderBottom: "1px solid #f0f0f0", background: "#fff" }}>
         <Input 
            placeholder="Cari berdasarkan nama atau ukuran..." 
            prefix={<SearchOutlined style={{ color: "#bfbfbf" }} />}
            allowClear
            size="large"
            value={searchText}
            onChange={e => setSearchText(e.target.value)}
            style={{ maxWidth: 400, borderRadius: 8 }}
         />
      </div>

      <Table
        dataSource={tableData}
        rowKey={(record: any) =>
          type === "stock" ? record.id : `${record.transactionId}-${record.itemId}`
        }
        loading={loading}
        pagination={{ pageSize: 20, size: "small", showSizeChanger: false }}
        size="middle"
        scroll={{ x: 750 }}
        columns={type === "stock" ? stockColumns : outboundColumns}
        rowClassName={(_, index) => index % 2 === 0 ? 'table-row-light' : 'table-row-dark'}
      />
      {/* Sedikit style tambahan untuk merapikan baris */}
      <style>{`
        .table-row-light { background-color: #ffffff; }
        .table-row-dark { background-color: #fafafa; }
        .ant-table-thead > tr > th { background: #f5f5f5 !important; font-weight: 600; }
      `}</style>
    </Card>
  );
};

FILE: src/hooks/useDashboardStats.ts
================================================================================
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { supabaseClient } from "../utility/supabaseClient";
import { TABLES } from "../utility/constants";
import { USE_MOCK } from "../utility/config";
import { getMockDashboardStats } from "../mocks/dashboard";
import type { DashboardStats } from "../types";

// ============================================
// Tipe return eksplisit
// ============================================
export interface UseDashboardStatsResult {
  stats: DashboardStats;
  isLoading: boolean;
  refetch: () => void;
}

const EMPTY_STATS: DashboardStats = {
  totalProducts: 0,
  totalStock: 0,
  todayInbound: 0,
  todayOutbound: 0,
};

export const useDashboardStats = (): UseDashboardStatsResult => {
  const query = useQuery<DashboardStats, Error, DashboardStats>({
    queryKey: ["dashboard-stats"],
    refetchInterval: USE_MOCK ? false : 60_000,
    queryFn: async (): Promise<DashboardStats> => {
      // === MODE MOCK ===
      if (USE_MOCK) {
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300));
        return getMockDashboardStats();
      }

      // === MODE SUPABASE ===
      const today = new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];

      const [productsRes, inboundRes, outboundRes] = await Promise.all([
        supabaseClient.from(TABLES.products).select("stok"),
        supabaseClient
          .from(TABLES.stockEntries)
          .select("jumlah")
          .eq("tanggal", today),
        supabaseClient
          .from(TABLES.stockExits)
          .select("items")
          .eq("date", today),
      ]);

      if (productsRes.error) throw productsRes.error;
      if (inboundRes.error) throw inboundRes.error;
      if (outboundRes.error) throw outboundRes.error;

      const totalProducts = productsRes.data?.length ?? 0;
      const totalStock =
        productsRes.data?.reduce(
          (sum, p: { stok: number | null }) => sum + (p.stok ?? 0),
          0,
        ) ?? 0;
      const todayInbound =
        inboundRes.data?.reduce(
          (sum, e: { jumlah: number | null }) => sum + (e.jumlah ?? 0),
          0,
        ) ?? 0;

      // Hitung total quantity dari items[] di stock exits
      const todayOutbound =
        outboundRes.data?.reduce(
          (sum, exit: { items: Array<{ quantity: number }> }) =>
            sum + (exit.items?.reduce((s, i) => s + (i.quantity ?? 0), 0) ?? 0),
          0,
        ) ?? 0;

      return { totalProducts, totalStock, todayInbound, todayOutbound };
    },
  });

  return {
    stats: query.data ?? EMPTY_STATS,
    isLoading: query.isLoading,
    refetch: query.refetch,
  };
};

FILE: src/hooks/useDebounce.ts
================================================================================
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";

export function useDebounce<T>(value: T, delay: number): T {
  const [debouncedValue, setDebouncedValue] = useState<T>(value);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = setTimeout(() => {
      setDebouncedValue(value);
    }, delay);

    return () => {
      clearTimeout(handler);
    };
  }, [value, delay]);

  return debouncedValue;
}

FILE: src/hooks/useEntryFlow.ts
================================================================================
import { useCallback, useState } from "react";
import { mockWorkplaces } from "../mocks/entry";
import { usePersons } from "./usePersons";
import type { EntryLine, Person, SetupStep, Workplace } from "../types/entry";
import type { Product } from "../types";

export type EntryPhase = "search" | "quantity";

export const useEntryFlow = () => {
  const [step, setStep] = useState<SetupStep>("person");
  const [person, setPerson] = useState<Person | null>(null);
  const [workplace, setWorkplace] = useState<Workplace | null>(null);
  const [wizardOpen, setWizardOpen] = useState(false);

  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<EntryPhase>("search");
  const [activeItem, setActiveItem] = useState<Product | null>(null);
  const [activeQty, setActiveQty] = useState(1);
  const [lines, setLines] = useState<EntryLine[]>([]);

  // ✅ Ambil data pekerja langsung dari Database
  const { persons } = usePersons();

  const wizardData = {
    person: {
      value: person,
      options: persons, // Pakai data dari DB
      placeholder: "Ketik atau pilih nama pekerja...",
      title: "Pilih Nama Pekerja",
    },
    workplace: {
      value: workplace,
      options: mockWorkplaces, // Tetap pakai hardcode lokal
      placeholder: "Ketik atau pilih lokasi pekerjaan...",
      title: "Pilih Lokasi Pekerjaan",
    },
  } as const;

  const currentWizardData =
    step === "done"
      ? { value: null, title: "", placeholder: "", options: [] }
      : wizardData[step as "person" | "workplace"];

  const openWizard = useCallback(() => {
    setStep("person");
    setWizardOpen(true);
  }, []);

  const closeWizard = useCallback(() => setWizardOpen(false), []);

  const selectWizardValue = useCallback(
    (value: Person | Workplace) => {
      if (step === "person") {
        setPerson(value as Person);
        setWorkplace(null);
        setStep("workplace");
      } else if (step === "workplace") {
        setWorkplace(value as Workplace);
        setStep("done");
        setWizardOpen(false);
      }
    },
    [step],
  );

  const resetSession = useCallback(() => {
    setStep("person");
    setPerson(null);
    setWorkplace(null);
    setPhase("search");
    setActiveItem(null);
    setActiveQty(1);
    setLines([]);
    setWizardOpen(false);
  }, []);

  const backWizard = useCallback(() => {
    if (step === "workplace") {
      setWorkplace(null);
      setStep("person");
    }
  }, [step]);

  const selectItem = useCallback((item: Product) => {
    setActiveItem(item);
    setActiveQty(1);
    setPhase("quantity");
  }, []);

  const confirmQuantity = useCallback(() => {
    if (!activeItem) return;
    setLines((prev) => {
      const idx = prev.findIndex((l) => l.itemId === activeItem.id);
      if (idx >= 0) {
        const copy = [...prev];
        copy[idx] = { ...copy[idx], quantity: copy[idx].quantity + activeQty };
        return copy;
      }
      return [
        ...prev,
        {
          itemId: activeItem.id,
          itemName: activeItem.name,
          unit: activeItem.unit,
          quantity: activeQty,
        },
      ];
    });
    setActiveItem(null);
    setActiveQty(1);
    setPhase("search");
  }, [activeItem, activeQty]);

  const cancelQuantity = useCallback(() => {
    setActiveItem(null);
    setActiveQty(1);
    setPhase("search");
  }, []);

  const removeLine = useCallback((itemId: number) => {
    setLines((prev) => prev.filter((l) => l.itemId !== itemId));
  }, []);

  const increaseQty = useCallback(() => setActiveQty((q) => q + 1), []);
  const decreaseQty = useCallback(
    () => setActiveQty((q) => Math.max(1, q - 1)),
    [],
  );

  return {
    step,
    person,
    workplace,
    currentWizardData,
    selectWizardValue,
    backWizard,
    wizardOpen,
    openWizard,
    closeWizard,
    phase,
    activeItem,
    activeQty,
    lines,
    selectItem,
    confirmQuantity,
    cancelQuantity,
    increaseQty,
    decreaseQty,
    setActiveQty,
    removeLine,
    resetSession,
    isReady: step === "done",
  };
};

FILE: src/hooks/useKeyboardShortcut.ts
================================================================================
import { useEffect } from "react";

interface UseKeyboardShortcutOptions {
  key: string;
  ctrlKey?: boolean;
  shiftKey?: boolean;
  altKey?: boolean;
  metaKey?: boolean;
  enabled?: boolean;
  preventDefault?: boolean;
  ignoreInputs?: boolean;
  handler: (event: KeyboardEvent) => void;
}

const isEditableElement = (el: EventTarget | null): boolean => {
  if (!(el instanceof HTMLElement)) return false;
  const tag = el.tagName.toLowerCase();
  return (
    tag === "input" ||
    tag === "textarea" ||
    tag === "select" ||
    el.isContentEditable
  );
};

export const useKeyboardShortcut = ({
  key,
  ctrlKey = false,
  shiftKey = false,
  altKey = false,
  metaKey = false,
  enabled = true,
  preventDefault = true,
  ignoreInputs = false,
  handler,
}: UseKeyboardShortcutOptions) => {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return;

    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      // Normalisasi nama key (mengabaikan case untuk huruf 'm' dan 'M')
      const isKeyMatch = event.key.toLowerCase() === key.toLowerCase() || event.key === key;
      
      if (!isKeyMatch) return;
      if (event.ctrlKey !== ctrlKey) return;
      if (event.shiftKey !== shiftKey) return;
      if (event.altKey !== altKey) return;
      if (event.metaKey !== metaKey) return;
      if (ignoreInputs && isEditableElement(event.target)) return;

      if (preventDefault) event.preventDefault();
      handler(event);
    };

    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
  }, [
    key,
    ctrlKey,
    shiftKey,
    altKey,
    metaKey,
    enabled,
    preventDefault,
    ignoreInputs,
    handler,
  ]);
};

FILE: src/hooks/useMonitoringSPB.ts
================================================================================
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { supabaseClient } from "../utility/supabaseClient";
import { TABLES } from "../utility/constants";

export interface SPBDocumentGroup {
  id: string;
  spbNo: string | null;
  poNo: string | null;
  date: string;
  status: string;
  itemsCount: number;
  sortNumber: number;
}

const getSortNumber = (str: string | null) => {
  if (!str) return 999999;
  const match = str.match(/\d+/);
  return match ? parseInt(match[0], 10) : 999999;
};

export const useMonitoringSPB = () => {
  const { data, isLoading, refetch } = useQuery<SPBDocumentGroup[]>({
    queryKey: ["monitoring-spb"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from(TABLES.spb)
        .select("no_spb, tanggal_pembuatan_spb, no_po, tanggal_po, status, tanggal_datang")
        .order("no_spb", { ascending: true });

      if (error) throw error;
      
      const groups: Record<string, SPBDocumentGroup> = {};
      
      (data ?? []).forEach((item: any) => {
        const key = `${item.no_spb || "NO_SPB"}_${item.no_po || "NO_PO"}`;
        
        if (!groups[key]) {
          groups[key] = {
            id: key,
            spbNo: item.no_spb,
            poNo: item.no_po,
            date: item.tanggal_pembuatan_spb || item.tanggal_po || item.tanggal_datang || "-",
            status: item.status,
            itemsCount: 0,
            sortNumber: getSortNumber(item.no_spb) + (getSortNumber(item.no_po) * 0.01),
          };
        }
        
        // Aturan status: Jika ada satupun barang yang BELUM DATANG, status card adalah BELUM DATANG
        if (item.status === "BELUM DATANG") {
          groups[key].status = "BELUM DATANG";
        }
        
        groups[key].itemsCount += 1;
      });

      return Object.values(groups);
    },
  });

  return {
    data: data ?? [],
    isLoading,
    refetch,
  };
};

FILE: src/hooks/useProductSearch.ts
================================================================================
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { supabaseClient } from "../utility/supabaseClient";
import { TABLES } from "../utility/constants";
import { USE_MOCK } from "../utility/config";
import { mockProducts } from "../mocks/products";
import { mapProduct } from "../utility/mappers";
import type { Product } from "../types";

export const useProductSearch = (keyword: string, limit = 30) => { // ✅ FIX 6: Limit dinaikkan ke 30
  // ✅ FIX 3: Sanitize input (Hapus karakter liar %, _, (, ) dll yang bikin query error)
  const sanitize = (str: string) => str.replace(/[%_()\\'"]/g, "");
  const trimmed = sanitize(keyword).trim();

  const { data, isLoading, refetch } = useQuery<Product[]>({
    queryKey: ["product-search", trimmed, limit],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (USE_MOCK) {
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 150));
        if (!trimmed) return mockProducts.slice(0, limit);
        const lower = trimmed.toLowerCase();
        return mockProducts
          .filter(
            (p) =>
              p.name.toLowerCase().includes(lower) ||
              p.code.toLowerCase().includes(lower),
          )
          .slice(0, limit);
      }

      let query = supabaseClient
        .from(TABLES.products)
        .select("*")
        .limit(limit)
        // ✅ FIX 5: .order() agar hasil tidak acak dan relevance bagus
        .order("nama", { ascending: true }); 

      if (trimmed) {
        // ✅ FIX 2: Split per kata, jadikan OR.
        // Hasilnya: nama.ilike.%kata1%,kode.ilike.%kata1%,nama.ilike.%kata2%...
        // Agar multi-kata atau urutan terbalik tetap matching.
        const words = trimmed.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
        const orConditions = words
          .map((w) => `nama.ilike.%${w}%,kode.ilike.%${w}%`)
          .join(",");
        
        query = query.or(orConditions);
      }

      const { data, error } = await query;
      if (error) throw error;
      return (data ?? []).map(mapProduct);
    },
    staleTime: 10_000,
  });

  return {
    products: data ?? [],
    isLoading,
    refetch,
  };
};

FILE: src/hooks/useProducts.ts
================================================================================
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { supabaseClient } from "../utility/supabaseClient";
import { TABLES } from "../utility/constants";
import { USE_MOCK } from "../utility/config";
import { mockProducts } from "../mocks/products";
import { mapProduct } from "../utility/mappers";
import type { Product } from "../types";

export const useProducts = (category?: string) => {
  const { data, isLoading, refetch } = useQuery<Product[]>({
    queryKey: ["products", category ?? "all"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (USE_MOCK) {
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300));
        const filtered = category
          ? mockProducts.filter((p) => p.category === category)
          : mockProducts;
        return [...filtered].sort((a, b) => b.stock - a.stock);
      }

      let query = supabaseClient
        .from(TABLES.products)
        .select("*")
        // ✅ Urutkan berdasarkan stok terbanyak terlebih dahulu
        .order("stok", { ascending: false })
        .order("nama", { ascending: true });

      if (category) {
        query = query.eq("kategori", category);
      }

      const { data, error } = await query;
      if (error) throw error;
      return (data ?? []).map(mapProduct);
    },
  });

  return {
    products: data ?? [],
    isLoading,
    refetch,
  };
};

FILE: src/hooks/useQuickEntry.ts

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { App } from "antd";
import dayjs from "dayjs";
import { useProductSearch } from "./useProductSearch";
import { useEntryFlow } from "./useEntryFlow";
import type { Product, StockExit, StockExitItem } from "../types";

// ============================================
// PendingLine — tambah field `size`
// ============================================
export interface PendingLine {
  itemId: number;
  itemName: string;
  size: string | null; // ← TAMBAH
  unit: string;
  quantity: number;
}

interface UseQuickEntryParams {
  onFinish?: (exit: StockExit) => void;
}

export const useQuickEntry = ({ onFinish }: UseQuickEntryParams = {}) => {
  const { message } = App.useApp();
  const flow = useEntryFlow();

  const [keyword, setKeyword] = useState("");
  const [highlightedIdx, setHighlightedIdx] = useState(0);
  const [activeItem, setActiveItem] = useState<Product | null>(null);
  const [activeQty, setActiveQty] = useState(1);
  const [pendingLines, setPendingLines] = useState<PendingLine[]>([]);

  const searchRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const qtyRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const { products: searchResults } = useProductSearch(keyword, 8);
  const phase = activeItem ? "quantity" : "search";

  // ==========================================
  // Auto-focus
  // ==========================================
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!flow.isReady) return;
    if (phase === "search") {
      setTimeout(() => searchRef.current?.focus(), 100);
    } else {
      setTimeout(() => qtyRef.current?.focus(), 100);
    }
  }, [phase, flow.isReady]);

  useEffect(() => setHighlightedIdx(0), [keyword]);

  // ==========================================
  // Ctrl+Enter → selesai
  // ==========================================
  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.ctrlKey && e.key === "Enter" && pendingLines.length > 0) {
        e.preventDefault();
        handleFinish();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", handler);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handler);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [pendingLines.length]);

  // ==========================================
  // Search handlers
  // ==========================================
  const commitItem = useCallback(() => {
    if (searchResults.length === 0) return;
    const chosen = searchResults[highlightedIdx] ?? searchResults[0];
    setActiveItem(chosen);
    setActiveQty(1);
    setKeyword("");
  }, [searchResults, highlightedIdx]);

  const handleSearchKeyDown = useCallback(
    (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
        e.preventDefault();
        setHighlightedIdx((i) => Math.min(i + 1, searchResults.length - 1));
      } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
        e.preventDefault();
        setHighlightedIdx((i) => Math.max(i - 1, 0));
      } else if (e.key === "Enter") {
        e.preventDefault();
        commitItem();
      }
    },
    [searchResults.length, commitItem],
  );

  // ==========================================
  // Quantity handlers
  // ==========================================
  const confirmQuantity = useCallback(() => {
    if (!activeItem) return;
    setPendingLines((prev) => {
      const idx = prev.findIndex((l) => l.itemId === activeItem.id);
      if (idx >= 0) {
        const copy = [...prev];
        copy[idx] = {
          ...copy[idx],
          quantity: copy[idx].quantity + activeQty,
        };
        return copy;
      }
      return [
        ...prev,
        {
          itemId: activeItem.id,
          itemName: activeItem.name,
          size: activeItem.size, // ← TAMBAH
          unit: activeItem.unit,
          quantity: activeQty,
        },
      ];
    });
    setActiveItem(null);
    setActiveQty(1);
  }, [activeItem, activeQty]);

  const handleQtyKeyDown = useCallback(
    (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Enter") {
        e.preventDefault();
        confirmQuantity();
      } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
        e.preventDefault();
        setActiveItem(null);
        setActiveQty(1);
      } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
        e.preventDefault();
        setActiveQty((q) => q + 1);
      } else if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
        e.preventDefault();
        setActiveQty((q) => Math.max(1, q - 1));
      }
    },
    [confirmQuantity],
  );

  const removeLine = useCallback((itemId: number) => {
    setPendingLines((prev) => prev.filter((l) => l.itemId !== itemId));
  }, []);

  const resetEntry = useCallback(() => {
    setPendingLines([]);
    setActiveItem(null);
    setActiveQty(1);
    setKeyword("");
  }, []);

  // ============================================
  // Handle Finish — build StockExit sesuai tipe baru
  // ============================================
  const handleFinish = useCallback(() => {
    if (pendingLines.length === 0) return;
    if (!flow.person || !flow.workplace) return;

    const now = dayjs();
    const exit: StockExit = {
      id: Date.now(),
      nomorTransaksi: "", // akan di-generate DB
      timestamp: now.toISOString(),
      date: now.format("YYYY-MM-DD"),
      time: now.format("HH:mm"),
      person: flow.person.name,
      destination: flow.workplace.name, // ← workplace jadi destination
      isBreakdown: true, // default breakdown
      items: pendingLines.map<StockExitItem>((l) => ({
        itemId: l.itemId,
        itemName: l.itemName,
        size: l.size, // ← TAMBAH
        unit: l.unit,
        quantity: l.quantity,
      })),
    };

    message.success(
      `Tersimpan: ${pendingLines.length} jenis barang di ${flow.workplace.name}`,
    );

    onFinish?.(exit);
    resetEntry();
    flow.resetSession();
  }, [pendingLines, flow, message, onFinish, resetEntry]);

  const handleCancel = useCallback(() => {
    resetEntry();
    flow.resetSession();
  }, [resetEntry, flow]);

  const totalPendingItems = pendingLines.reduce((s, l) => s + l.quantity, 0);

  return {
    flow,
    keyword,
    setKeyword,
    highlightedIdx,
    searchResults,
    searchRef,
    handleSearchKeyDown,
    commitItem,
    activeItem,
    activeQty,
    setActiveQty,
    qtyRef,
    handleQtyKeyDown,
    confirmQuantity,
    pendingLines,
    totalPendingItems,
    removeLine,
    phase,
    handleFinish,
    handleCancel,
  };
};

FILE: src/hooks/useStockEntryMutations.ts
================================================================================
import { useMutation } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { App } from "antd";
import { supabaseClient } from "../utility/supabaseClient";
import { TABLES } from "../utility/constants";
import { USE_MOCK } from "../utility/config";
import type { StockEntry } from "../types";

export interface CreateStockEntryInput {
  productId: number;
  supplierId: number | null;
  quantity: number;
  unitPrice: number;
  date: string;
  note?: string | null;
}

export const useCreateStockEntry = () => {
  const { message } = App.useApp();

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (input: CreateStockEntryInput) => {
      // === MODE MOCK ===
      if (USE_MOCK) {
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500));
        // Simulasi sukses
        return { id: Date.now(), ...input } as unknown as StockEntry;
      }

      // === MODE SUPABASE ===
      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from(TABLES.stockEntries)
        .insert({
          product_id: input.productId,
          supplier_id: input.supplierId,
          quantity: input.quantity,
          unit_price: input.unitPrice,
          date: input.date,
          note: input.note ?? null,
        })
        .select()
        .single();

      if (error) throw error;
      return data as StockEntry;
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      message.success("Barang masuk berhasil disimpan");
    },
    onError: (error: Error) => {
      message.error(error.message || "Gagal menyimpan barang masuk");
    },
  });
};


================================================================================
FILE: src/hooks/useStockExits.ts
================================================================================
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import dayjs from "dayjs";
import { supabaseClient } from "../utility/supabaseClient";
import { TABLES } from "../utility/constants";
import { USE_MOCK } from "../utility/config";
import { mockStockExits } from "../mocks/stockExitList";
import { mapStockExits } from "../utility/mappers";
import type { StockExit } from "../types";

interface Options {
  onlyToday?: boolean;
  breakdown?: boolean; // true = breakdown, false = non-breakdown, undefined = semua
}

export const useStockExits = ({
  onlyToday = false,
  breakdown,
}: Options = {}) => {
  const { data, isLoading, refetch } = useQuery<StockExit[]>({
    queryKey: ["stock-exits", onlyToday, breakdown],
    queryFn: async () => {
      // === MOCK ===
      if (USE_MOCK) {
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300));
        return mockStockExits;
      }

      // === SUPABASE ===
      let query = supabaseClient
        .from(TABLES.stockExits)
        .select("*")
        .order("created_at", { ascending: false });

      if (onlyToday) {
        const startOfDay = dayjs().startOf("day").toISOString();
        const endOfDay = dayjs().endOf("day").toISOString();
        query = query.gte("created_at", startOfDay).lte("created_at", endOfDay);
      }

      if (breakdown !== undefined) {
        query = query.eq("is_breakdown", breakdown);
      }

      const { data, error } = await query;
      if (error) throw error;

      return mapStockExits(data ?? []);
    },
    refetchInterval: USE_MOCK ? false : 30_000,
  });

  return {
    exits: data ?? [],
    isLoading,
    refetch,
  };
};



================================================================================
FILE: src/hooks/useStockInChart.ts
================================================================================
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import dayjs from "dayjs";
import { supabaseClient } from "../utility/supabaseClient";
import { TABLES } from "../utility/constants";
import { USE_MOCK } from "../utility/config";
import { mockStockInChart } from "../mocks/stockEntries";
import type { StockInChartItem } from "../types";

export const useStockInChart = (days = 30) => {
  const { data, isLoading, refetch } = useQuery<StockInChartItem[]>({
    queryKey: ["stock-in-chart", days],
    queryFn: async () => {
      // === MODE MOCK ===
      if (USE_MOCK) {
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300));
        return mockStockInChart.slice(-days);
      }

      // === MODE SUPABASE ===
      const fromDate = dayjs().subtract(days, "day").format("YYYY-MM-DD");

      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from(TABLES.stockEntries)
        .select("tanggal, jumlah")
        .gte("tanggal", fromDate)
        .order("tanggal", { ascending: true });

      if (error) throw error;

      // Group by date
      const grouped = (data ?? []).reduce<Record<string, number>>(
        (acc, row: { tanggal: string; jumlah: number }) => {
          acc[row.tanggal] = (acc[row.tanggal] ?? 0) + row.jumlah;
          return acc;
        },
        {},
      );

      return Object.entries(grouped).map(([date, total]) => ({
        date,
        total,
      }));
    },
  });

  return {
    items: data ?? [],
    isLoading,
    refetch,
  };
};

import type { DashboardStats } from "../types";
import { mockProducts } from "./products";
import { getMockTodayInbound } from "./stockEntries";
import { mockStockExits } from "./stockExitList";

export const getMockDashboardStats = (): DashboardStats => {
  const totalProducts = mockProducts.length;
  const totalStock = mockProducts.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.stock, 0);
  const todayInbound = getMockTodayInbound();

  // Hitung barang keluar hari ini dari mockStockExits
  const today = new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];
  const todayOutbound = mockStockExits
    .filter((e) => e.date === today)
    .reduce((sum, e) => sum + e.items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.quantity, 0), 0);

  return { totalProducts, totalStock, todayInbound, todayOutbound };
};

// ============================================
// Data grafik 30 hari terakhir (deterministik, bukan random)
// ============================================
const generateChart = (): StockInChartItem[] => {
  const result: StockInChartItem[] = [];
  // Pola: naik turun natural, bukan random murni (biar test stabil)
  const pattern = [
    0, 0, 45, 80, 120, 60, 0, 30, 95, 140, 70, 0, 0, 55, 110, 85, 40, 0, 20,
    75, 130, 100, 50, 0, 15, 90, 160, 120, 65, 0,
  ];

  for (let i = 29; i >= 0; i--) {
    const date = dayjs().subtract(i, "day").format("YYYY-MM-DD");
    const idx = 29 - i;
    result.push({ date, total: pattern[idx] ?? 0 });
  }
  return result;
};

export const mockStockInChart: StockInChartItem[] = generateChart();

// ============================================
// Helper: total masuk hari ini (dipakai di mocks/dashboard.ts)
// ============================================
export const getMockTodayInbound = (): number => {
  const today = dayjs().format("YYYY-MM-DD");
  return mockStockEntries
    .filter((e) => e.date === today)
    .reduce((sum, e) => sum + e.quantity, 0);
};

            icon={<InboxOutlined />}
            color={COLORS.success}
            loading={isLoadingProducts}
          />
        </Col>
        <Col xs={24} sm={12} lg={6}>
          <StatCard
            title="Masuk Hari Ini"
            value={todayInbound}
            icon={<ArrowDownOutlined />}
            color={COLORS.warning}
            loading={false}
          />
        </Col>
        <Col xs={24} sm={12} lg={6}>
          <StatCard
            title="Keluar Hari Ini"
            value={todayOutbound}
            icon={<ArrowUpOutlined />}
            color={COLORS.danger}
            loading={isLoadingExits}
          />
        </Col>
      </Row>

      <Row gutter={[16, 16]}>
        <Col xs={24} lg={16}>
          <StockTable products={materialProducts} loading={isLoadingProducts} />
        </Col>
        <Col xs={24} lg={8}>
          <StockExitList exits={exits} loading={isLoadingExits} />
        </Col>
      </Row>
    </>
  );
};

export default DashboardPage;

FILE: src/pages/entry/index.tsx
================================================================================
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate, useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import {
  Button,
  Card,
  Col,
  Empty,
  InputNumber,
  Row,
  Select, // ✅ Menggunakan Select bukan AutoComplete
  Space,
  Switch,
  Tag,
  Typography,
  App,
  Table,
} from "antd";
import {
  ArrowLeftOutlined,
  CheckCircleOutlined,
  CloseCircleOutlined,
  EnvironmentOutlined,
  SwapOutlined,
  UserOutlined,
} from "@ant-design/icons";
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useProductSearch } from "../../hooks/useProductSearch";
import { usePersons } from "../../hooks/usePersons";
import { useKeyboardShortcut } from "../../hooks/useKeyboardShortcut";
import { useDebounce } from "../../hooks/useDebounce"; // ✅ FIX 4: Import hook debounce
import { SetupWizard } from "../../components/entry/SetupWizard";
import { mockWorkplaces } from "../../mocks/entry";
import { supabaseClient } from "../../utility/supabaseClient";
import { TABLES } from "../../utility/constants";
import { USE_MOCK } from "../../utility/config";
import { formatNumber } from "../../utility/format";
import type { Product } from "../../types";
import type { Person, Workplace } from "../../types/entry";

const { Title, Text } = Typography;

interface OutboundLine {
  itemId: number;
  itemName: string;
  size: string | null;
  unit: string;
  maxStock: number;
  quantity: number;
}

export const EntryPage = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const { message } = App.useApp();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  const { persons } = usePersons();

  const initialPerson = searchParams.get("person") || "";
  const initialWorkplace = searchParams.get("workplace") || "";

  const [personName, setPersonName] = useState<string>(initialPerson);
  const [workplaceName, setWorkplaceName] = useState<string>(initialWorkplace);

  const [isBreakdown, setIsBreakdown] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [wizardOpen, setWizardOpen] = useState<boolean>(!initialPerson || !initialWorkplace);
  const [wizardStep, setWizardStep] = useState<"person" | "workplace">("person");

  // State pencarian
  const [keyword, setKeyword] = useState("");
  // ✅ FIX 4: Debounce input agar tidak race / lompat-lompat
  const debouncedKeyword = useDebounce(keyword, 250); 
  // Hook pencarian memanggil API dinamis menggunakan text yang sudah di-debounce
  const { products, isLoading: isLoadingProducts } = useProductSearch(debouncedKeyword, 30);

  const [activeItem, setActiveItem] = useState<Product | null>(null);
  const [activeQty, setActiveQty] = useState<number>(1);
  const [lines, setLines] = useState<OutboundLine[]>([]);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const searchRef = useRef<any>(null);
  const qtyRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const phase = activeItem ? "quantity" : "search";

  // Auto-focus logic
  useEffect(() => {
    if (wizardOpen) return;
    if (phase === "search") {
      setTimeout(() => searchRef.current?.focus(), 100);
    } else if (phase === "quantity") {
      setTimeout(() => qtyRef.current?.focus(), 100);
    }
  }, [phase, wizardOpen]);

  const handleWizardSelect = (val: Person | Workplace) => {
    if (wizardStep === "person") {
      setPersonName(val.name);
      setWizardStep("workplace");
    } else {
      setWorkplaceName(val.name);
      setWizardOpen(false);
      setSearchParams({ person: personName, workplace: val.name });
    }
  };

  const handleProductSelect = (productId: number) => {
    const item = products.find((p) => p.id === productId);
    if (item) {
      setActiveItem(item);
      setActiveQty(1);
      setKeyword(""); // Reset keyword
    }
  };

  const confirmQuantity = () => {
    if (!activeItem) return;
    if (activeQty <= 0) {
      message.warning("Jumlah minimal 1");
      return;
    }

    setLines((prev) => {
      const idx = prev.findIndex((l) => l.itemId === activeItem.id);
      if (idx >= 0) {
        const copy = [...prev];
        copy[idx] = { ...copy[idx], quantity: copy[idx].quantity + activeQty };
        return copy;
      }
      return [
        {
          itemId: activeItem.id,
          itemName: activeItem.name,
          size: activeItem.size,
          unit: activeItem.unit,
          maxStock: activeItem.stock,
          quantity: activeQty,
        },
        ...prev,
      ];
    });
    
    setActiveItem(null);
    setActiveQty(1);
  };

  const removeLine = (itemId: number) => {
    setLines((prev) => prev.filter((l) => l.itemId !== itemId));
  };

  const handleFinish = async () => {
    if (lines.length === 0) {
      message.warning("Tambahkan minimal 1 barang ke daftar terlebih dahulu");
      return;
    }
    if (!personName || !workplaceName) {
      setWizardStep("person");
      setWizardOpen(true);
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const trxNumber = `OUT-${Date.now()}`;

      if (!USE_MOCK) {
        const payload = lines.map((l) => ({
          nomor_transaksi: trxNumber,
          barang_id: l.itemId,
          nama_pekerja: personName,
          nama_barang: l.itemName,
          ukuran_barang: l.size,
          satuan_barang: l.unit,
          jumlah_barang_keluar: l.quantity,
          tujuan: workplaceName,
          is_breakdown: isBreakdown,
        }));

        const { error: insertErr } = await supabaseClient.from(TABLES.stockExits).insert(payload);
        if (insertErr) throw insertErr;

        for (const line of lines) {
          const newStock = Math.max(0, line.maxStock - line.quantity);
          await supabaseClient.from(TABLES.products).update({ stok: newStock }).eq("id", line.itemId);
        }
      }

      message.success(`Pengeluaran ${lines.length} jenis barang berhasil disimpan!`);
      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["products"] });
      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["stock-exits"] });
      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["dashboard-stats"] });

      navigate("/dashboard");
    } catch (err: any) {
      message.error(err?.message || "Gagal menyimpan pengeluaran barang");
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  useKeyboardShortcut({
    key: "Enter",
    ctrlKey: true,
    enabled: lines.length > 0 && !isSubmitting && !wizardOpen && !activeItem,
    preventDefault: true,
    handler: () => handleFinish(),
  });

  const totalItems = lines.reduce((sum, l) => sum + l.quantity, 0);

  return (
    <div style={{ maxWidth: 920, margin: "0 auto", paddingBottom: 32 }}>
      <SetupWizard
        open={wizardOpen}
        step={wizardStep}
        title={wizardStep === "person" ? "Pilih Nama Pekerja" : "Pilih Lokasi Pekerjaan"}
        placeholder={wizardStep === "person" ? "Ketik nama pekerja..." : "Ketik lokasi pekerjaan..."}
        options={wizardStep === "person" ? persons : mockWorkplaces}
        onSelect={handleWizardSelect}
        onBack={wizardStep === "workplace" ? () => setWizardStep("person") : undefined}
        onClose={() => {
          if (!personName || !workplaceName) navigate("/dashboard");
          else setWizardOpen(false);
        }}
      />

      <div style={{ marginBottom: 16, display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 12 }}>
        <Space align="center">
          <Button icon={<ArrowLeftOutlined />} onClick={() => navigate("/dashboard")} type="text" size="large" />
          <div>
            <Title level={3} style={{ margin: 0 }}>Pengeluaran Barang</Title>
            <Text type="secondary">Pilih barang yang diambil dan tentukan jumlahnya</Text>
          </div>
        </Space>

        <Card
          size="small"
          style={{ borderRadius: 10, background: isBreakdown ? "#e6f4ff" : "#fffbe6", borderColor: isBreakdown ? "#91caff" : "#ffe58f" }}
          styles={{ body: { padding: "8px 14px" } }}
        >
          <Space align="center" size={10}>
            <div>
              <Text strong style={{ fontSize: 13, display: "block" }}>
                Status: {isBreakdown ? "Masuk Breakdown" : "Diluar Breakdown"}
              </Text>
              <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
                {isBreakdown ? "Otomatis tercatat di daftar Breakdown" : "Tercatat sebagai Non-Breakdown"}
              </Text>
            </div>
            <Switch checked={isBreakdown} onChange={setIsBreakdown} checkedChildren="Breakdown" unCheckedChildren="Non" />
          </Space>
        </Card>
      </div>

      <Card variant="borderless" style={{ borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 16 }} styles={{ body: { padding: 16 } }}>
        <Row justify="space-between" align="middle" gutter={[12, 12]}>
          <Col>
            <Space size={12} wrap>
              <Tag icon={<UserOutlined />} color="blue" style={{ fontSize: 14, padding: "6px 12px", borderRadius: 8 }}>
                Pekerja: <strong>{personName || "Belum dipilih"}</strong>
              </Tag>
              <Tag icon={<EnvironmentOutlined />} color="cyan" style={{ fontSize: 14, padding: "6px 12px", borderRadius: 8 }}>
                Lokasi: <strong>{workplaceName || "Belum dipilih"}</strong>
              </Tag>
            </Space>
          </Col>
          <Col>
            <Button size="small" icon={<SwapOutlined />} onClick={() => { setWizardStep("person"); setWizardOpen(true); }}>
              Ubah Nama / Lokasi
            </Button>
          </Col>
        </Row>
      </Card>

      <Card variant="borderless" style={{ borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 16 }} styles={{ body: { padding: 20 } }}>
        {phase === "search" && (
          <>
            <Text strong style={{ fontSize: 14, display: "block", marginBottom: 8 }}>
              Cari Material / Alat
            </Text>
            
            <Select
              showSearch
              autoFocus
              ref={searchRef}
              size="large"
              style={{ width: "100%" }}
              placeholder="Ketik nama, ukuran, atau kode barang..."
              // ✅ FIX 1: Matikan filter lokal Ant Design. Biarkan Supabase yang memfilter
              filterOption={false} 
              value={null}
              loading={isLoadingProducts}
              onSearch={setKeyword}
              onChange={handleProductSelect}
              options={products.map((p) => ({
                value: p.id,
                label: `${p.name} ${p.size ? `(${p.size})` : ""} — Stok: ${p.stock} ${p.unit}`,
              }))}
              notFoundContent={isLoadingProducts ? "Mencari data..." : "Barang tidak ditemukan"}
            />
          </>
        )}

        {phase === "quantity" && activeItem && (
          <div>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", marginBottom: 12, flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 8 }}>
              <div>
                <Text strong style={{ fontSize: 16 }}>
                  {activeItem.name} {activeItem.size ? `(${activeItem.size})` : ""}
                </Text>
              </div>
              <Tag color="blue" style={{ fontSize: 13, padding: "4px 10px" }}>
                Sisa Stok: {activeItem.stock} {activeItem.unit}
              </Tag>
            </div>

            <Space.Compact style={{ width: "100%" }}>
              <Button size="large" onClick={() => setActiveQty((q) => Math.max(1, q - 1))} style={{ width: 64, height: 50, fontSize: 22 }}>−</Button>
              <InputNumber
                ref={qtyRef as never}
                value={activeQty}
                onChange={(val) => setActiveQty(Number(val) || 1)}
                size="large"
                min={1}
                controls={false}
                onPressEnter={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  confirmQuantity();
                }}
                onKeyDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.key === "Escape") setActiveItem(null);
                  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") setActiveQty((q) => q + 1);
                  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") setActiveQty((q) => Math.max(1, q - 1));
                }}
                style={{ flex: 1, textAlign: "center", fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 600, height: 50 }}
              />
              <Button size="large" onClick={() => setActiveQty((q) => q + 1)} style={{ width: 64, height: 50, fontSize: 22 }}>+</Button>
            </Space.Compact>

            <Space style={{ marginTop: 14, width: "100%", justifyContent: "space-between" }} wrap>
              <Space size="small" wrap>
                <Tag>Enter</Tag> <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>tambahkan ke daftar</Text>
                <Tag>Esc</Tag> <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>batal</Text>
              </Space>
              <Space>
                <Button onClick={() => { setActiveItem(null); setTimeout(() => searchRef.current?.focus(), 50); }}>Batal</Button>
                <Button type="primary" onClick={confirmQuantity}>Tambah ke Daftar</Button>
              </Space>
            </Space>
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>

      <Card
        title={`📦 Daftar Pengeluaran (${lines.length} jenis · ${formatNumber(totalItems)} item)`}
        variant="borderless"
        style={{ borderRadius: 12 }}
        styles={{ body: { padding: 0 } }}
        extra={
          <Button
            type="primary"
            size="large"
            icon={<CheckCircleOutlined />}
            disabled={lines.length === 0}
            loading={isSubmitting}
            onClick={handleFinish}
          >
            Simpan ke Database (Ctrl+Enter)
          </Button>
        }
      >
        {lines.length === 0 ? (
          <div style={{ padding: 32 }}>
            <Empty description="Belum ada barang yang ditambahkan ke daftar" image={Empty.PRESENTED_IMAGE_SIMPLE} />
          </div>
        ) : (
          <Table
            dataSource={lines}
            rowKey="itemId"
            pagination={false}
            size="middle"
            columns={[
              {
                title: "Nama Barang",
                dataIndex: "itemName",
                render: (text, record) => (
                  <Space direction="vertical" size={0}>
                    <Text strong style={{ fontSize: 15 }}>{text}</Text>
                    {record.size && <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>Ukuran: {record.size}</Text>}
                  </Space>
                ),
              },
              {
                title: "Jumlah",
                dataIndex: "quantity",
                align: "right",
                render: (val, record) => (
                  <Tag color="red" style={{ fontSize: 15, padding: "4px 12px", fontWeight: 600 }}>
                    {formatNumber(val)} {record.unit}
                  </Tag>
                ),
              },
              {
                title: "",
                align: "center",
                width: 70,
                render: (_, record) => (
                  <Button
                    type="text"
                    danger
                    icon={<CloseCircleOutlined />}
                    onClick={() => removeLine(record.itemId)}
                  />
                ),
              },
            ]}
          />
        )}
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
};

export default EntryPage;

import { useState } from "react";
import { Typography, Tabs, Space } from "antd";
import { formatFullDate } from "../../utility/format";
import { InventoryTable } from "../../components/inventory/InventoryTable";
import { useProducts } from "../../hooks/useProducts";
import { useStockExits } from "../../hooks/useStockExits";

const { Title, Text } = Typography;

enum InventoryTabKey {
  MATERIAL = "material",
  TOOLS = "tools",
  OUTBOUND_BREAKDOWN = "outbound-breakdown",
  OUTBOUND_NON_BREAKDOWN = "outbound-non-breakdown",
}

export const InventoryPage = () => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<string>(InventoryTabKey.MATERIAL);

  const { products: materials, isLoading: isLoadingMaterials } =
    useProducts("Material");

  const { products: tools, isLoading: isLoadingTools } =
    useProducts("Alat Bantu");

  const { exits: breakdownExits, isLoading: isLoadingBreakdown } =
    useStockExits({ breakdown: true });

  const { exits: nonBreakdownExits, isLoading: isLoadingNonBreakdown } =
    useStockExits({ breakdown: false });

  const tabItems = [
    {
      key: InventoryTabKey.MATERIAL,
      label: `Stok Persediaan Material (${materials.length})`,
      children: (
        <InventoryTable
          type="stock"
          dataSource={materials}
          loading={isLoadingMaterials}
        />
      ),
    },
    {
      key: InventoryTabKey.TOOLS,
      // ✅ Rename jadi Stok Persediaan Alat
      label: `Stok Persediaan Alat (${tools.length})`,
      children: (
        <InventoryTable
          type="stock"
          dataSource={tools}
          loading={isLoadingTools}
        />
      ),
    },
    {
      key: InventoryTabKey.OUTBOUND_BREAKDOWN,
      label: `Pengeluaran (Breakdown) (${breakdownExits.length})`,
      children: (
        <InventoryTable
          type="outbound"
          dataSource={breakdownExits}
          loading={isLoadingBreakdown}
        />
      ),
    },
    {
      key: InventoryTabKey.OUTBOUND_NON_BREAKDOWN,
      label: `Pengeluaran (Diluar Breakdown) (${nonBreakdownExits.length})`,
      children: (
        <InventoryTable
          type="outbound"
          dataSource={nonBreakdownExits}
          loading={isLoadingNonBreakdown}
        />
      ),
    },
  ];

  return (
    <Space direction="vertical" size="large" style={{ width: "100%" }}>
      <div>
        <Title level={3} style={{ marginBottom: 4 }}>
          Manajemen Persediaan & Pengeluaran
        </Title>
        <Text type="secondary">{formatFullDate(new Date())}</Text>
      </div>

      <Tabs
        activeKey={activeTab}
        onChange={setActiveTab}
        type="card"
        size="large"
        items={tabItems}
        destroyInactiveTabPane={false}
      />
    </Space>
  );
};

export default InventoryPage;

FILE: src/pages/monitoring-spb/index.tsx

import { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import { Typography, Card, Space, Tag, Row, Col, Divider, Spin, Segmented, Empty } from "antd"; // ✅ Tambahan Empty di sini
import { useMonitoringSPB, type SPBDocumentGroup } from "../../hooks/useMonitoringSPB";
import { formatFullDate, formatDate } from "../../utility/format";
import { CheckCircleOutlined, SyncOutlined, FileTextOutlined } from "@ant-design/icons";

const { Title, Text } = Typography;

type FilterType = "Semua" | "Sudah di PO" | "Belum di PO" | "Datang" | "SPB Selesai";

export const MonitoringSPBPage = () => {
  const { data, isLoading } = useMonitoringSPB();
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<FilterType>("Semua");

  const recentItems = useMemo(() => {
    // Diambil dari 4 data teratas
    return [...data].slice(0, 4);
  }, [data]);

  const filteredAndSortedData = useMemo(() => {
    let filtered = data.filter((item) => {
      switch (filter) {
        case "Sudah di PO":
          return item.poNo !== null;
        case "Belum di PO":
          return item.poNo === null;
        case "Datang":
        case "SPB Selesai":
          return item.status === "DATANG SESUAI" || item.status === "DATANG LEBIH";
        default:
          return true;
      }
    });

    // Urutkan berdasarkan no SPB terkecil, namun yang selesai dilempar ke paling bawah
    return filtered.sort((a, b) => {
      const aIsDone = a.status.includes("DATANG SESUAI") || a.status.includes("DATANG LEBIH");
      const bIsDone = b.status.includes("DATANG SESUAI") || b.status.includes("DATANG LEBIH");
      
      if (aIsDone && !bIsDone) return 1;
      if (!aIsDone && bIsDone) return -1;
      
      return a.sortNumber - b.sortNumber;
    });
  }, [data, filter]);

  const renderCardContent = (item: SPBDocumentGroup) => {
    const hasSPB = item.spbNo !== null;
    const hasPO = item.poNo !== null;
    
    const isDone = item.status.includes("DATANG SESUAI") || item.status.includes("DATANG LEBIH");
    const statusColor = isDone ? "success" : (item.status === "BELUM DATANG" ? "error" : "processing");
    const statusIcon = isDone ? <CheckCircleOutlined /> : <SyncOutlined spin />;

    return (
      <Card
        hoverable
        style={{ borderRadius: 12, height: "100%", border: "1px solid #f0f0f0", boxShadow: "0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)" }}
        styles={{ body: { padding: 16 } }}
      >
        <Space direction="vertical" style={{ width: "100%" }} size={2}>
          {hasSPB && (
            <div>
              <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>No. SPB</Text>
              <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 16 }}>{item.spbNo}</div>
            </div>
          )}
          
          {hasSPB && hasPO && <Divider style={{ margin: "8px 0" }} />}
          
          {hasPO && (
            <div>
              <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>No. PO</Text>
              <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 16 }}>{item.poNo}</div>
            </div>
          )}

          <div style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
            <Tag icon={statusIcon} color={statusColor} style={{ margin: 0 }}>
              Status: {item.status}
            </Tag>
            <div style={{ marginTop: 8, fontSize: 12, color: "#8c8c8c" }}>
              Total: {item.itemsCount} Barang
            </div>
          </div>
        </Space>
      </Card>
    );
  };

  if (isLoading) {
    return <div style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: 50 }}><Spin size="large" /></div>;
  }

  return (
    <div style={{ maxWidth: 1000, margin: "0 auto", paddingBottom: 32 }}>
      
      <div style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}>
        <Space align="center">
          <div style={{ width: 42, height: 42, borderRadius: 10, background: "#1677ff15", color: "#1677ff", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", fontSize: 20 }}>
            <FileTextOutlined />
          </div>
          <div>
            <Title level={3} style={{ margin: 0 }}>Monitoring SPB</Title>
            <Text type="secondary">
              {data.length} Dokumen Terdaftar - Diperbarui {formatFullDate(new Date())}
            </Text>
          </div>
        </Space>
      </div>

      {/* Baru ditambahkan */}
      <div style={{ marginBottom: 32 }}>
        <Text strong style={{ fontSize: 16, display: "block", marginBottom: 12 }}>Baru ditambahkan</Text>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 16, overflowX: "auto", paddingBottom: 8 }}>
          {recentItems.map((item) => (
            <div key={item.id} style={{ minWidth: 200, flexShrink: 0 }}>
              <Card size="small" style={{ borderRadius: 10, background: "#fafafa" }}>
                <Space direction="vertical" size={0}>
                  <Text strong>{item.spbNo ? `SPB: ${item.spbNo}` : `PO: ${item.poNo}`}</Text>
                  <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>{formatDate(item.date)}</Text>
                </Space>
              </Card>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style={{ marginBottom: 20 }}>
        <Segmented<FilterType>
          size="large"
          options={["Semua", "Sudah di PO", "Belum di PO", "Datang", "SPB Selesai"]}
          value={filter}
          onChange={setFilter}
          style={{ padding: 4, fontWeight: 500 }}
        />
      </div>

      <Row gutter={[16, 16]}>
        {filteredAndSortedData.map((item) => (
          <Col xs={24} sm={12} md={8} lg={6} key={item.id}>
            {renderCardContent(item)}
          </Col>
        ))}
      </Row>
      
      {filteredAndSortedData.length === 0 && (
         <div style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: 40, width: "100%" }}>
            <Empty description="Tidak ada data SPB/PO untuk kategori ini." />
         </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default MonitoringSPBPage;

import { useState } from "react";
import {
  Button,
  Card,
  Col,
  DatePicker,
  Form,
  Input,
  InputNumber,
  Row,
  Select,
  Space,
  Table,
  Typography,
  App,
} from "antd";
import {
  PlusOutlined,
  SaveOutlined,
  AppstoreAddOutlined,
} from "@ant-design/icons";
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import dayjs from "dayjs";
import { supabaseClient } from "../../utility/supabaseClient";
import { TABLES } from "../../utility/constants";
import { USE_MOCK } from "../../utility/config";

// ✅ MEMASUKKAN FIX DEEPSEEK: Menggunakan Hook Search Pintar & Debounce
import { useProductSearch } from "../../hooks/useProductSearch"; 
import { useDebounce } from "../../hooks/useDebounce"; 

import { formatNumber, formatDate } from "../../utility/format";
import type { Product } from "../../types";

const { Title, Text } = Typography;

interface StockEntryFormValues {
  productId: number;
  jumlah: number;
  tanggal_pengiriman: dayjs.Dayjs;
  spesifikasi?: string;
  merk?: string;
}

export const ProductCreatePage = () => {
  const [form] = Form.useForm<StockEntryFormValues>();
  const { message } = App.useApp();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  // ✅ FIX DEEPSEEK: Menerapkan state keyword dengan debounce 250ms
  const [keyword, setKeyword] = useState("");
  const debouncedKeyword = useDebounce(keyword, 250);
  
  // ✅ FIX DEEPSEEK: Memanggil data dari server secara dinamis
  const { products, isLoading } = useProductSearch(debouncedKeyword, 30);
  
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [selectedProduct, setSelectedProduct] = useState<Product | null>(null);

  // Menyimpan riwayat lokal sementara setelah diinput
  const [recentEntries, setRecentEntries] = useState<any[]>([]);

  const handleProductSelect = (val: number) => {
    const prod = products.find((p) => p.id === val);
    setSelectedProduct(prod || null);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (values: StockEntryFormValues) => {
    if (!selectedProduct) return;
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    
    try {
      if (!USE_MOCK) {
        // 1. Catat di tabel barang_masuk
        const payload = {
          kode_barang: selectedProduct.code,
          nama_barang: selectedProduct.name,
          ukuran_barang: selectedProduct.size,
          spesifikasi_barang: values.spesifikasi || null,
          satuan_barang: selectedProduct.unit,
          kategori: selectedProduct.category,
          jumlah_barang_masuk: values.jumlah,
          tanggal_pengiriman: values.tanggal_pengiriman.format("YYYY-MM-DD"),
          keterangan: values.merk ? `Merk: ${values.merk}` : null,
        };

        const { error: insertErr } = await supabaseClient
          .from("barang_masuk")
          .insert(payload);

        if (insertErr) throw insertErr;

        // 2. Tambah stok di tabel barang
        const newStock = selectedProduct.stock + values.jumlah;
        const { error: updateErr } = await supabaseClient
          .from(TABLES.products)
          .update({ stok: newStock })
          .eq("id", selectedProduct.id);

        if (updateErr) throw updateErr;
      }

      message.success(`Berhasil menambahkan ${formatNumber(values.jumlah)} ${selectedProduct.unit} ke stok ${selectedProduct.name}!`);
      
      setRecentEntries((prev) => [
        {
          key: Date.now(),
          nama: selectedProduct.name,
          ukuran: selectedProduct.size,
          jumlah: values.jumlah,
          satuan: selectedProduct.unit,
          tanggal: values.tanggal_pengiriman.format("YYYY-MM-DD"),
        },
        ...prev,
      ]);

      // Reset form agar siap input barang lain
      form.resetFields();
      setSelectedProduct(null);
      setKeyword("");
      
      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["products"] });
      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["dashboard-stats"] });

    } catch (err: any) {
      message.error(err?.message || "Gagal menyimpan data barang masuk");
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ maxWidth: 860, margin: "0 auto", paddingBottom: 32 }}>
      <div style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
        <Space align="center" size={10}>
          <div
            style={{
              width: 42,
              height: 42,
              borderRadius: 10,
              background: "#1677ff15",
              color: "#1677ff",
              display: "flex",
              alignItems: "center",
              justifyContent: "center",
              fontSize: 20,
            }}
          >
            <AppstoreAddOutlined />
          </div>
          <div>
            <Title level={3} style={{ margin: 0 }}>
              Tambah Barang Masuk
            </Title>
            <Text type="secondary">
              Pilih barang dari database dan tambahkan jumlah stoknya
            </Text>
          </div>
        </Space>
      </div>

      <Card
        variant="borderless"
        style={{
          borderRadius: 14,
          boxShadow: "0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)",
          marginBottom: 24,
        }}
        styles={{ body: { padding: 24 } }}
      >
        <Form<StockEntryFormValues>
          form={form}
          layout="vertical"
          onFinish={handleSubmit}
          initialValues={{
            tanggal_pengiriman: dayjs(),
          }}
          requiredMark={false}
        >
          <Row gutter={[16, 8]}>
            <Col xs={24}>
              <Form.Item
                name="productId"
                label="Nama Barang (Pilih dari Database)"
                rules={[{ required: true, message: "Pilih barang terlebih dahulu" }]}
              >
                <Select
                  showSearch
                  size="large"
                  placeholder="Ketik nama atau ukuran barang..."
                  // ✅ FIX DEEPSEEK 1: filterOption={false} agar filter Antd tidak menimpa hasil dari server
                  filterOption={false} 
                  loading={isLoading}
                  onSearch={setKeyword} // Update keyword saat mengetik
                  onChange={handleProductSelect}
                  options={products.map((p) => ({
                    value: p.id,
                    label: `${p.name} ${p.size ? `(${p.size})` : ""} — Sisa Stok: ${p.stock} ${p.unit}`,
                  }))}
                  notFoundContent={isLoading ? "Mencari data..." : "Barang tidak ditemukan"}
                />
              </Form.Item>
            </Col>

            <Col xs={12} sm={8}>
              <Form.Item
                name="jumlah"
                label="Jumlah Masuk"
                rules={[{ required: true, message: "Wajib diisi" }]}
              >
                <InputNumber
                  size="large"
                  min={1}
                  style={{ width: "100%" }}
                  placeholder="0"
                  addonAfter={selectedProduct?.unit || ""}
                />
              </Form.Item>
            </Col>

            <Col xs={12} sm={16}>
              <Form.Item
                name="tanggal_pengiriman"
                label="Tanggal Pengiriman"
                rules={[{ required: true, message: "Wajib diisi" }]}
              >
                <DatePicker
                  size="large"
                  style={{ width: "100%" }}
                  format="DD MMMM YYYY"
                />
              </Form.Item>
            </Col>

            <Col xs={24} sm={12}>
              <Form.Item name="merk" label="Merk (Opsional)">
                <Input size="large" placeholder="Contoh: Rucika, Panasonic" />
              </Form.Item>
            </Col>

            <Col xs={24} sm={12}>
              <Form.Item name="spesifikasi" label="Spesifikasi (Opsional)">
                <Input size="large" placeholder="Keterangan tambahan..." />
              </Form.Item>
            </Col>
          </Row>

          <div
            style={{
              marginTop: 16,
              display: "flex",
              justifyContent: "flex-end",
            }}
          >
            <Button
              type="primary"
              size="large"
              htmlType="submit"
              icon={<SaveOutlined />}
              loading={isSubmitting}
              style={{ minWidth: 200 }}
              disabled={!selectedProduct}
            >
              Simpan Stok
            </Button>
          </div>
        </Form>
      </Card>

      {/* Daftar Riwayat Input Sesi Ini */}
      {recentEntries.length > 0 && (
        <Card
          title={
            <Space>
              <PlusOutlined />
              <span>Baru Saja Ditambahkan</span>
            </Space>
          }
          variant="borderless"
          style={{ borderRadius: 14 }}
          styles={{ body: { padding: 0 } }}
        >
          <Table
            dataSource={recentEntries}
            pagination={false}
            size="small"
            scroll={{ x: 500 }}
            columns={[
              { dataIndex: "nama", title: "Nama Barang", ellipsis: true },
              {
                dataIndex: "ukuran",
                title: "Ukuran",
                width: 140,
                render: (v) => v ?? "-",
              },
              {
                title: "Jumlah",
                width: 120,
                align: "right",
                render: (_, r) => (
                  <Text strong style={{ color: "#52c41a" }}>
                    +{formatNumber(r.jumlah)} <Text type="secondary" style={{fontSize: 12}}>{r.satuan}</Text>
                  </Text>
                ),
              },
              {
                dataIndex: "tanggal",
                title: "Tgl Kirim",
                width: 110,
                render: (v) => formatDate(v),
              },
            ]}
          />
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default ProductCreatePage;
