FILE: src/components/entry/EntryBoard.tsx
========================================
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  AutoComplete,
  Button,
  Card,
  Empty,
  Input,
  InputNumber,
  List,
  Space,
  Tag,
  Typography,
} from "antd";
import {
  CheckCircleOutlined,
  CloseCircleOutlined,
  EnvironmentOutlined,
  SearchOutlined,
  TeamOutlined,
  UserOutlined,
} from "@ant-design/icons";
import { useProductSearch } from "../../hooks/useProductSearch";
import { formatNumber } from "../../utility/format";
import type { Person, Team, Workplace, EntryLine } from "../../types/entry";
import type { Product } from "../../types";

const { Title, Text } = Typography;

interface Props {
  team: Team;
  person: Person;
  workplace: Workplace;
  phase: "search" | "quantity";
  activeItem: Product | null;
  activeQty: number;
  lines: EntryLine[];
  onSelectItem: (item: Product) => void;
  onConfirmQuantity: () => void;
  onCancelQuantity: () => void;
  onIncreaseQty: () => void;
  onDecreaseQty: () => void;
  onRemoveLine: (itemId: number) => void;
  onFinish: () => void;
}

export const EntryBoard = ({
  team,
  person,
  workplace,
  phase,
  activeItem,
  activeQty,
  lines,
  onSelectItem,
  onConfirmQuantity,
  onCancelQuantity,
  onIncreaseQty,
  onDecreaseQty,
  onRemoveLine,
  onFinish,
}: Props) => {
  // ==========================================
  // Local state
  // ==========================================
  const [keyword, setKeyword] = useState("");
  const [highlightedIdx, setHighlightedIdx] = useState(0);
  const searchRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const qtyRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const { products } = useProductSearch(keyword, 8);

  // ==========================================
  // Auto-focus sesuai phase
  // ==========================================
  useEffect(() => {
    if (phase === "search") {
      setTimeout(() => searchRef.current?.focus(), 100);
    } else if (phase === "quantity") {
      setTimeout(() => qtyRef.current?.focus(), 100);
    }
  }, [phase]);

  // ==========================================
  // Reset highlight saat keyword berubah
  // ==========================================
  useEffect(() => {
    setHighlightedIdx(0);
  }, [keyword]);

  // ==========================================
  // Ctrl+Enter → selesai
  // ==========================================
  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.ctrlKey && e.key === "Enter") {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (lines.length > 0) onFinish();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", handler);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handler);
  }, [lines.length, onFinish]);

  // ==========================================
  // Handlers — search phase
  // ==========================================
  const commitItem = () => {
    if (products.length === 0) return;
    const chosen = products[highlightedIdx] ?? products[0];
    onSelectItem(chosen);
    setKeyword("");
  };

  const handleSearchKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
      e.preventDefault();
      setHighlightedIdx((i) => Math.min(i + 1, products.length - 1));
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
      e.preventDefault();
      setHighlightedIdx((i) => Math.max(i - 1, 0));
    } else if (e.key === "Enter") {
      e.preventDefault();
      commitItem();
    }
  };

  // ==========================================
  // Handlers — quantity phase
  // ==========================================
  const handleQtyKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === "Enter") {
      e.preventDefault();
      onConfirmQuantity();
    } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
      e.preventDefault();
      onCancelQuantity();
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
      e.preventDefault();
      onIncreaseQty();
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
      e.preventDefault();
      onDecreaseQty();
    }
  };

  // ==========================================
  // Derived
  // ==========================================
  const totalItems = lines.reduce((sum, l) => sum + l.quantity, 0);

  return (
    <div style={{ maxWidth: 900, margin: "0 auto" }}>
      {/* ====================================== */}
      {/* Header card — workplace + team + person */}
      {/* ====================================== */}
      <Card variant="borderless" style={{ borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 16 }}>
        <Space direction="vertical" size={4} style={{ width: "100%" }}>
          <Space size={8}>
            <EnvironmentOutlined style={{ color: "#1677ff", fontSize: 20 }} />
            <Title level={3} style={{ margin: 0 }}>
              {workplace.name}
            </Title>
          </Space>
          <Space size={12} wrap>
            <Text type="secondary">
              <EnvironmentOutlined /> {workplace.name}
            </Text>
            <Text type="secondary">
              <TeamOutlined /> {team.name}
            </Text>
            <Text type="secondary">
              <UserOutlined /> {person.name}
            </Text>
          </Space>
        </Space>
      </Card>

      {/* ====================================== */}
      {/* Input card — search atau quantity       */}
      {/* ====================================== */}
      <Card
        variant="borderless"
        style={{ borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 16 }}
        styles={{ body: { padding: 24 } }}
      >
        {phase === "search" && (
          <>
            <Text strong style={{ fontSize: 14 }}>
              Nama Barang
            </Text>
            <AutoComplete
              value={keyword}
              onChange={setKeyword}
              options={products.map((p, idx) => ({
                value: p.name,
                label: (
                  <div
                    style={{
                      display: "flex",
                      justifyContent: "space-between",
                      padding: "2px 0",
                      background:
                        idx === highlightedIdx ? "#e6f4ff" : "transparent",
                    }}
                  >
                    <span>
                      {p.name}{" "}
                      <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                        · {p.code}
                      </Text>
                    </span>
                    <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                      stok: {p.stock} {p.unit}
                    </Text>
                  </div>
                ),
                data: p,
              }))}
              onSelect={(_, opt) => {
                onSelectItem((opt as { data: Product }).data);
                setKeyword("");
              }}
              style={{ width: "100%", marginTop: 8 }}
            >
              <Input
                ref={searchRef as never}
                size="large"
                prefix={<SearchOutlined />}
                placeholder="Ketik nama barang, lalu Enter..."
                onKeyDown={handleSearchKeyDown}
                autoFocus
              />
            </AutoComplete>

            <Space style={{ marginTop: 12 }} size="small" wrap>
              <Tag>↑↓</Tag>
              <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                navigasi
              </Text>
              <Tag>Enter</Tag>
              <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                pilih & lanjut ke jumlah
              </Text>
              <Tag>Ctrl+Enter</Tag>
              <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                selesai
              </Text>
            </Space>
          </>
        )}

        {phase === "quantity" && activeItem && (
          <>
            <Space
              style={{
                marginBottom: 12,
                width: "100%",
                justifyContent: "space-between",
              }}
            >
              <Text strong style={{ fontSize: 14 }}>
                Jumlah — {activeItem.name}
              </Text>
              <Tag color="blue">
                Stok: {activeItem.stock} {activeItem.unit}
              </Tag>
            </Space>

            <Space.Compact style={{ width: "100%" }}>
              <Button
                size="large"
                onClick={onDecreaseQty}
                style={{ width: 60, height: 48, fontSize: 20 }}
              >
                −
              </Button>

              <InputNumber
                ref={qtyRef as never}
                value={activeQty}
                size="large"
                min={1}
                max={activeItem.stock}
                controls={false}
                onKeyDown={handleQtyKeyDown}
                readOnly
                style={{
                  flex: 1,
                  textAlign: "center",
                  fontSize: 20,
                  fontWeight: 600,
                }}
              />

              <Button
                size="large"
                onClick={onIncreaseQty}
                style={{ width: 60, height: 48, fontSize: 20 }}
              >
                +
              </Button>
            </Space.Compact>

            <div style={{ marginTop: 8, textAlign: "right" }}>
              <Text type="secondary">
                {activeQty} {activeItem.unit}
              </Text>
            </div>

            <Space style={{ marginTop: 12 }} size="small" wrap>
              <Tag>↑↓ / + −</Tag>
              <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                ubah jumlah
              </Text>
              <Tag>Enter</Tag>
              <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                tambah & lanjut
              </Text>
              <Tag>Esc</Tag>
              <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                batal
              </Text>
            </Space>
          </>
        )}
      </Card>

      {/* ====================================== */}
      {/* Lines list — barang yang sudah di-input */}
      {/* ====================================== */}
      <Card
        title={`Daftar Barang (${lines.length} jenis · ${formatNumber(totalItems)} total)`}
        variant="borderless"
        style={{ borderRadius: 12 }}
        extra={
          <Button
            type="primary"
            icon={<CheckCircleOutlined />}
            disabled={lines.length === 0}
            onClick={onFinish}
          >
            Selesai (Ctrl+Enter)
          </Button>
        }
      >
        {lines.length === 0 ? (
          <Empty
            description="Belum ada barang ditambahkan"
            image={Empty.PRESENTED_IMAGE_SIMPLE}
          />
        ) : (
          <List
            size="small"
            dataSource={lines}
            renderItem={(line) => (
              <List.Item
                actions={[
                  <Button
                    key="del"
                    type="text"
                    danger
                    size="small"
                    icon={<CloseCircleOutlined />}
                    onClick={() => onRemoveLine(line.itemId)}
                  />,
                ]}
              >
                <List.Item.Meta
                  title={line.itemName}
                  description={`${formatNumber(line.quantity)} ${line.unit}`}
                />
              </List.Item>
            )}
          />
        )}
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
};



========================================
FILE: src/components/entry/SetupWizard.tsx
========================================
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  AutoComplete,
  Card,
  Input,
  Modal,
  Space,
  Steps,
  Tag,
  Typography,
} from "antd";
import { SearchOutlined } from "@ant-design/icons";
import type { Person, Workplace } from "../../types/entry";

const { Title, Text } = Typography;

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  step: "workplace" | "person";
  title: string;
  placeholder: string;
  options: readonly (Person | Workplace)[];
  onSelect: (value: Person | Workplace) => void;
  onBack?: () => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

const STEP_INDEX: Record<"workplace" | "person", number> = {
  workplace: 0,
  person: 1,
};

export const SetupWizard = ({
  open,
  step,
  title,
  placeholder,
  options,
  onSelect,
  onBack,
  onClose,
}: Props) => {
  const [keyword, setKeyword] = useState("");
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setKeyword("");
      setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 100);
    }
  }, [open, step]);

  const filtered = options.filter((o) =>
    o.name.toLowerCase().includes(keyword.trim().toLowerCase()),
  );

  const handleEnter = () => {
    if (filtered.length > 0) {
      onSelect(filtered[0]);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onCancel={onClose}
      footer={null}
      closable
      maskClosable
      keyboard
      width={520}
      styles={{ body: { padding: 0 } }}
      style={{ top: 100 }}
    >
      <Card
        variant="borderless"
        style={{ borderRadius: 16 }}
        styles={{ body: { padding: 24 } }}
      >
        <Steps
          current={STEP_INDEX[step]}
          size="small"
          items={[{ title: "Lokasi" }, { title: "Nama" }]}
          style={{ marginBottom: 20 }}
        />

        <Title level={4} style={{ marginBottom: 4 }}>
          {title}
        </Title>
        <Text type="secondary">
          Ketik nama, lalu tekan <Tag>Enter</Tag> untuk memilih
        </Text>

        <div style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
          <AutoComplete
            value={keyword}
            onChange={setKeyword}
            options={filtered.map((o) => ({
              value: o.name,
              label: o.name,
              data: o,
            }))}
            onSelect={(_, option) => {
              const data = (option as { data: Person | Workplace }).data;
              onSelect(data);
            }}
            style={{ width: "100%" }}
            placeholder={placeholder}
          >
            <Input
              ref={inputRef as never}
              size="large"
              prefix={<SearchOutlined />}
              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                if (e.key === "Enter") {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  handleEnter();
                } else if (e.key === "Escape" && onBack) {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  onBack();
                }
              }}
              autoFocus
            />
          </AutoComplete>
        </div>

        <Space style={{ marginTop: 16 }} size="small">
          <Tag>Enter</Tag>
          <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
            pilih item pertama
          </Text>
          {onBack && (
            <>
              <Tag>Esc</Tag>
              <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                kembali
              </Text>
            </>
          )}
        </Space>
      </Card>
    </Modal>
  );
};

FILE: src/components/dashboard/QuickPanel.tsx

import {
  AutoComplete,
  Button,
  Card,
  Input,
  List,
  Space,
  Tag,
  Typography,
} from "antd";
import {
  CheckCircleOutlined,
  CloseCircleOutlined,
  EnvironmentOutlined,
  SearchOutlined,
  UserOutlined,
} from "@ant-design/icons";
import { formatNumber } from "../../utility/format";
import { COLORS } from "../../utility/constants";
import type { useQuickEntry } from "../../hooks/useQuickEntry";

const { Text } = Typography;

interface Props {
  entry: ReturnType<typeof useQuickEntry>;
}

export const QuickEntryPanel = ({ entry }: Props) => {
  const {
    flow,
    keyword,
    setKeyword,
    highlightedIdx,
    searchResults,
    searchRef,
    handleSearchKeyDown,
    activeItem,
    activeQty,
    setActiveQty,
    qtyRef,
    handleQtyKeyDown,
    pendingLines,
    totalPendingItems,
    removeLine,
    phase,
    handleFinish,
    handleCancel,
  } = entry;

  return (
    <Card
      variant="borderless"
      style={{
        borderRadius: 12,
        marginBottom: 16,
        border:
          flow.isReady && pendingLines.length > 0
            ? `1px solid ${COLORS.primary}`
            : undefined,
      }}
      styles={{ body: { padding: 16 } }}
    >
      {/* Session bar */}
      {flow.isReady && (
        <div
          style={{
            display: "flex",
            justifyContent: "space-between",
            alignItems: "center",
            marginBottom: 12,
            flexWrap: "wrap",
            gap: 8,
          }}
        >
          <Space size={8} wrap>
            <Tag icon={<EnvironmentOutlined />} color="blue">
              {flow.workplace?.name}
            </Tag>
            <Tag icon={<UserOutlined />}>{flow.person?.name}</Tag>
          </Space>
          <Space size={8}>
            <Button
              type="primary"
              size="small"
              icon={<CheckCircleOutlined />}
              disabled={pendingLines.length === 0}
              onClick={handleFinish}
            >
              Selesai (Ctrl+Enter)
            </Button>
            <Button size="small" type="text" onClick={handleCancel}>
              Batal
            </Button>
          </Space>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Search phase */}
      {phase === "search" && (
        <>
          <AutoComplete
            value={keyword}
            onChange={setKeyword}
            options={
              flow.isReady
                ? searchResults.map((p, idx) => ({
                    value: p.name,
                    label: (
                      <div
                        style={{
                          display: "flex",
                          justifyContent: "space-between",
                          padding: "2px 0",
                          background:
                            idx === highlightedIdx ? "#e6f4ff" : "transparent",
                        }}
                      >
                        <span>
                          {p.name}{" "}
                          <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                            · {p.code}
                          </Text>
                        </span>
                        <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                          stok: {p.stock} {p.unit}
                        </Text>
                      </div>
                    ),
                    data: p,
                  }))
                : []
            }
            style={{ width: "100%" }}
          >
            <Input
              ref={searchRef as never}
              size="large"
              prefix={<SearchOutlined style={{ fontSize: 18 }} />}
              placeholder={
                flow.isReady
                  ? "🔍 Ketik nama material, lalu Enter untuk tambah..."
                  : "🔍 Klik di sini untuk memulai sesi pengeluaran..."
              }
              onKeyDown={flow.isReady ? handleSearchKeyDown : undefined}
              onClick={() => {
                if (!flow.isReady) {
                  flow.openWizard();
                }
              }}
              readOnly={!flow.isReady}
              autoFocus={flow.isReady}
              style={{
                fontSize: 15,
                height: 48,
                cursor: flow.isReady ? "text" : "pointer",
                background: flow.isReady ? undefined : "#f5f5f5",
              }}
            />
          </AutoComplete>

          <div style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
            {flow.isReady ? (
              <Space size="small" wrap>
                <Tag>↑↓</Tag>
                <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                  navigasi
                </Text>
                <Tag>Enter</Tag>
                <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                  pilih & lanjut ke jumlah
                </Text>
                <Tag>Ctrl+Enter</Tag>
                <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                  selesai
                </Text>
              </Space>
            ) : (
              <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                Pilih Lokasi → Nama untuk memulai
              </Text>
            )}
          </div>
        </>
      )}

      {/* Quantity phase */}
      {phase === "quantity" && activeItem && (
        <div>
          <div style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
            <Text strong style={{ marginRight: 8 }}>
              Jumlah — {activeItem.name}
            </Text>
            <Tag color="blue">
              Stok: {activeItem.stock} {activeItem.unit}
            </Tag>
          </div>
          <Space.Compact style={{ width: "100%" }}>
            <Button
              size="large"
              onClick={() => setActiveQty((q) => Math.max(1, q - 1))}
              style={{ width: 60, height: 48, fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 600 }}
            >
              −
            </Button>
            <Input
              ref={qtyRef as never}
              value={activeQty}
              size="large"
              onKeyDown={handleQtyKeyDown}
              readOnly
              style={{
                flex: 1,
                textAlign: "center",
                fontSize: 22,
                fontWeight: 600,
                height: 48,
              }}
            />
            <Button
              size="large"
              onClick={() => setActiveQty((q) => q + 1)}
              style={{ width: 60, height: 48, fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 600 }}
            >
              +
            </Button>
          </Space.Compact>
          <div style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
            <Space size="small" wrap>
              <Tag>↑↓ / + −</Tag>
              <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                ubah jumlah
              </Text>
              <Tag>Enter</Tag>
              <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                tambah
              </Text>
              <Tag>Esc</Tag>
              <Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                batal
              </Text>
            </Space>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Pending list */}
      {pendingLines.length > 0 && (
        <div
          style={{
            marginTop: 12,
            paddingTop: 12,
            borderTop: "1px dashed #f0f0f0",
          }}
        >
          <Text
            strong
            style={{ fontSize: 13, display: "block", marginBottom: 8 }}
          >
            📝 Akan disimpan ({pendingLines.length} jenis ·{" "}
            {formatNumber(totalPendingItems)} total):
          </Text>
          <List
            size="small"
            dataSource={pendingLines}
            renderItem={(line) => (
              <List.Item
                style={{ padding: "4px 0" }}
                actions={[
                  <Button
                    key="del"
                    type="text"
                    danger
                    size="small"
                    icon={<CloseCircleOutlined />}
                    onClick={() => removeLine(line.itemId)}
                  />,
                ]}
              >
                <Space>
                  <Text style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>{line.itemName}</Text>
                  <Tag color="blue" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
                    {formatNumber(line.quantity)} {line.unit}
                  </Tag>
                </Space>
              </List.Item>
            )}
          />
        </div>
      )}
    </Card>
  );
};

FILE: src/authProvider.ts
========================================
import type {
  AuthProvider,
  AuthActionResponse,
  CheckResponse,
} from "@refinedev/core";
import { supabaseClient } from "./utility/supabaseClient";
import { USE_MOCK } from "./utility/config";

const MOCK_USER = {
  email: "admin@admin.com",
  password: "admin123",
  name: "Administrator",
};

const STORAGE_KEY = "mock-auth-user";

const getMockUser = () => {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};

export const authProvider: AuthProvider = {
  login: async ({ email, password }): Promise<AuthActionResponse> => {
    if (USE_MOCK) {
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400));
      if (email === MOCK_USER.email && password === MOCK_USER.password) {
        localStorage.setItem(
          STORAGE_KEY,
          JSON.stringify({ email, name: MOCK_USER.name }),
        );
        return { success: true, redirectTo: "/dashboard" };
      }
      return {
        success: false,
        error: {
          name: "LoginError",
          message: "Email atau password salah",
        },
      };
    }

    const { data, error } = await supabaseClient.auth.signInWithPassword({
      email,
      password,
    });

    if (error) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: { name: "LoginError", message: error.message },
      };
    }
    if (!data?.user) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: { name: "LoginError", message: "User tidak ditemukan" },
      };
    }
    return { success: true, redirectTo: "/dashboard" };
  },

  logout: async (): Promise<AuthActionResponse> => {
    if (USE_MOCK) {
      localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      return { success: true, redirectTo: "/login" };
    }
    const { error } = await supabaseClient.auth.signOut();
    if (error) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: { name: "LogoutError", message: error.message },
      };
    }
    return { success: true, redirectTo: "/login" };
  },

  // ⬇️ INI YANG DIPERBAIKI: return type CheckResponse, bukan AuthActionResponse
  check: async (): Promise<CheckResponse> => {
    if (USE_MOCK) {
      const user = getMockUser();
      return user
        ? { authenticated: true }
        : { authenticated: false, redirectTo: "/login", logout: true };
    }
    const { data } = await supabaseClient.auth.getSession();
    return data.session
      ? { authenticated: true }
      : { authenticated: false, redirectTo: "/login", logout: true };
  },

  getIdentity: async () => {
    if (USE_MOCK) {
      const user = getMockUser();
      if (!user) return null;
      return {
        id: "mock-1",
        name: user.name,
        email: user.email,
        avatar: `https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=${encodeURIComponent(
          user.name,
        )}&background=1677ff&color=fff`,
      };
    }
    const { data } = await supabaseClient.auth.getUser();
    if (!data.user) return null;
    return {
      id: data.user.id,
      name: data.user.email?.split("@")[0] ?? "User",
      email: data.user.email,
      avatar: `https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=${encodeURIComponent(
        data.user.email ?? "U",
      )}&background=1677ff&color=fff`,
    };
  },

  getPermissions: async () => ["admin"],

  onError: async (error) => {
    if (error?.statusCode === 401) {
      return { logout: true, redirectTo: "/login", error };
    }
    return { error };
  },
};

// Tipe longgar untuk dynamic import
type AnyModule = Record<string, unknown>;

// Mock SEBELUM import
// ============================================

  supabaseClient: {
    auth: {
      getSession: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ data: { session: null } }),
      getUser: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ data: { user: null } }),
      signInWithPassword: vi.fn(),
      signOut: vi.fn(),
      onAuthStateChange: vi.fn(() => ({
        data: { subscription: { unsubscribe: vi.fn() } },
      })),
    },
    from: vi.fn(() => ({
      select: vi.fn().mockReturnThis(),
      order: vi.fn().mockReturnThis(),
      limit: vi.fn().mockReturnThis(),
      eq: vi.fn().mockReturnThis(),
      gte: vi.fn().mockReturnThis(),

}));

import { describe, it, expect, vi } from "vitest";
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { MemoryRouter } from "react-router";
import { App as AntdApp, ConfigProvider } from "antd";
import type { ComponentType, ReactNode } from "react";

// ============================================
// Tipe longgar untuk dynamic import
// ============================================
type AnyModule = Record<string, unknown>;
type AnyComponent = ComponentType<Record<string, unknown>>;

// ============================================
// Mock supabase
// ============================================
vi.mock("@/utility/supabaseClient", () => ({
  supabaseClient: {
    auth: {
      getSession: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ data: { session: null } }),
      getUser: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ data: { user: null } }),
      signInWithPassword: vi.fn(),
      signOut: vi.fn(),
      onAuthStateChange: vi.fn(() => ({
        data: { subscription: { unsubscribe: vi.fn() } },
      })),
    },
    from: vi.fn(() => ({
      select: vi.fn().mockReturnThis(),
      order: vi.fn().mockReturnThis(),
      limit: vi.fn().mockReturnThis(),
      eq: vi.fn().mockReturnThis(),
      gte: vi.fn().mockReturnThis(),
      single: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ data: null, error: null }),
    })),
  },
}));

vi.mock("@ant-design/plots", () => ({
  Line: () => <div data-testid="mock-line-chart" />,
}));

// ============================================
// Wrapper dengan semua provider yang dibutuhkan
// ============================================
function Wrapper({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const queryClient = new QueryClient({
    defaultOptions: {
      queries: { retry: false, cacheTime: 0 },
      mutations: { retry: false },
    },
  });

  return (
    <ConfigProvider theme={{ token: { colorPrimary: "#1677ff" } }}>
      <AntdApp>
        <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
          <MemoryRouter>{children}</MemoryRouter>
        </QueryClientProvider>
      </AntdApp>
    </ConfigProvider>
  );
}

function safeRender(ui: ReactNode) {
  return render(<Wrapper>{ui}</Wrapper>);
}

// ============================================
// Helper: ambil komponen dari module
// ============================================
async function loadComponent(
  modulePath: string,
  exportName: string,
): Promise<AnyComponent> {
  const mod = (await import(/* @vite-ignore */ modulePath)) as AnyModule;
  return mod[exportName] as AnyComponent;
}

// ============================================
// Tests
// ============================================
describe("DIAGNOSTIC 03 — Component Renders", () => {
  // ----------------------------------------
  // Components murni (tanpa provider khusus)
  // ----------------------------------------
  describe("Pure components", () => {
    it("renders StatCard", async () => {
      const StatCard = await loadComponent(
        "@/components/dashboard/StatCard",
        "StatCard",
      );
      safeRender(<StatCard title="Test" value={100} />);
      expect(screen.getByText("Test")).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("renders StatusBadge (safe)", async () => {
      const StatusBadge = await loadComponent(
        "@/components/common/StatusBadge",
        "StatusBadge",
      );
      safeRender(<StatusBadge status="safe" />);
      expect(screen.getByText(/aman/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("renders StatusBadge (low)", async () => {
      const StatusBadge = await loadComponent(
        "@/components/common/StatusBadge",
        "StatusBadge",
      );
      safeRender(<StatusBadge status="low" />);
      expect(screen.getByText(/menipis/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("renders StatusBadge (out)", async () => {
      const StatusBadge = await loadComponent(
        "@/components/common/StatusBadge",
        "StatusBadge",
      );
      safeRender(<StatusBadge status="out" />);
      expect(screen.getByText(/habis/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
  });

  // ----------------------------------------
  // Components dengan data hooks (query)
  // ----------------------------------------
  describe("Data components (mock mode)", () => {
    it("renders LowStockTable", async () => {
      const LowStockTable = await loadComponent(
        "@/components/dashboard/LowStockTable",

      );

      expect(() => safeRender(<LowStockTable />)).not.toThrow();
    });

    it("renders StockInChart", async () => {
      const StockInChart = await loadComponent(

      expect(() => safeRender(<StockInChart />)).not.toThrow();

    it("renders GlobalSearch", async () => {

      expect(() => safeRender(<GlobalSearch />)).not.toThrow();

  // ----------------------------------------
  // Pages — butuh Refine context

      expect(mod.LoginPage).toBeDefined();

    it("DashboardPage module bisa di-load", async () => {

import { describe, it, expect, vi } from "vitest";
import { createElement } from "react";
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import type { ComponentType } from "react";

// ============================================
// Tipe longgar
// ============================================
type AnyModule = Record<string, unknown>;

// ============================================
// Mock supabase
// ============================================
vi.mock("@/utility/supabaseClient", () => ({
  supabaseClient: {
    auth: {
      getSession: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ data: { session: null } }),
      getUser: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ data: { user: null } }),
      signInWithPassword: vi.fn(),
      signOut: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ error: null }),
      onAuthStateChange: vi.fn(() => ({
        data: { subscription: { unsubscribe: vi.fn() } },
      })),
    },
    from: vi.fn(() => ({
      select: vi.fn().mockReturnThis(),
      order: vi.fn().mockReturnThis(),
      limit: vi.fn().mockReturnThis(),
      eq: vi.fn().mockReturnThis(),
      gte: vi.fn().mockReturnThis(),
      single: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ data: null, error: null }),
    })),
  },
}));

vi.mock("@ant-design/plots", () => ({
  Line: () => null,
}));

// ============================================
// Helper
// ============================================
async function loadApp(): Promise<ComponentType> {
  const mod = (await import("@/App")) as AnyModule;
  return mod.default as ComponentType;
}

// ============================================
// Tests
// ============================================
describe("DIAGNOSTIC 04 — Full App Render", () => {
  it(
    "Step 1: App.tsx module loads",
    async () => {
      const mod = (await import("@/App")) as AnyModule;
      expect(mod).toBeDefined();
      expect(mod.default).toBeDefined();
      expect(typeof mod.default).toBe("function");
    },
    30_000,
  );

  it(
    "Step 2: App renders without throwing synchronously",
    async () => {
      const App = await loadApp();

      let renderError: Error | null = null;
      try {
        render(createElement(App));
      } catch (e) {
        renderError = e as Error;
      }

      expect(renderError).toBeNull();
    },
    30_000,
  );

  it(
    "Step 3: App renders and produces DOM output",
    async () => {
      const App = await loadApp();
      const { container } = render(createElement(App));

      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500));

      expect(container).toBeTruthy();
      expect(document.body.innerHTML.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    },
    30_000,
  );

  it(
    "Step 4: login page appears (auth belum login)",
    async () => {
      const App = await loadApp();
      render(createElement(App));

      // ⬇️ "Admin Stok" — dengan huruf "k", bukan "ck"
      const heading = await screen.findByText(
        /admin stok/i,
        {},
        { timeout: 10_000 },
      );
      expect(heading).toBeInTheDocument();
    },
    30_000,
  );

  it(
    "Step 5: form login punya input email & password",
    async () => {
      const App = await loadApp();
      render(createElement(App));

      // ⬇️ "Admin Stok" — dengan huruf "k", bukan "ck"
      await screen.findByText(/admin stok/i, {}, { timeout: 10_000 });

      expect(
        screen.getByPlaceholderText("admin@admin.com"),
      ).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.getByPlaceholderText("••••••••")).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(
        screen.getByRole("button", { name: /masuk/i }),
      ).toBeInTheDocument();
    },
    30_000,
  );
});

FILE: tests/diagnostics/05-supabase-config.test.ts

import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest";

describe("FOCUS: Supabase Config", () => {
  it("VITE_SUPABASE_URL terdefinisi", () => {
    expect(import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL).toBeDefined();
    expect(typeof import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL).toBe("string");
    expect(import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });

  it("VITE_SUPABASE_KEY terdefinisi", () => {
    expect(import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_KEY).toBeDefined();
    expect(typeof import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_KEY).toBe("string");
    expect(import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_KEY.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });

  it("URL format benar (https, tanpa trailing slash)", () => {
    const url = import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL;
    expect(url).toMatch(/^https:\/\//);
    expect(url).not.toMatch(/\/$/);
    expect(url).not.toMatch(/\/rest\/v1\/?$/); // TIDAK boleh ada /rest/v1/
  });

  it("URL mengarah ke supabase.co", () => {
    const url = import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL;
    expect(url).toMatch(/\.supabase\.co/);
  });

  it("Key bukan service_role (harus publishable/anon)", () => {
    const key = import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_KEY;
    // service_role pakai JWT dengan "role":"service_role"
    // atau prefix "sb_secret_"
    expect(key).not.toMatch(/^sb_secret_/);

    // Kalau JWT, decode untuk cek role
    if (key.startsWith("eyJ")) {
      const parts = key.split(".");
      if (parts.length >= 2) {
        try {
          const payload = JSON.parse(atob(parts[1]));
          expect(payload.role).not.toBe("service_role");
        } catch {
          // Kalau tidak bisa decode, skip
        }
      }
    }
  });
});

FILE: tests/diagnostics/06-supabase-connection.test.ts

import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest";
import { createClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";

describe("FOCUS: Supabase Connection", () => {
  const url = import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL;
  const key = import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_KEY;
  const supabase = createClient(url, key);

  it("Client berhasil dibuat", () => {
    expect(supabase).toBeDefined();
    expect(supabase.from).toBeDefined();
  });

  it("Bisa ping ke Supabase (health check)", async () => {
    const response = await fetch(`${url}/rest/v1/barang?select=id&limit=1`, {
      headers: {
        apikey: key,
        Authorization: `Bearer ${key}`,
      },
    });
    expect(response.ok).toBe(true);
  }, 15_000);

  it("Tabel 'barang' bisa dibaca", async () => {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.from("barang").select("*").limit(3);

    expect(error).toBeNull();
    expect(Array.isArray(data)).toBe(true);
  }, 15_000);

  it("Data barang tidak kosong (≥ 1 baris)", async () => {
    const { count, error } = await supabase
      .from("barang")
      .select("*", { count: "exact", head: true });

    expect(error).toBeNull();
    expect(count).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    console.log(`📊 Total barang di Supabase: ${count}`);
  }, 15_000);

  it("Struktur kolom sesuai (kode, nama, ukuran, satuan, stok)", async () => {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.from("barang").select("*").limit(1);

    expect(error).toBeNull();
    expect(data).toBeDefined();
    expect(data!.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);

    const row = data![0];
    expect(row).toHaveProperty("id");
    expect(row).toHaveProperty("kode");
    expect(row).toHaveProperty("nama");
    expect(row).toHaveProperty("ukuran");
    expect(row).toHaveProperty("satuan");
    expect(row).toHaveProperty("stok");
  }, 15_000);
});

FILE: tests/diagnostics/07-mappers.test.ts
================================================================================
import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest";
import { mapProduct } from "@/utility/mappers";

describe("FOCUS: Product Mapper", () => {
  it("Mapping lengkap", () => {
    const dbRow = {
      id: 1,
      kode: "BRG-001",
      nama: "Printer",
      ukuran: "A3",
      satuan: "unit",
      stok: 10,
      created_at: "2026-10-13T00:00:00Z",
    };

    const product = mapProduct(dbRow);

    expect(product.id).toBe(1);
    expect(product.code).toBe("BRG-001");
    expect(product.name).toBe("Printer");
    expect(product.size).toBe("A3");
    expect(product.unit).toBe("unit");
    expect(product.stock).toBe(10);
  });

  it("Handle ukuran null", () => {
    const dbRow = {
      id: 2,
      kode: "BRG-002",
      nama: "Laptop",
      ukuran: null,
      satuan: "unit",
      stok: 5,
      created_at: "2026-10-13T00:00:00Z",
    };

    const product = mapProduct(dbRow);
    expect(product.size).toBeNull();
  });

  it("Handle field missing (fallback default)", () => {
    const dbRow = {
      id: 3,
      kode: "BRG-003",
      nama: "Test",
    };

    const product = mapProduct(dbRow);
    expect(product.size).toBeNull();
    expect(product.unit).toBe("pcs");
    expect(product.stock).toBe(0);
  });

  it("Semua 517 produk bisa di-map tanpa error", () => {
    const sample = Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => ({
      id: i + 1,
      kode: `BRG-${String(i + 1).padStart(3, "0")}`,
      nama: `Product ${i + 1}`,
      ukuran: i % 2 === 0 ? "10 cm" : null,
      satuan: "pcs",
      stok: i * 5,
      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    }));

    const products = sample.map(mapProduct);
    expect(products).toHaveLength(10);
    products.forEach((p) => {
      expect(p.id).toBeDefined();
      expect(p.code).toMatch(/^BRG-/);
      expect(typeof p.name).toBe("string");
      expect(typeof p.stock).toBe("number");
    });
  });
});

FILE: tests/diagnostics/08-hooks-supabase.test.tsx
================================================================================
import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest";
import { renderHook, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { useProducts } from "@/hooks/useProducts";
import { useProductSearch } from "@/hooks/useProductSearch";

function wrapper({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const qc = new QueryClient({
    defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: false } },
  });
  return <QueryClientProvider client={qc}>{children}</QueryClientProvider>;
}

describe("FOCUS: Hooks dengan Supabase", () => {
  it("useProducts fetch dari Supabase", async () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useProducts(), { wrapper });

    await waitFor(
      () => {
        expect(result.current.isLoading).toBe(false);
      },
      { timeout: 15_000 },
    );

    expect(result.current.products.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);

    const first = result.current.products[0];
    console.log("First product:", first);

    expect(first).toHaveProperty("id");
    expect(first).toHaveProperty("code");
    expect(first).toHaveProperty("name");
    expect(first).toHaveProperty("stock");
  }, 20_000);

  it("useProductSearch cari 'beras'", async () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useProductSearch("beras", 5), {
      wrapper,
    });

    await waitFor(
      () => {
        expect(result.current.isLoading).toBe(false);
      },
      { timeout: 15_000 },
    );

    console.log(`Hasil cari "beras": ${result.current.products.length} item`);
    // Kalau ada "beras" di DB, harus > 0
    // Kalau tidak ada, minimal 0 tidak error
    expect(Array.isArray(result.current.products)).toBe(true);
  }, 20_000);

  it("useProductSearch cari 'kabel'", async () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useProductSearch("kabel", 10), {
      wrapper,
    });

    await waitFor(
      () => {
        expect(result.current.isLoading).toBe(false);
      },
      { timeout: 15_000 },
    );

    console.log(`Hasil cari "kabel": ${result.current.products.length} item`);
    result.current.products.forEach((p) => {
      expect(
        p.name.toLowerCase().includes("kabel") ||
          p.code.toLowerCase().includes("kabel"),
      ).toBe(true);
    });
  }, 20_000);
});

FILE: tests/unit/hooks/useKeyboardShortcut.test.ts
================================================================================
import { describe, it, expect, vi } from "vitest";
import { renderHook, fireEvent } from "@testing-library/react";
import { useKeyboardShortcut } from "@/hooks/useKeyboardShortcut";

describe("useKeyboardShortcut", () => {
  it("memanggil handler saat tombol cocok", () => {
    const handler = vi.fn();
    renderHook(() => useKeyboardShortcut({ key: " ", handler }));

    fireEvent.keyDown(window, { key: " " });
    expect(handler).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it("TIDAK memanggil saat tombol beda", () => {
    const handler = vi.fn();
    renderHook(() => useKeyboardShortcut({ key: " ", handler }));

    fireEvent.keyDown(window, { key: "a" });
    expect(handler).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("ctrl modifier harus cocok", () => {
    const handler = vi.fn();
    renderHook(() =>
      useKeyboardShortcut({ key: "k", ctrlKey: true, handler }),
    );

    fireEvent.keyDown(window, { key: "k" });
    expect(handler).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    fireEvent.keyDown(window, { key: "k", ctrlKey: true });
    expect(handler).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it("ignoreInputs=true skip saat fokus di input", () => {
    const handler = vi.fn();
    renderHook(() =>
      useKeyboardShortcut({ key: " ", ignoreInputs: true, handler }),
    );

    const input = document.createElement("input");
    document.body.appendChild(input);

    fireEvent.keyDown(input, { key: " " });
    expect(handler).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    document.body.removeChild(input);
  });

  it("enabled=false tidak memasang listener", () => {
    const handler = vi.fn();
    renderHook(() =>
      useKeyboardShortcut({ key: " ", enabled: false, handler }),
    );

    fireEvent.keyDown(window, { key: " " });
    expect(handler).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

FILE: tests/utils/render.tsx
================================================================================
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { render, type RenderOptions } from "@testing-library/react";
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { MemoryRouter } from "react-router-dom";
import { App as AntdApp, ConfigProvider } from "antd";

interface CustomOptions extends Omit<RenderOptions, "wrapper"> {
  initialRoute?: string;
  withRouter?: boolean;
}

export function renderWithProviders(
  ui: ReactNode,
  {
    initialRoute = "/",
    withRouter = true,
    ...options
  }: CustomOptions = {},
) {
  const queryClient = new QueryClient({
    defaultOptions: {
      // ⬇️ v4 pakai cacheTime, bukan gcTime
      queries: { retry: false, cacheTime: 0 },
      mutations: { retry: false },
    },
  });

  const Wrapper = ({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) => (
    <ConfigProvider theme={{ token: { colorPrimary: "#1677ff" } }}>
      <AntdApp>
        <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
          {withRouter ? (
            <MemoryRouter initialEntries={[initialRoute]}>
              {children}
            </MemoryRouter>
          ) : (
            children
          )}
        </QueryClientProvider>
      </AntdApp>
    </ConfigProvider>
  );

  return render(ui, { wrapper: Wrapper, ...options });
}

export { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
export { default as userEvent } from "@testing-library/user-event";
